FTC.Entry.source:
structure Entry (X : Type*) where
  point : X
  weight : ℝ
  weight_nonneg : 0 ≤ weight

/-- Weighted contribution of one separately indexed copy. -/

FTC.contribution.source:
def contribution (loss : X → S → ℝ) (entries : I → Entry X) (i : I) (s : S) : ℝ :=
  (entries i).weight * loss (entries i).point s

FTC.contribution_nonneg.source:
theorem contribution_nonneg (loss : X → S → ℝ) (entries : I → Entry X)
    (h : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ loss x s) (i : I) (s : S) :
    0 ≤ contribution loss entries i s :=
  mul_nonneg (entries i).weight_nonneg (h _ _)

/-- Cost over the active indices, with inherited contributions. -/

FTC.IsCoreset.source:
def IsCoreset (ε : ℝ) (reference approx : S → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s, (1 - ε) * reference s ≤ approx s ∧ approx s ≤ (1 + ε) * reference s

FTC.cost_nonneg.source:
theorem cost_nonneg {c : I → S → ℝ} (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    (Q : Finset I) (s : S) : 0 ≤ cost c Q s :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hc i s

FTC.contribution_le_cost.source:
theorem contribution_le_cost {c : I → S → ℝ} (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) (s : S) : c i s ≤ cost c Q s :=
  Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hc j s) hi

FTC.cost_eq_zero_contribution.source:
theorem cost_eq_zero_contribution {c : I → S → ℝ} (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) {s : S} (hzero : cost c Q s = 0) :
    c i s = 0 := by
  have hle := contribution_le_cost hc hi s
  rw [hzero] at hle
  exact le_antisymm hle (hc i s)

FTC.cost_mono.source:
theorem cost_mono {c : I → S → ℝ} (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {A B : Finset I} (h : A ⊆ B) (s : S) : cost c A s ≤ cost c B s :=
  Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h (fun i _ _ => hc i s)

FTC.cost_empty.source:
@[simp] theorem cost_empty (c : I → S → ℝ) (s : S) : cost c ∅ s = 0 := by
  simp [cost]

FTC.cost_sdiff_add_inter.source:
theorem cost_sdiff_add_inter (c : I → S → ℝ) (Q B : Finset I) (s : S) :
    cost c (Q \ B) s + cost c (Q ∩ B) s = cost c Q s := by
  unfold cost
  rw [← Finset.sum_union (Finset.disjoint_sdiff_inter Q B), Finset.sdiff_union_inter]

FTC.cost_sdiff_add.source:
theorem cost_sdiff_add (c : I → S → ℝ) {Q A : Finset I} (h : A ⊆ Q) (s : S) :
    cost c (Q \ A) s + cost c A s = cost c Q s := by
  simpa [Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr h] using cost_sdiff_add_inter c Q A s

FTC.cost_le_card_mul.source:
theorem cost_le_card_mul {c : I → S → ℝ} {Q : Finset I} {b : ℝ} {s : S}
    (h : ∀ i ∈ Q, c i s ≤ b) : cost c Q s ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) * b := by
  calc
    cost c Q s ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Q, b := Finset.sum_le_sum h
    _ = (Q.card : ℝ) * b := by simp

FTC.cost_erase_add.source:
theorem cost_erase_add (c : I → S → ℝ) {Q : Finset I} {i : I}
    (hi : i ∈ Q) (s : S) : cost c (Q.erase i) s + c i s = cost c Q s := by
  exact Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hi

end FTC

FTC.IsFCorruption.source:
def IsFCorruption (f : ℕ) (U : Finset I) (original corrupted : I → Entry X) : Prop :=
  ∃ B ⊆ U, B.card ≤ f ∧ ∀ i ∈ U, i ∉ B → corrupted i = original i

FTC.IsFCorruption.refl.source:
theorem IsFCorruption.refl (f : ℕ) (U : Finset I) (entries : I → Entry X) :
    IsFCorruption f U entries entries := by
  exact ⟨∅, Finset.empty_subset _, by simp, by intros; rfl⟩

/-- Deterministic success event from Definition 2.1. The decoder observes only
the corrupted entries, returns active indices, and inherits their weights.
The probability of this event is handled separately in `Sampling.lean`. -/

FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant.source:
def IsFilteringFaultTolerant (ε : ℝ) (f : ℕ) (reference : S → ℝ)
    (loss : X → S → ℝ) (U : Finset I) (entries : I → Entry X)
    (decoder : (I → Entry X) → Finset I) : Prop :=
  IsCoreset ε reference (cost (contribution loss entries) U) ∧
    ∀ corrupted, IsFCorruption f U entries corrupted →
      decoder corrupted ⊆ U ∧
        IsCoreset ε reference (cost (contribution loss corrupted) (decoder corrupted))

end FTC

FTC.Counterexample.proxyScore.source:
noncomputable def proxyScore {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad first : Fin n) (A : Query n) : Finset (Fin n) → Fin n → ℝ :=
  fun _ i => proxy M hM bad first A i

FTC.Counterexample.corruption_one.source:
theorem corruption_one {n : ℕ} (bad : Fin n) :
    FTC.IsFCorruption 1 Finset.univ cleanEntries (corruptedEntries bad) := by
  refine ⟨{bad}, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i _ hi
  have hib : i ≠ bad := by simpa using hi
  simp [corruptedEntries, cleanEntries, hib]

FTC.Counterexample.clean_is_exact.source:
theorem clean_is_exact {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    FTC.IsCoreset 0 (cleanCost (n := n) M hM)
      (FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) Finset.univ) := by
  intro S
  simp [cleanCost]

FTC.Counterexample.proxy_peel_output.source:
theorem proxy_peel_output {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 8 ≤ n) (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4) (bad first j : Fin n)
    (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) (hbad : bad.val ≠ 0) (hbj : bad ≠ j) :
    FTC.peel (proxyScore M hM bad first (referenceQuery j)) 1 Finset.univ =
      Finset.univ.erase first := by
  apply peel_one_of_strict_max _ _ first (Finset.mem_univ first)
  intro i _ hi
  exact proxy_strict_max M hM hn hM2 bad first j i hfirst hj hbad hbj hi

FTC.Counterexample.exact_peel_output.source:
theorem exact_peel_output {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 8 ≤ n) (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4)
    (bad j l : Fin n) (hjl : j ≠ l) (hbj : bad ≠ j) (hbl : bad ≠ l) :
    FTC.peel (FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M hM bad)) 1 Finset.univ =
      Finset.univ.erase bad := by
  apply peel_one_of_strict_max _ _ bad (Finset.mem_univ bad)
  intro i _ hi
  exact corruption_strict_sensitivity_max M hM hn hM2 bad j l hjl hbj hbl i hi

/-- Exact distortion at the explicit query `{p_j,p_l}` after proxy deletion. -/

FTC.Counterexample.proxy_output_distorti.source:
theorem proxy_output_distortion {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4) (bad first j l : Fin n) (hjl : j ≠ l)
    (hbj : bad ≠ j) (hbl : bad ≠ l) (hfb : first ≠ bad)
    (hfj : first ≠ j) (hfl : first ≠ l) :
    FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) (Finset.univ.erase first)
        (simplexQuery j l hjl) / cleanCost M hM (simplexQuery j l hjl) =
      wrongDistortion (n : ℝ) := by
  rw [cost_erase_first_simplex M hM bad first j l hjl hbj hbl hfb hfj hfl,
    cleanCost_simplex, hM2]
  unfold wrongDistortion
  congr 1
  ring

FTC.Counterexample.proxy_output_not_core.source:
theorem proxy_output_not_coreset {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hn : 8 / ε ≤ (n : ℝ))
    (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4) (bad first j l : Fin n) (hjl : j ≠ l)
    (hbj : bad ≠ j) (hbl : bad ≠ l) (hfb : first ≠ bad)
    (hfj : first ≠ j) (hfl : first ≠ l) :
    ¬ FTC.IsCoreset (6 * ε) (cleanCost M hM)
      (FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) (Finset.univ.erase first)) := by
  intro hco
  have hn8 := size_ge_eight hε hεsmall hn
  have hcpos : 0 < cleanCost M hM (simplexQuery j l hjl) := by
    rw [cleanCost_simplex]
    linarith
  have hratio := proxy_output_distortion M hM hM2 bad first j l hjl hbj hbl hfb hfj hfl
  have hgt := wrongDistortion_gt_tolerance hε hεsmall hn
  rw [← hratio] at hgt
  have hcostgt := (lt_div_iff₀ hcpos).mp hgt
  exact (not_le_of_gt hcostgt) (hco (simplexQuery j l hjl)).2

/-- All claims of the unnumbered Appendix A.1 counterexample, for one size.
The carrier is the actual finite metric `Vertex n` with `metricSpace M one_le_M`;
all costs and both decoders below operate on its actual two-center queries. -/

FTC.Counterexample.ProxyFailureAtSize.source:
structure ProxyFailureAtSize (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) where
  M : ℝ
  one_le_M : 1 ≤ M
  M_sq : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4
  bad : Fin n
  first : Fin n
  j : Fin n
  first_zero : first.val = 0
  j_nonzero : j.val ≠ 0
  bad_nonzero : bad.val ≠ 0
  singleton_genuine : first ≠ bad
  initial_exact : FTC.IsCoreset 0 (cleanCost (n := n) M one_le_M)
    (FTC.cost (cleanContribution M one_le_M) Finset.univ)
  admissible_corruption : FTC.IsFCorruption 1 Finset.univ cleanEntries (corruptedEntries bad)
  clean_sensitivity : ∀ i : Fin n,
    FTC.sensitivity (cleanContribution M one_le_M) Finset.univ i = 1 / ((n : ℝ) - 2)
  good_sensitivity : ∀ i : Fin n, i ≠ bad →
    FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M one_le_M bad) Finset.univ i ≤ 1 / ((n : ℝ) - 3)
  reference_cost : corruptCost M one_le_M bad (referenceQuery j) = referenceCost (n : ℝ)
  reference_two_approx : ∀ S : Query n,
    corruptCost M one_le_M bad (referenceQuery j) ≤ 2 * corruptCost M one_le_M bad S
  reference_nearest : ∀ i : Fin n,
    if i = first then graphDist M (corruptedEntries bad i).point a <
      graphDist M (corruptedEntries bad i).point (p j)
    else graphDist M (corruptedEntries bad i).point (p j) <
      graphDist M (corruptedEntries bad i).point a
  proxy_valid : ∀ i : Fin n,
    FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M one_le_M bad) Finset.univ i ≤
      proxy M one_le_M bad first (referenceQuery j) i
  proxy_unique_max : ∀ i : Fin n, i ≠ first →
    proxy M one_le_M bad first (referenceQuery j) i <
      proxy M one_le_M bad first (referenceQuery j) first
  exact_unique_max : ∀ i : Fin n, i ≠ bad →
    FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M one_le_M bad) Finset.univ i <
      FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M one_le_M bad) Finset.univ bad
  proxy_output : FTC.peel (proxyScore M one_le_M bad first (referenceQuery j)) 1 Finset.univ =
    Finset.univ.erase first
  exact_output : FTC.peel (FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M one_le_M bad)) 1 Finset.univ =
    Finset.univ.erase bad
  proxy_distortion : ∃ S : Query n,
    FTC.cost (corruptContribution M one_le_M bad) (Finset.univ.erase first) S /
      cleanCost M one_le_M S = wrongDistortion (n : ℝ)
  proxy_fails : ¬ FTC.IsCoreset (6 * ε) (cleanCost M one_le_M)
    (FTC.cost (corruptContribution M one_le_M bad)
      (FTC.peel (proxyScore M one_le_M bad first (referenceQuery j)) 1 Finset.univ))
  exact_succeeds : FTC.IsCoreset ε (cleanCost M one_le_M)
    (FTC.cost (corruptContribution M one_le_M bad)
      (FTC.peel (FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M one_le_M bad)) 1 Finset.univ))

/-- Full counterexample for every parameter choice in the source PDF.
`M = sqrt(n-4)`, `first = 0`, reference center `j = 1`, witness's other center
`l = 2`, and the corrupted index `bad = n-1` discharge all construction
hypotheses. There are no assumed metric, sensitivity, or decoder claims. -/

FTC.Counterexample.appendix_A1_counterex.source:
theorem appendix_A1_counterexample {n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hn : 8 / ε ≤ (n : ℝ)) :
    Nonempty (ProxyFailureAtSize n ε) := by
  have hnR : (8 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := size_ge_eight hε hεsmall hn
  have hn8 : 8 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hnR
  let M : ℝ := Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) - 4)
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hM : 1 ≤ M := by nlinarith
  let first : Fin n := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let j : Fin n := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  let l : Fin n := ⟨2, by omega⟩
  let bad : Fin n := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have hf : first.val = 0 := rfl
  have hj : j.val ≠ 0 := by norm_num [j]
  have hb : bad.val ≠ 0 := by dsimp [bad]; omega
  have hjl : j ≠ l := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; norm_num [j, l] at this
  have hbj : bad ≠ j := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; dsimp [bad, j] at this; omega
  have hbl : bad ≠ l := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; dsimp [bad, l] at this; omega
  have hfb : first ≠ bad := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; dsimp [first, bad] at this; omega
  have hfj : first ≠ j := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; norm_num [first, j] at this
  have hfl : first ≠ l := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; norm_num [first, l] at this
  have hpout := proxy_peel_output M hM hn8 hM2 bad first j hf hj hb hbj
  have heout := exact_peel_output M hM hn8 hM2 bad j l hjl hbj hbl
  refine ⟨{
    M := M, one_le_M := hM, M_sq := hM2,
    bad := bad, first := first, j := j,
    first_zero := hf, j_nonzero := hj, bad_nonzero := hb, singleton_genuine := hfb,
    initial_exact := clean_is_exact M hM,
    admissible_corruption := corruption_one bad,
    clean_sensitivity := clean_sensitivity_eq M hM (by omega),
    good_sensitivity := fun i hi => corrupt_good_sensitivity_le M hM (by omega) bad i hi,
    reference_cost := reference_cost_formula M hM hM2 bad first j hf hj hb hbj,
    reference_two_approx := reference_is_two_approx M hM hn8 hM2 bad first j hf hj hb hbj,
    reference_nearest := reference_assignment_nearest M bad first j hf hj hb,
    proxy_valid := fun i => sensitivity_le_proxy M hM hn8 hM2 bad first j i hf hj hb hbj,
    proxy_unique_max := fun i hi => proxy_strict_max M hM hn8 hM2 bad first j i hf hj hb hbj hi,
    exact_unique_max := fun i hi => corruption_strict_sensitivity_max M hM hn8 hM2 bad j l hjl hbj hbl i hi,
    proxy_output := hpout, exact_output := heout,
    proxy_distortion := ⟨simplexQuery j l hjl,
      proxy_output_distortion M hM hM2 bad first j l hjl hbj hbl hfb hfj hfl⟩,
    proxy_fails := ?_, exact_succeeds := ?_ }⟩
  · rw [hpout]
    exact proxy_output_not_coreset M hM ε hε hεsmall hn hM2 bad first j l hjl hbj hbl hfb hfj hfl
  · rw [heout]
    exact exact_deletion_isCoreset M hM (by omega) bad ε hε.le
      (distortion_and_deletion_bounds hε hεsmall hn).2.2

end FTC.Counterexample

FTC.Counterexample.sum_lower_bound_of_fl.source:
theorem sum_lower_bound_of_flat
    (Q E : Finset I) (c : I → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hflat : ∀ i ∈ Q \ E, c i = L) :
    ((Q.card : ℝ) - (E.card : ℝ)) * L ≤ ∑ i ∈ Q, c i := by
  have hcard : (Q.card : ℝ) - (E.card : ℝ) ≤ ((Q \ E).card : ℝ) := by
    have h := Finset.card_le_card_sdiff_add_card (s := Q) (t := E)
    have hr : (Q.card : ℝ) ≤ ((Q \ E).card : ℝ) + (E.card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast h
    linarith
  calc
    ((Q.card : ℝ) - (E.card : ℝ)) * L ≤ ((Q \ E).card : ℝ) * L :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hL
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Q \ E, c i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hflat]
      simp
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Q, c i :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg Finset.sdiff_subset (fun i _ _ => hc i)

/-- At most two exceptions give a uniform contribution bound for every
entry below the common level. The total may include additional bad entries. -/

FTC.Counterexample.contribution_mul_card.source:
theorem contribution_mul_card_sub_two_le
    (Q E : Finset I) (c : I → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hflat : ∀ i ∈ Q \ E, c i = L) (hE : E.card ≤ 2)
    (hQ : 2 ≤ Q.card) {i : I} (hi : c i ≤ L) :
    ((Q.card : ℝ) - 2) * c i ≤ ∑ j ∈ Q, c j := by
  have hq : 0 ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) - 2 := by
    have h : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hQ
    linarith
  have he : (E.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hE
  calc
    ((Q.card : ℝ) - 2) * c i ≤ ((Q.card : ℝ) - 2) * L :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi hq
    _ ≤ ((Q.card : ℝ) - (E.card : ℝ)) * L :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hL
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Q, c j := sum_lower_bound_of_flat Q E c L hc hL hflat

/-- At most two entries can receive an exceptional label from two centers. -/

FTC.Counterexample.card_biUnion_le_two.source:
theorem card_biUnion_le_two {X : Type*} [DecidableEq X]
    (C : Finset X) (exceptional : X → Finset I)
    (hC : C.card = 2) (hex : ∀ x, (exceptional x).card ≤ 1) :
    (C.biUnion exceptional).card ≤ 2 := by
  calc
    (C.biUnion exceptional).card ≤ ∑ x ∈ C, (exceptional x).card :=
      Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _x ∈ C, 1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => hex x)
    _ = 2 := by simp [hC]

end FTC.Counterexample

FTC.Counterexample.commonLevel.source:
noncomputable def commonLevel {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (S : Query n) : ℝ :=
  S.centers.inf' S.nonempty (fun v => baseline M v ^ 2)

/-- Union of the at-most-one original-point exceptions of the two centers. -/

FTC.Counterexample.queryExceptions.source:
def queryExceptions {n : ℕ} (S : Query n) : Finset (Fin n) :=
  S.centers.biUnion exceptional

FTC.Counterexample.queryExceptions_card_.source:
theorem queryExceptions_card_le_two {n : ℕ} (S : Query n) :
    (queryExceptions S).card ≤ 2 :=
  card_biUnion_le_two S.centers exceptional S.card_eq exceptional_card_le_one

FTC.Counterexample.one_le_commonLevel.source:
theorem one_le_commonLevel {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (S : Query n) :
    1 ≤ commonLevel M S := by
  apply Finset.le_inf'
  intro v _
  have hv := one_le_baseline M hM v
  nlinarith

FTC.Counterexample.commonLevel_nonneg.source:
theorem commonLevel_nonneg {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (S : Query n) :
    0 ≤ commonLevel M S := le_trans (by norm_num) (one_le_commonLevel M hM S)

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_le_commonLe.source:
theorem pointLoss_le_commonLevel {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (i : Fin n) (S : Query n) : pointLoss M hM (p i) S ≤ commonLevel M S := by
  apply Finset.le_inf'
  intro v hv
  have hpoint : pointLoss M hM (p i) S ≤ graphDist M (p i) v ^ 2 := by
    rw [pointLoss_eq_inf]
    exact Finset.inf'_le _ hv
  have hcap : graphDist M (p i) v ^ 2 ≤ baseline M v ^ 2 := by
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (graphDist_nonneg M hM _ _) (baseline_nonneg M hM v)).2
      (graphDist_le_baseline M i v)
  exact hpoint.trans hcap

/-- Every original point outside at most two exceptions has the common loss. -/

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_eq_commonLe.source:
theorem pointLoss_eq_commonLevel_of_notMem {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (i : Fin n) (S : Query n) (hi : i ∉ queryExceptions S) :
    pointLoss M hM (p i) S = commonLevel M S := by
  apply le_antisymm (pointLoss_le_commonLevel M hM i S)
  rw [pointLoss_eq_inf]
  apply Finset.le_inf'
  intro v hv
  have hinot : i ∉ exceptional v := by
    intro h
    exact hi (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨v, hv, h⟩)
  rw [graphDist_eq_baseline_of_notMem M i v hinot]
  exact Finset.inf'_le _ hv

FTC.Counterexample.commonLevel_mul_card_.source:
theorem commonLevel_mul_card_sub_two_le_cost {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (G : Finset (Fin n)) (S : Query n) :
    ((G.card : ℝ) - 2) * commonLevel M S ≤ FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) G S := by
  have he : ((queryExceptions S).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast queryExceptions_card_le_two S
  calc
    ((G.card : ℝ) - 2) * commonLevel M S ≤
        ((G.card : ℝ) - ((queryExceptions S).card : ℝ)) * commonLevel M S :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (commonLevel_nonneg M hM S)
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ G, cleanContribution M hM i S := by
      apply sum_lower_bound_of_flat G (queryExceptions S)
        (fun i => cleanContribution M hM i S) (commonLevel M S)
        (fun i => cleanContribution_nonneg M hM i S) (commonLevel_nonneg M hM S)
      intro i hi
      simp only [cleanContribution_apply]
      exact pointLoss_eq_commonLevel_of_notMem M hM i S (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).2
    _ = FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) G S := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_mul_card_su.source:
theorem pointLoss_mul_card_sub_two_le_cost {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (G : Finset (Fin n)) (hG : 2 ≤ G.card) (i : Fin n) (S : Query n) :
    ((G.card : ℝ) - 2) * pointLoss M hM (p i) S ≤
      FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) G S := by
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ (G.card : ℝ) - 2 := by
    have h : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (G.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hG
    linarith
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pointLoss_le_commonLevel M hM i S) hcoef).trans
    (commonLevel_mul_card_sub_two_le_cost M hM G S)

FTC.Counterexample.card_sub_two_le_cost.source:
theorem card_sub_two_le_cost {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (G : Finset (Fin n)) (hG : 2 ≤ G.card) (S : Query n) :
    (G.card : ℝ) - 2 ≤ FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) G S := by
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ (G.card : ℝ) - 2 := by
    have h : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (G.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hG
    linarith
  calc
    (G.card : ℝ) - 2 = ((G.card : ℝ) - 2) * 1 := by ring
    _ ≤ ((G.card : ℝ) - 2) * commonLevel M S :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (one_le_commonLevel M hM S) hcoef
    _ ≤ FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) G S :=
      commonLevel_mul_card_sub_two_le_cost M hM G S

FTC.Counterexample.cost_good_eq_clean.source:
theorem cost_good_eq_clean {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad : Fin n) (G : Finset (Fin n)) (hG : bad ∉ G) (S : Query n) :
    FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) G S = FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) G S := by
  apply FTC.cost_congr
  intro i hi T
  have hib : i ≠ bad := by intro h; subst i; exact hG hi
  simp [corruptContribution_apply, hib]

FTC.Counterexample.clean_uniform_bound.source:
theorem clean_uniform_bound {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) (S : Query n) :
    ((n : ℝ) - 2) * cleanContribution M hM i S ≤ cleanCost M hM S := by
  simpa [cleanCost] using pointLoss_mul_card_sub_two_le_cost M hM
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) (by simpa) i S

FTC.Counterexample.corrupt_uniform_good_.source:
theorem corrupt_uniform_good_bound {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (bad i : Fin n) (hib : i ≠ bad) (S : Query n) :
    ((n : ℝ) - 3) * corruptContribution M hM bad i S ≤ corruptCost M hM bad S := by
  let G := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase bad
  have hcard := Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_univ bad)
  have hcardR : (G.card : ℝ) + 1 = (n : ℝ) := by
    have hcN : G.card + 1 = n := by simpa [G] using hcard
    exact_mod_cast hcN
  have hG : 2 ≤ G.card := by
    have hc : G.card + 1 = n := by simpa [G] using hcard
    omega
  have hflat := pointLoss_mul_card_sub_two_le_cost M hM G hG i S
  have heq := cost_good_eq_clean M hM bad G (by simp [G]) S
  have hmono := FTC.cost_mono (corruptContribution_nonneg M hM bad)
    (Finset.erase_subset bad Finset.univ) S
  change FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) G S ≤ _ at hmono
  rw [heq] at hmono
  have hci : corruptContribution M hM bad i S = pointLoss M hM (p i) S := by simp [hib]
  rw [hci]
  have hcoef : (G.card : ℝ) - 2 = (n : ℝ) - 3 := by linarith
  rw [hcoef] at hflat
  exact hflat.trans hmono

FTC.Counterexample.corrupt_cost_lower_bo.source:
theorem corrupt_cost_lower_bound {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (bad : Fin n) (S : Query n) :
    (n : ℝ) - 3 ≤ corruptCost M hM bad S := by
  let G := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase bad
  have hcard := Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_univ bad)
  have hcardR : (G.card : ℝ) + 1 = (n : ℝ) := by
    have hcN : G.card + 1 = n := by simpa [G] using hcard
    exact_mod_cast hcN
  have hG : 2 ≤ G.card := by
    have hc : G.card + 1 = n := by simpa [G] using hcard
    omega
  have hlo := card_sub_two_le_cost M hM G hG S
  have heq := cost_good_eq_clean M hM bad G (by simp [G]) S
  have hmono := FTC.cost_mono (corruptContribution_nonneg M hM bad)
    (Finset.erase_subset bad Finset.univ) S
  change FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) G S ≤ _ at hmono
  rw [heq] at hmono
  change (n : ℝ) - 3 ≤ FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) Finset.univ S
  linarith

end FTC.Counterexample

FTC.Counterexample.Vertex.source: abbrev Vertex (n : ℕ) := Fin n ⊕ Bool

FTC.Counterexample.p.source: abbrev p {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : Vertex n := Sum.inl i

FTC.Counterexample.a.source: abbrev a {n : ℕ} : Vertex n := Sum.inr false

FTC.Counterexample.b.source:
abbrev b {n : ℕ} : Vertex n := Sum.inr true

noncomputable section

/-- Distance from the attachment vertex to an original point. -/

FTC.Counterexample.unitDistance.source:
def unitDistance {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : ℝ := if i = j then 0 else 1

/-- Explicit shortest-path distances of the counterexample graph. -/

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist.source:
def graphDist {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) : Vertex n → Vertex n → ℝ
  | .inl i, .inl j => unitDistance i j
  | .inl i, .inr false => firstDistance i
  | .inr false, .inl i => firstDistance i
  | .inl _, .inr true => M
  | .inr true, .inl _ => M
  | .inr false, .inr true => M + 1 / 2
  | .inr true, .inr false => M + 1 / 2
  | .inr false, .inr false => 0
  | .inr true, .inr true => 0

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_p_p.source:
@[simp] theorem graphDist_p_p {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    graphDist M (p i) (p j) = if i = j then 0 else 1 := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_p_a.source:
@[simp] theorem graphDist_p_a {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    graphDist M (p i) a = if i.val = 0 then 1 / 2 else 3 / 2 := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_a_p.source:
@[simp] theorem graphDist_a_p {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    graphDist M a (p i) = if i.val = 0 then 1 / 2 else 3 / 2 := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_p_b.source:
@[simp] theorem graphDist_p_b {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    graphDist M (p i) b = M := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_b_p.source:
@[simp] theorem graphDist_b_p {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    graphDist M b (p i) = M := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_a_b.source:
@[simp] theorem graphDist_a_b {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) :
    graphDist (n := n) M a b = M + 1 / 2 := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_b_a.source:
@[simp] theorem graphDist_b_a {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) :
    graphDist (n := n) M b a = M + 1 / 2 := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_a_a.source:
@[simp] theorem graphDist_a_a {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) :
    graphDist (n := n) M a a = 0 := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_b_b.source:
@[simp] theorem graphDist_b_b {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) :
    graphDist (n := n) M b b = 0 := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.unitDistance_nonneg.source:
theorem unitDistance_nonneg {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : 0 ≤ unitDistance i j := by
  unfold unitDistance
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

FTC.Counterexample.unitDistance_le_one.source:
theorem unitDistance_le_one {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : unitDistance i j ≤ 1 := by
  unfold unitDistance
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

FTC.Counterexample.firstDistance_bounds.source:
theorem firstDistance_bounds {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    1 / 2 ≤ firstDistance i ∧ firstDistance i ≤ 3 / 2 := by
  unfold firstDistance
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_self.source:
@[simp] theorem graphDist_self {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (x : Vertex n) :
    graphDist M x x = 0 := by
  rcases x with i | (_ | _) <;> simp [graphDist, unitDistance]

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_comm.source:
theorem graphDist_comm {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (x y : Vertex n) :
    graphDist M x y = graphDist M y x := by
  rcases x with i | (_ | _) <;> rcases y with j | (_ | _) <;>
    simp [graphDist, unitDistance, eq_comm]

/-- The triangle inequality, proved over the finite vertex cases. -/

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_triangle.source:
theorem graphDist_triangle {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (x y z : Vertex n) : graphDist M x z ≤ graphDist M x y + graphDist M y z := by
  rcases x with i | (_ | _) <;>
    rcases y with j | (_ | _) <;>
      rcases z with k | (_ | _) <;>
        simp only [graphDist, unitDistance, firstDistance] <;>
          (try split_ifs) <;> (try simp_all) <;> linarith

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_nonneg.source:
theorem graphDist_nonneg {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (x y : Vertex n) :
    0 ≤ graphDist M x y := by
  have h := graphDist_triangle M hM x y x
  rw [graphDist_self, graphDist_comm M y x] at h
  linarith

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_eq_zero_iff.source:
theorem graphDist_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (x y : Vertex n) :
    graphDist M x y = 0 ↔ x = y := by
  have hMne : M ≠ 0 := by linarith
  rcases x with i | (_ | _) <;> rcases y with j | (_ | _) <;>
    simp [graphDist, unitDistance, firstDistance, hMne] <;>
      (try split_ifs) <;> norm_num at * <;> linarith

/-- The actual finite metric space used in the counterexample. Install this
locally with `letI := metricSpace M hM`. -/

FTC.Counterexample.metricSpace.source:
@[reducible] def metricSpace {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) : MetricSpace (Vertex n) where
  dist := graphDist M
  dist_self := graphDist_self M
  dist_comm := graphDist_comm M
  dist_triangle := graphDist_triangle M hM
  eq_of_dist_eq_zero := fun h => (graphDist_eq_zero_iff M hM _ _).mp h

FTC.Counterexample.dist_metricSpace.source:
@[simp] theorem dist_metricSpace {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (x y : Vertex n) :
    @dist (Vertex n) (metricSpace M hM).toDist x y = graphDist M x y := rfl

/-- The common distance from an original point to a center, outside that
center's exceptional set. -/

FTC.Counterexample.baseline.source:
def baseline {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) : Vertex n → ℝ
  | .inl _ => 1
  | .inr false => 3 / 2
  | .inr true => M

/-- Each center has at most one exceptional original point. -/

FTC.Counterexample.exceptional_p.source: @[simp] theorem exceptional_p {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : exceptional (p i) = {i} := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.exceptional_a.source:
@[simp] theorem exceptional_a {n : ℕ} :
    exceptional (a : Vertex n) = Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i.val = 0) := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.exceptional_b.source: @[simp] theorem exceptional_b {n : ℕ} : exceptional (b : Vertex n) = ∅ := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.exceptional_card_le_o.source:
theorem exceptional_card_le_one {n : ℕ} (v : Vertex n) : (exceptional v).card ≤ 1 := by
  rcases v with i | (_ | _)
  · simp [exceptional]
  · apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
    intro i hi j hj
    apply Fin.ext
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2.trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.symm
  · simp [exceptional]

FTC.Counterexample.one_le_baseline.source:
theorem one_le_baseline {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (v : Vertex n) :
    1 ≤ baseline M v := by
  rcases v with i | (_ | _) <;> simp only [baseline] <;> linarith

FTC.Counterexample.baseline_nonneg.source:
theorem baseline_nonneg {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (v : Vertex n) :
    0 ≤ baseline M v := le_trans (by norm_num) (one_le_baseline M hM v)

/-- Exceptional original points have no larger distance than the common
level of a center. -/

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_le_baseline.source:
theorem graphDist_le_baseline {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (i : Fin n) (v : Vertex n) :
    graphDist M (p i) v ≤ baseline M v := by
  rcases v with j | (_ | _)
  · exact unitDistance_le_one i j
  · exact (firstDistance_bounds i).2
  · exact le_rfl

/-- Outside its at-most-one exception, a center has exactly its common
original-point distance. -/

FTC.Counterexample.graphDist_eq_baseline.source:
theorem graphDist_eq_baseline_of_notMem {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (i : Fin n) (v : Vertex n)
    (hi : i ∉ exceptional v) : graphDist M (p i) v = baseline M v := by
  rcases v with j | (_ | _)
  · have hij : i ≠ j := by simpa [exceptional] using hi
    simp [graphDist, unitDistance, baseline, hij]
  · have hi0 : i.val ≠ 0 := by simpa [exceptional] using hi
    simp [graphDist, firstDistance, baseline, hi0]
  · rfl

end

end FTC.Counterexample

FTC.Counterexample.clusterMembers.source:
def clusterMembers {n : ℕ} (first i : Fin n) : Finset (Fin n) :=
  if i = first then {first} else Finset.univ.erase first

FTC.Counterexample.card_cluster_first.source:
@[simp] theorem card_cluster_first {n : ℕ} (first : Fin n) :
    (clusterMembers first first).card = 1 := by simp [clusterMembers]

FTC.Counterexample.card_cluster_other.source:
theorem card_cluster_other {n : ℕ} (first i : Fin n) (hi : i ≠ first) :
    ((clusterMembers first i).card : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - 1 := by
  have h := Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_univ first)
  have hR : (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase first).card : ℝ) + 1 = (n : ℝ) := by
    have hN : (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase first).card) + 1 = n := by simpa using h
    exact_mod_cast hN
  simp only [clusterMembers, if_neg hi]
  linarith

/-- The usual proxy, with exactly the scaling used in Appendix A.1. -/

FTC.Counterexample.proxy.source:
noncomputable def proxy {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad first : Fin n) (A : Query n) (i : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  2 / ((clusterMembers first i).card : ℝ) +
    2 * corruptContribution M hM bad i A / corruptCost M hM bad A

FTC.Counterexample.proxy_first.source:
theorem proxy_first {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad first : Fin n) (A : Query n) :
    proxy M hM bad first A first =
      2 + 2 * corruptContribution M hM bad first A / corruptCost M hM bad A := by
  simp [proxy]

FTC.Counterexample.proxy_other.source:
theorem proxy_other {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad first i : Fin n) (A : Query n) (hi : i ≠ first) :
    proxy M hM bad first A i =
      2 / ((n : ℝ) - 1) +
        2 * corruptContribution M hM bad i A / corruptCost M hM bad A := by
  rw [proxy, card_cluster_other first i hi]

FTC.Counterexample.cluster_term_le_proxy.source:
theorem cluster_term_le_proxy {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad first i : Fin n) (A : Query n) :
    2 / ((clusterMembers first i).card : ℝ) ≤ proxy M hM bad first A i := by
  have hc : 0 ≤ corruptCost M hM bad A :=
    FTC.cost_nonneg (corruptContribution_nonneg M hM bad) _ _
  have hsecond : 0 ≤ 2 * corruptContribution M hM bad i A / corruptCost M hM bad A :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (corruptContribution_nonneg M hM bad i A)) hc
  unfold proxy
  linarith

/-- Ties elsewhere do not matter when the maximizing entry is strict. This
identifies the output of the actual Algorithm 1 function. -/

FTC.Counterexample.peel_one_of_strict_ma.source:
theorem peel_one_of_strict_max {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I]
    (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (U : Finset I) (x : I)
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hstrict : ∀ i ∈ U, i ≠ x → score U i < score U x) :
    FTC.peel score 1 U = U.erase x := by
  have hU : U.Nonempty := ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hspec := FTC.chosenMax_spec score U hU
  have hchosen : FTC.chosenMax score U hU = x := by
    by_contra h
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hspec.2 x hx)) (hstrict _ hspec.1 h)
  simp [FTC.peel, FTC.peelStep, hU, hchosen]

end FTC.Counterexample

FTC.Counterexample.assignedCenter.source:
def assignedCenter {n : ℕ} (first j i : Fin n) : Vertex n := if i = first then a else p j

/-- The proxy clusters are exactly the fibers of the reference assignment. -/

FTC.Counterexample.clusterMembers_eq_ass.source:
theorem clusterMembers_eq_assignment_fiber {n : ℕ} (first j i : Fin n) :
    clusterMembers first i = Finset.univ.filter
      (fun z => assignedCenter first j z = assignedCenter first j i) := by
  ext z
  by_cases hi : i = first <;> by_cases hz : z = first <;>
    simp [clusterMembers, assignedCenter, hi, hz]

/-- Every reference assignment is the unique closest of its two centers. -/

FTC.Counterexample.reference_assignment_.source:
theorem reference_assignment_nearest {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ)
    (bad first j : Fin n) (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0)
    (hbad : bad.val ≠ 0) (i : Fin n) :
    if i = first then
      graphDist M (corruptedEntries bad i).point a <
        graphDist M (corruptedEntries bad i).point (p j)
    else graphDist M (corruptedEntries bad i).point (p j) <
        graphDist M (corruptedEntries bad i).point a := by
  have hfb : first ≠ bad := by intro h; exact hbad (h ▸ hfirst)
  by_cases hi : i = first
  · subst i
    simpa [corruptedEntries, hfb] using reference_first_nearest M first j hfirst hj
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    by_cases hib : i = bad
    · subst i
      simpa [corruptedEntries] using reference_b_nearest M j
    · have hi0 : i.val ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hi
        exact Fin.ext (h0.trans hfirst.symm)
      simpa [corruptedEntries, hib] using reference_other_nearest M i j hi0

FTC.Counterexample.reference_cost_formul.source:
theorem reference_cost_formula {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4) (bad first j : Fin n)
    (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) (hbad : bad.val ≠ 0) (hbj : bad ≠ j) :
    corruptCost M hM bad (referenceQuery j) = referenceCost (n : ℝ) := by
  rw [corruptCost_reference M hM bad first j hfirst hj hbad hbj, hM2]
  unfold referenceCost
  ring

/-- The reference centers really are a factor-two approximation on Q. -/

FTC.Counterexample.reference_is_two_appr.source:
theorem reference_is_two_approx {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 8 ≤ n) (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4) (bad first j : Fin n)
    (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) (hbad : bad.val ≠ 0) (hbj : bad ≠ j)
    (S : Query n) : corruptCost M hM bad (referenceQuery j) ≤ 2 * corruptCost M hM bad S := by
  rw [reference_cost_formula M hM hM2 bad first j hfirst hj hbad hbj]
  exact reference_two_approx (corrupt_cost_lower_bound M hM (by omega) bad S)

FTC.Counterexample.proxy_first_formula.source:
theorem proxy_first_formula {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 8 ≤ n) (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4) (bad first j : Fin n)
    (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) (hbad : bad.val ≠ 0) (hbj : bad ≠ j) :
    proxy M hM bad first (referenceQuery j) first = singletonProxy (n : ℝ) := by
  have hfb : first ≠ bad := by intro h; exact hbad (h ▸ hfirst)
  rw [proxy_first, corruptContribution_apply, if_neg hfb,
    pointLoss_first_reference M hM first j hfirst hj,
    reference_cost_formula M hM hM2 bad first j hfirst hj hbad hbj]
  have hnR : (8 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hd := referenceCost_pos hnR
  unfold singletonProxy
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hd]
  <;> ring

FTC.Counterexample.proxy_bad_formula.source:
theorem proxy_bad_formula {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4) (bad first j : Fin n)
    (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) (hbad : bad.val ≠ 0) (hbj : bad ≠ j) :
    proxy M hM bad first (referenceQuery j) bad = corruptionProxy (n : ℝ) := by
  have hbf : bad ≠ first := by intro h; exact hbad (h.symm ▸ hfirst)
  rw [proxy_other M hM bad first bad (referenceQuery j) hbf,
    corruptContribution_apply, if_pos rfl, pointLoss_b_reference,
    reference_cost_formula M hM hM2 bad first j hfirst hj hbad hbj, hM2]
  rfl

FTC.Counterexample.proxy_ordinary_le.source:
theorem proxy_ordinary_le {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 8 ≤ n) (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4) (bad first j i : Fin n)
    (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) (hbad : bad.val ≠ 0) (hbj : bad ≠ j)
    (hif : i ≠ first) (hib : i ≠ bad) :
    proxy M hM bad first (referenceQuery j) i ≤ ordinaryProxy (n : ℝ) := by
  rw [proxy_other M hM bad first i (referenceQuery j) hif,
    corruptContribution_apply, if_neg hib,
    reference_cost_formula M hM hM2 bad first j hfirst hj hbad hbj]
  have hnR : (8 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hd := referenceCost_pos hnR
  have hcap := pointLoss_reference_le_one M hM i j
  have hr : 2 * pointLoss M hM (p i) (referenceQuery j) / referenceCost (n : ℝ) ≤
      2 / referenceCost (n : ℝ) := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hd.le
    linarith
  unfold ordinaryProxy
  linarith

/-- The singleton uniquely maximizes the proxy, although it is genuine. -/

FTC.Counterexample.proxy_strict_max.source:
theorem proxy_strict_max {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 8 ≤ n) (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4) (bad first j i : Fin n)
    (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) (hbad : bad.val ≠ 0) (hbj : bad ≠ j)
    (hif : i ≠ first) :
    proxy M hM bad first (referenceQuery j) i <
      proxy M hM bad first (referenceQuery j) first := by
  have hnR : (8 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  rw [proxy_first_formula M hM hn hM2 bad first j hfirst hj hbad hbj]
  by_cases hib : i = bad
  · subst i
    rw [proxy_bad_formula M hM hM2 bad first j hfirst hj hbad hbj]
    exact (corruptionProxy_lt_two hnR).trans (singletonProxy_gt_two hnR)
  · exact ((proxy_ordinary_le M hM hn hM2 bad first j i hfirst hj hbad hbj hif hib).trans_lt
      (ordinaryProxy_lt_two hnR)).trans (singletonProxy_gt_two hnR)

/-- These are valid pointwise sensitivity upper bounds on the actual Q. -/

FTC.Counterexample.sensitivity_le_proxy.source:
theorem sensitivity_le_proxy {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 8 ≤ n) (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4) (bad first j i : Fin n)
    (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) (hbad : bad.val ≠ 0) (hbj : bad ≠ j) :
    FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M hM bad) Finset.univ i ≤
      proxy M hM bad first (referenceQuery j) i := by
  have hnR : (8 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  by_cases hib : i = bad
  · subst i
    rw [proxy_bad_formula M hM hM2 bad first j hfirst hj hbad hbj]
    exact (FTC.sensitivity_le_one (corruptContribution_nonneg M hM bad) _ _).trans
      (corruptionProxy_gt_one hnR).le
  · by_cases hif : i = first
    · subst i
      rw [proxy_first_formula M hM hn hM2 bad first j hfirst hj hbad hbj]
      exact (FTC.sensitivity_le_one (corruptContribution_nonneg M hM bad) _ _).trans
        (by linarith [singletonProxy_gt_two hnR])
    · have hterm := cluster_term_le_proxy M hM bad first i (referenceQuery j)
      rw [card_cluster_other first i hif] at hterm
      exact (corrupt_good_sensitivity_le M hM (by omega) bad i hib).trans
        ((genuineBound_le_cluster_term hnR).trans hterm)

end FTC.Counterexample

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss.source:
noncomputable def pointLoss {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (x : Vertex n) (S : Query n) : ℝ := by
  letI : MetricSpace (Vertex n) := metricSpace M hM
  exact FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss x S

/-- A query consists of exactly two distinct vertices. -/

FTC.Counterexample.pairQuery.source:
def pairQuery {n : ℕ} (x y : Vertex n) (hxy : x ≠ y) : Query n where
  centers := {x, y}
  card_eq := by simp [hxy]
  nonempty := by simp

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_eq_inf.source:
@[simp] theorem pointLoss_eq_inf {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (x : Vertex n) (S : Query n) :
    pointLoss M hM x S = S.centers.inf' S.nonempty (fun y => graphDist M x y ^ 2) := rfl

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_nonneg.source:
theorem pointLoss_nonneg {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (x : Vertex n) (S : Query n) : 0 ≤ pointLoss M hM x S := by
  rw [pointLoss_eq_inf]
  apply Finset.le_inf'
  intro y _
  exact sq_nonneg _

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_pair.source:
@[simp] theorem pointLoss_pair {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (z x y : Vertex n) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    pointLoss M hM z (pairQuery x y hxy) =
      min (graphDist M z x ^ 2) (graphDist M z y ^ 2) := by
  rw [pointLoss_eq_inf]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_min
    · exact Finset.inf'_le _ (by simp [pairQuery])
    · exact Finset.inf'_le _ (by simp [pairQuery])
  · apply Finset.le_inf'
    intro v hv
    simp only [pairQuery, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
    · exact min_le_left _ _
    · exact min_le_right _ _

/-- The clean coreset is the whole input, with one separately indexed unit
entry at each original point. -/

FTC.Counterexample.cleanEntries.source:
def cleanEntries {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : FTC.Entry (Vertex n) where
  point := p i
  weight := 1
  weight_nonneg := by norm_num

/-- Move just the entry with index `bad` to `b`; keep its unit weight. -/

FTC.Counterexample.corruptedEntries.source:
def corruptedEntries {n : ℕ} (bad i : Fin n) : FTC.Entry (Vertex n) where
  point := if i = bad then b else p i
  weight := 1
  weight_nonneg := by norm_num

FTC.Counterexample.cleanContribution.source:
noncomputable def cleanContribution {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (i : Fin n) (S : Query n) : ℝ :=
  FTC.contribution (pointLoss M hM) cleanEntries i S

FTC.Counterexample.corruptContribution.source:
noncomputable def corruptContribution {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad i : Fin n) (S : Query n) : ℝ :=
  FTC.contribution (pointLoss M hM) (corruptedEntries bad) i S

FTC.Counterexample.cleanContribution_app.source:
@[simp] theorem cleanContribution_apply {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (i : Fin n) (S : Query n) : cleanContribution M hM i S = pointLoss M hM (p i) S := by
  simp [cleanContribution, FTC.contribution, cleanEntries]

FTC.Counterexample.corruptContribution_a.source:
@[simp] theorem corruptContribution_apply {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad i : Fin n) (S : Query n) :
    corruptContribution M hM bad i S =
      if i = bad then pointLoss M hM b S else pointLoss M hM (p i) S := by
  by_cases hi : i = bad <;> simp [corruptContribution, FTC.contribution, corruptedEntries, hi]

FTC.Counterexample.cleanCost.source:
noncomputable def cleanCost {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (S : Query n) : ℝ :=
  FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) Finset.univ S

FTC.Counterexample.corruptCost.source:
noncomputable def corruptCost {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad : Fin n) (S : Query n) : ℝ :=
  FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) Finset.univ S

FTC.Counterexample.cleanContribution_non.source:
theorem cleanContribution_nonneg {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (i : Fin n) (S : Query n) : 0 ≤ cleanContribution M hM i S := by
  simp only [cleanContribution_apply]
  exact pointLoss_nonneg M hM _ _

FTC.Counterexample.corruptContribution_n.source:
theorem corruptContribution_nonneg {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad i : Fin n) (S : Query n) : 0 ≤ corruptContribution M hM bad i S := by
  simp only [corruptContribution_apply]
  split_ifs <;> exact pointLoss_nonneg M hM _ _

end FTC.Counterexample

FTC.Counterexample.clean_entry_bound.source:
theorem clean_entry_bound {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) (S : Query n) :
    cleanContribution M hM i S ≤ (1 / ((n : ℝ) - 2)) * cleanCost M hM S := by
  have hnR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hd : 0 < (n : ℝ) - 2 := by linarith
  have h := clean_uniform_bound M hM (by omega) i S
  calc
    cleanContribution M hM i S ≤ cleanCost M hM S / ((n : ℝ) - 2) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hd).2 (by nlinarith [h])
    _ = (1 / ((n : ℝ) - 2)) * cleanCost M hM S := by ring

FTC.Counterexample.clean_sensitivity_le.source:
theorem clean_sensitivity_le {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    FTC.sensitivity (cleanContribution M hM) Finset.univ i ≤ 1 / ((n : ℝ) - 2) := by
  have hnR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  apply FTC.sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le (cleanContribution_nonneg M hM)
    (Finset.mem_univ i) (div_nonneg (by norm_num) (by linarith))
  exact clean_entry_bound M hM hn i

FTC.Counterexample.corrupt_good_entry_bo.source:
theorem corrupt_good_entry_bound {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (bad i : Fin n) (hib : i ≠ bad) (S : Query n) :
    corruptContribution M hM bad i S ≤
      (1 / ((n : ℝ) - 3)) * corruptCost M hM bad S := by
  have hnR : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hd : 0 < (n : ℝ) - 3 := by linarith
  have h := corrupt_uniform_good_bound M hM (by omega) bad i hib S
  calc
    corruptContribution M hM bad i S ≤ corruptCost M hM bad S / ((n : ℝ) - 3) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hd).2 (by nlinarith [h])
    _ = (1 / ((n : ℝ) - 3)) * corruptCost M hM bad S := by ring

FTC.Counterexample.corrupt_good_sensitiv.source:
theorem corrupt_good_sensitivity_le {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (bad i : Fin n) (hib : i ≠ bad) :
    FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M hM bad) Finset.univ i ≤
      1 / ((n : ℝ) - 3) := by
  have hnR : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  apply FTC.sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le (corruptContribution_nonneg M hM bad)
    (Finset.mem_univ i) (div_nonneg (by norm_num) (by linarith))
  exact corrupt_good_entry_bound M hM hn bad i hib

/-- Removing the corruption yields an ε-coreset: only the one original clean
copy at its former location is missing. -/

FTC.Counterexample.exact_deletion_isCore.source:
theorem exact_deletion_isCoreset {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (bad : Fin n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hsmall : 1 / ((n : ℝ) - 2) ≤ ε) :
    FTC.IsCoreset ε (cleanCost M hM)
      (FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) (Finset.univ.erase bad)) := by
  intro S
  have heq := cost_good_eq_clean M hM bad (Finset.univ.erase bad) (by simp) S
  rw [heq]
  have hc : 0 ≤ cleanCost M hM S := FTC.cost_nonneg (cleanContribution_nonneg M hM) _ _
  have hci : 0 ≤ cleanContribution M hM bad S := cleanContribution_nonneg M hM bad S
  have hentry := clean_entry_bound M hM hn bad S
  have hbudget := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hc
  have herase := FTC.cost_erase_add (cleanContribution M hM) (Finset.mem_univ bad) S
  change FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) (Finset.univ.erase bad) S +
    cleanContribution M hM bad S = cleanCost M hM S at herase
  constructor <;> nlinarith

end FTC.Counterexample

FTC.Counterexample.exists_two_other_indi.source:
theorem exists_two_other_indices {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ j l : Fin n, j ≠ l ∧ i ≠ j ∧ i ≠ l := by
  have hc := Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hG : 1 < ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase i).card := by
    simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hc
    omega
  obtain ⟨j, l, hj, hl, hjl⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card_iff.mp hG
  exact ⟨j, l, hjl, Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1,
    Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).1⟩

/-- Every clean entry has exactly the sensitivity asserted in Appendix A.1. -/

FTC.Counterexample.clean_sensitivity_eq.source:
theorem clean_sensitivity_eq {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    FTC.sensitivity (cleanContribution M hM) Finset.univ i = 1 / ((n : ℝ) - 2) := by
  apply le_antisymm (clean_sensitivity_le M hM hn i)
  obtain ⟨j, l, hjl, hij, hil⟩ := exists_two_other_indices hn i
  have h := FTC.contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost (cleanContribution_nonneg M hM)
    (Finset.mem_univ i) (simplexQuery j l hjl)
  have hci : cleanContribution M hM i (simplexQuery j l hjl) = 1 := by
    rw [cleanContribution_apply, pointLoss_simplex, if_neg hij, if_neg hil]
  change _ ≤ _ * cleanCost M hM (simplexQuery j l hjl) at h
  rw [hci, cleanCost_simplex] at h
  have hnR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < (n : ℝ) - 2)).2
  simpa [mul_comm] using h

FTC.Counterexample.corruption_sensitivit.source:
theorem corruption_sensitivity_lower {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (bad j l : Fin n) (hjl : j ≠ l) (hbj : bad ≠ j) (hbl : bad ≠ l) :
    M ^ 2 / ((n : ℝ) - 3 + M ^ 2) ≤
      FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M hM bad) Finset.univ bad := by
  have h := FTC.contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost (corruptContribution_nonneg M hM bad)
    (Finset.mem_univ bad) (simplexQuery j l hjl)
  change _ ≤ _ * corruptCost M hM bad (simplexQuery j l hjl) at h
  simp only [corruptContribution_apply, if_pos rfl, pointLoss_b_simplex] at h
  rw [corruptCost_simplex M hM bad j l hjl hbj hbl] at h
  have hnR : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg M] : 0 < (n : ℝ) - 3 + M ^ 2)).2
  simpa [mul_comm] using h

/-- Exact sensitivity strictly prefers the corruption to every genuine entry. -/

FTC.Counterexample.corruption_strict_sen.source:
theorem corruption_strict_sensitivity_max {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hn : 8 ≤ n) (hM2 : M ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) - 4)
    (bad j l : Fin n) (hjl : j ≠ l) (hbj : bad ≠ j) (hbl : bad ≠ l)
    (i : Fin n) (hib : i ≠ bad) :
    FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M hM bad) Finset.univ i <
      FTC.sensitivity (corruptContribution M hM bad) Finset.univ bad := by
  have hnR : (8 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hlo := corruption_sensitivity_lower M hM (by omega) bad j l hjl hbj hbl
  have hden : (n : ℝ) - 3 + M ^ 2 = 2 * (n : ℝ) - 7 := by rw [hM2]; ring
  rw [hden, hM2] at hlo
  exact (corrupt_good_sensitivity_le M hM (by omega) bad i hib).trans_lt
    ((FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.genuineBound_lt_corruptionWitness hnR).trans_le hlo)

end FTC.Counterexample

FTC.Counterexample.referenceQuery.source:
def referenceQuery {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) : Query n :=
  pairQuery a (p j) (by simp)

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_simplex.source:
@[simp] theorem pointLoss_simplex {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (i j l : Fin n) (hjl : j ≠ l) :
    pointLoss M hM (p i) (simplexQuery j l hjl) =
      if i = j then 0 else if i = l then 0 else 1 := by
  rw [simplexQuery, pointLoss_pair]
  by_cases hij : i = j <;> by_cases hil : i = l <;>
    norm_num [graphDist, unitDistance, hij, hil, hjl, Ne.symm hjl]

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_b_simplex.source:
@[simp] theorem pointLoss_b_simplex {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (j l : Fin n) (hjl : j ≠ l) :
    pointLoss M hM b (simplexQuery j l hjl) = M ^ 2 := by
  rw [simplexQuery, pointLoss_pair]
  simp only [graphDist_b_p, min_self]

/-- The singleton's reference-query loss is exactly `1/4`. -/

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_first_refer.source:
theorem pointLoss_first_reference {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (first j : Fin n) (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) :
    pointLoss M hM (p first) (referenceQuery j) = 1 / 4 := by
  have hfj : first ≠ j := by
    intro h
    exact hj (h ▸ hfirst)
  rw [referenceQuery, pointLoss_pair]
  norm_num [graphDist, firstDistance, unitDistance, hfirst, hfj]

/-- The other genuine noncenter points have unit reference-query loss. -/

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_other_refer.source:
theorem pointLoss_other_reference {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (i j : Fin n) (hi : i.val ≠ 0) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pointLoss M hM (p i) (referenceQuery j) = 1 := by
  rw [referenceQuery, pointLoss_pair]
  norm_num [graphDist, firstDistance, unitDistance, hi, hij]

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_center_refe.source:
@[simp] theorem pointLoss_center_reference {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (j : Fin n) : pointLoss M hM (p j) (referenceQuery j) = 0 := by
  rw [referenceQuery, pointLoss_pair]
  rw [graphDist_self]
  simp only [zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
  exact min_eq_right (sq_nonneg _)

/-- The corruption is assigned to `p_j` and contributes `M²`. -/

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_b_reference.source:
@[simp] theorem pointLoss_b_reference {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (j : Fin n) : pointLoss M hM b (referenceQuery j) = M ^ 2 := by
  rw [referenceQuery, pointLoss_pair]
  change min ((M + 1 / 2) ^ 2) (M ^ 2) = M ^ 2
  apply min_eq_right
  nlinarith

FTC.Counterexample.pointLoss_reference_l.source:
theorem pointLoss_reference_le_one {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (i j : Fin n) : pointLoss M hM (p i) (referenceQuery j) ≤ 1 := by
  rw [referenceQuery, pointLoss_pair]
  calc
    min _ _ ≤ graphDist M (p i) (p j) ^ 2 := min_le_right _ _
    _ ≤ 1 := by
      by_cases hij : i = j <;> norm_num [graphDist, unitDistance, hij]

/-- Exact strict nearest-center assignment for the singleton. -/

FTC.Counterexample.reference_first_neare.source:
theorem reference_first_nearest {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (first j : Fin n)
    (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) :
    graphDist M (p first) a < graphDist M (p first) (p j) := by
  have hfj : first ≠ j := by
    intro h
    exact hj (h ▸ hfirst)
  norm_num [graphDist, firstDistance, unitDistance, hfirst, hfj]

/-- Every other original point is strictly closer to `p_j` than to `a`. -/

FTC.Counterexample.reference_other_neare.source:
theorem reference_other_nearest {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (i j : Fin n)
    (hi : i.val ≠ 0) : graphDist M (p i) (p j) < graphDist M (p i) a := by
  have hle := unitDistance_le_one i j
  change unitDistance i j < firstDistance i
  rw [firstDistance, if_neg hi]
  linarith

/-- The corruption is strictly closer to `p_j` than to `a`. -/

FTC.Counterexample.reference_b_nearest.source:
theorem reference_b_nearest {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    graphDist M b (p j) < graphDist (n := n) M b a := by
  change M < M + 1 / 2
  linarith

/-- A finite sum with two exceptional indices and a common value elsewhere. -/

FTC.Counterexample.sum_two_specials.source:
theorem sum_two_specials {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℝ) (x y : Fin n)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (L : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, i ≠ x → i ≠ y → f i = L) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, f i) = ((n : ℝ) - 2) * L + f x + f y := by
  let R : Finset (Fin n) := (Finset.univ.erase x).erase y
  have hy : y ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase x := by
    simp [Ne.symm hxy]
  have hcx := Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_univ x)
  have hcy := Finset.card_erase_add_one hy
  have hcN : (R.card + 1) + 1 = n := by
    calc
      _ = (Finset.univ.erase x).card + 1 := congrArg (fun t : ℕ => t + 1) hcy
      _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).card := hcx
      _ = n := by simp
  have hcR' : ((R.card : ℝ) + 1) + 1 = (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcN
  have hcR : (R.card : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - 2 := by linarith
  have hRsum : (∑ i ∈ R, f i) = (R.card : ℝ) * L := by
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ R, f i) = ∑ _i ∈ R, L := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        exact hf i (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).2).1
          (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1
      _ = (R.card : ℝ) * L := by simp
  have hsx := Finset.sum_erase_add (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) f (Finset.mem_univ x)
  have hsy := Finset.sum_erase_add (Finset.univ.erase x) f hy
  change (∑ i ∈ R, f i) + f y = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase x, f i at hsy
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin n, f i) = (∑ i ∈ R, f i) + f y + f x := by linarith
    _ = ((n : ℝ) - 2) * L + f x + f y := by rw [hRsum, hcR]; ring

FTC.Counterexample.cleanCost_simplex.source:
@[simp] theorem cleanCost_simplex {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (j l : Fin n) (hjl : j ≠ l) :
    cleanCost M hM (simplexQuery j l hjl) = (n : ℝ) - 2 := by
  have hs := sum_two_specials
    (fun i => pointLoss M hM (p i) (simplexQuery j l hjl)) j l hjl 1
    (fun i hij hil => by rw [pointLoss_simplex, if_neg hij, if_neg hil])
  simp only [cleanCost, FTC.cost, cleanContribution_apply]
  simpa only [pointLoss_simplex, if_pos rfl, if_neg (Ne.symm hjl), ite_true,
    mul_one, add_zero] using hs

/-- Replacing one unit-weight entry changes every query cost by subtracting
its original loss and adding its new loss. -/

FTC.Counterexample.corruptCost_eq_cleanC.source:
theorem corruptCost_eq_cleanCost_sub_add {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad : Fin n) (S : Query n) :
    corruptCost M hM bad S = cleanCost M hM S -
      pointLoss M hM (p bad) S + pointLoss M hM b S := by
  have hc := FTC.cost_erase_add (cleanContribution M hM)
    (Q := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) (i := bad) (Finset.mem_univ bad) S
  have hb := FTC.cost_erase_add (corruptContribution M hM bad)
    (Q := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) (i := bad) (Finset.mem_univ bad) S
  have he : FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) (Finset.univ.erase bad) S =
      FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) (Finset.univ.erase bad) S := by
    apply FTC.cost_congr
    intro i hi T
    simp only [corruptContribution_apply, if_neg (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1,
      cleanContribution_apply]
  change FTC.cost (cleanContribution M hM) (Finset.univ.erase bad) S +
    cleanContribution M hM bad S = cleanCost M hM S at hc
  change FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) (Finset.univ.erase bad) S +
    corruptContribution M hM bad bad S = corruptCost M hM bad S at hb
  simp only [corruptContribution_apply, ite_true] at hb
  simp only [cleanContribution_apply] at hc
  rw [he] at hb
  linarith

/-- The witness query has corrupted cost `n-3+M²`. -/

FTC.Counterexample.corruptCost_simplex.source:
theorem corruptCost_simplex {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad j l : Fin n) (hjl : j ≠ l) (hbj : bad ≠ j) (hbl : bad ≠ l) :
    corruptCost M hM bad (simplexQuery j l hjl) = (n : ℝ) - 3 + M ^ 2 := by
  rw [corruptCost_eq_cleanCost_sub_add, cleanCost_simplex, pointLoss_b_simplex,
    pointLoss_simplex, if_neg hbj, if_neg hbl]
  ring

/-- Filtering out the genuine singleton leaves cost `n-4+M²` on the witness
query, since it also had unit loss there. -/

FTC.Counterexample.cost_erase_first_simp.source:
theorem cost_erase_first_simplex {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad first j l : Fin n) (hjl : j ≠ l)
    (hbj : bad ≠ j) (hbl : bad ≠ l) (hfb : first ≠ bad)
    (hfj : first ≠ j) (hfl : first ≠ l) :
    FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) (Finset.univ.erase first)
      (simplexQuery j l hjl) = (n : ℝ) - 4 + M ^ 2 := by
  have he := FTC.cost_erase_add (corruptContribution M hM bad)
    (Q := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) (i := first) (Finset.mem_univ first)
    (simplexQuery j l hjl)
  have hf : corruptContribution M hM bad first (simplexQuery j l hjl) = 1 := by
    simp only [corruptContribution_apply, if_neg hfb, pointLoss_simplex,
      if_neg hfj, if_neg hfl]
  change FTC.cost (corruptContribution M hM bad) (Finset.univ.erase first)
      (simplexQuery j l hjl) + corruptContribution M hM bad first (simplexQuery j l hjl) =
    corruptCost M hM bad (simplexQuery j l hjl) at he
  rw [hf, corruptCost_simplex M hM bad j l hjl hbj hbl] at he
  linarith

FTC.Counterexample.cleanCost_reference.source:
theorem cleanCost_reference {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (first j : Fin n) (hfirst : first.val = 0) (hj : j.val ≠ 0) :
    cleanCost M hM (referenceQuery j) = (n : ℝ) - 2 + 1 / 4 := by
  have hfj : first ≠ j := by intro h; exact hj (h ▸ hfirst)
  have hs := sum_two_specials (fun i => pointLoss M hM (p i) (referenceQuery j))
    first j hfj 1 (by
      intro i hif hij
      have hi : i.val ≠ 0 := by
        intro hi0
        apply hif
        apply Fin.ext
        exact hi0.trans hfirst.symm
      exact pointLoss_other_reference M hM i j hi hij)
  simp only [cleanCost, FTC.cost, cleanContribution_apply]
  simpa only [pointLoss_first_reference M hM first j hfirst hj,
    pointLoss_center_reference, mul_one, add_zero] using hs

/-- The reference clustering has exactly the cost stated in Appendix A.1. -/

FTC.Counterexample.corruptCost_reference.source:
theorem corruptCost_reference {n : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (bad first j : Fin n) (hfirst : first.val = 0)
    (hj : j.val ≠ 0) (hbad : bad.val ≠ 0) (hbj : bad ≠ j) :
    corruptCost M hM bad (referenceQuery j) =
      (n : ℝ) - 3 + 1 / 4 + M ^ 2 := by
  rw [corruptCost_eq_cleanCost_sub_add, cleanCost_reference M hM first j hfirst hj,
    pointLoss_other_reference M hM bad j hbad hbj, pointLoss_b_reference]
  ring

end

end FTC.Counterexample

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.referenceCo.source:
def referenceCost (n : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 * n - 27 / 4

/-- Proxy score of the genuine singleton `p₁`. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.singletonPr.source:
def singletonProxy (n : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 + 1 / (2 * referenceCost n)

/-- Proxy score of the corruption `b`. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.corruptionP.source:
def corruptionProxy (n : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 / (n - 1) + 2 * (n - 4) / referenceCost n

/-- Upper bound on proxy scores of the other genuine entries. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.ordinaryPro.source:
def ordinaryProxy (n : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 / (n - 1) + 2 / referenceCost n

/-- The paper's uniform upper bound on genuine-entry sensitivities. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.genuineBoun.source:
def genuineBound (n : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 / (n - 3)

/-- The sensitivity ratio of `b` witnessed by `{p₂,p₃}`. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.corruptionW.source:
def corruptionWitness (n : ℝ) : ℝ := (n - 4) / (2 * n - 7)

/-- Distortion after the proxy rule removes `p₁` and retains `b`. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.referenceCo.source:
theorem referenceCost_pos {n : ℝ} (hn : 8 ≤ n) : 0 < referenceCost n := by
  unfold referenceCost
  linarith

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.singletonPr.source:
theorem singletonProxy_gt_two {n : ℝ} (hn : 8 ≤ n) : 2 < singletonProxy n := by
  have hd := referenceCost_pos hn
  have hp : 0 < 1 / (2 * referenceCost n) :=
    one_div_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  unfold singletonProxy
  linarith

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.corruptionP.source:
theorem corruptionProxy_gt_one {n : ℝ} (hn : 8 ≤ n) : 1 < corruptionProxy n := by
  have hd := referenceCost_pos hn
  have hn1 : 0 < n - 1 := by linarith
  unfold corruptionProxy
  rw [div_add_div _ _ (ne_of_gt hn1) (ne_of_gt hd)]
  apply (lt_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hn1 hd)).2
  unfold referenceCost
  nlinarith

theorem corruptionProxy_lt_two {n : ℝ} (hn : 8 ≤ n) : corruptionProxy n < 2 := by
  have hd := referenceCost_pos hn
  have hfirst : 2 / (n - 1) < 1 :=
    (div_lt_one (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)
  have hsecond : 2 * (n - 4) / referenceCost n < 1 := by
    apply (div_lt_one hd).2
    unfold referenceCost
    linarith
  unfold corruptionProxy
  linarith

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.ordinaryPro.source:
theorem ordinaryProxy_lt_two {n : ℝ} (hn : 8 ≤ n) : ordinaryProxy n < 2 := by
  have hd := referenceCost_pos hn
  have hfirst : 2 / (n - 1) < 1 :=
    (div_lt_one (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)
  have hsecond : 2 / referenceCost n < 1 := by
    apply (div_lt_one hd).2
    unfold referenceCost
    linarith
  unfold ordinaryProxy
  linarith

/-- The claimed genuine-sensitivity bound lies below the cluster-size term
of every nonsingleton proxy. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.genuineBoun.source:
theorem genuineBound_le_cluster_term {n : ℝ} (hn : 8 ≤ n) :
    genuineBound n ≤ 2 / (n - 1) := by
  unfold genuineBound
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < n - 3) (by linarith : 0 < n - 1)).2
  linarith

/-- The witnessed corruption sensitivity strictly exceeds the bound for all
of the genuine entries. -/

theorem genuineBound_lt_corruptionWitness {n : ℝ} (hn : 8 ≤ n) :
    genuineBound n < corruptionWitness n := by
  unfold genuineBound corruptionWitness
  apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < n - 3)
    (by linarith : 0 < 2 * n - 7)).2
  have hp := mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ n - 8) (by linarith : 0 ≤ n - 1)
  nlinarith

/-- Given the paper's lower bound `n-3` on optimum cost, its reference
clustering satisfies the asserted factor-two guarantee. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.reference_t.source:
theorem reference_two_approx {n opt : ℝ} (hopt : n - 3 ≤ opt) :
    referenceCost n ≤ 2 * opt := by
  unfold referenceCost
  linarith

/-- All strict scalar separations needed for the opposite proxy/exact choices. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.proxy_and_s.source:
theorem proxy_and_sensitivity_separations {n : ℝ} (hn : 8 ≤ n) :
    2 < singletonProxy n ∧
    1 < corruptionProxy n ∧ corruptionProxy n < 2 ∧
    ordinaryProxy n < 2 ∧ genuineBound n ≤ 2 / (n - 1) ∧
    genuineBound n < corruptionWitness n := by
  exact ⟨singletonProxy_gt_two hn, corruptionProxy_gt_one hn,
    corruptionProxy_lt_two hn, ordinaryProxy_lt_two hn,
    genuineBound_le_cluster_term hn, genuineBound_lt_corruptionWitness hn⟩

/-- The parameter regime of the PDF implies all the numerical size
conditions used above. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.size_ge_eig.source:
theorem size_ge_eight {ε n : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10)
    (hn : 8 / ε ≤ n) : 8 ≤ n := by
  have h : 8 ≤ 8 / ε := (le_div_iff₀ hε).2 (by linarith)
  exact h.trans hn

/-- Exact distortion and clean-deletion error estimates from Appendix A.1. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.distortion_.source:
theorem distortion_and_deletion_bounds {ε n : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hn : 8 / ε ≤ n) :
    2 - ε ≤ wrongDistortion n ∧ 1 + 6 * ε < 2 - ε ∧
    1 / (n - 2) ≤ ε := by
  have hn8 := size_ge_eight hε hεsmall hn
  have hn2 : 0 < n - 2 := by linarith
  have hbudget : 8 ≤ n * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).1 hn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold wrongDistortion
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hn2).2
    nlinarith
  · linarith
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hn2).2
    nlinarith

/-- The scalar distortion formula exceeds the upper coreset tolerance. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.wrongDistor.source:
theorem wrongDistortion_gt_tolerance {ε n : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hn : 8 / ε ≤ n) :
    1 + 6 * ε < wrongDistortion n := by
  obtain ⟨hlarge, hgap, _⟩ := distortion_and_deletion_bounds hε hεsmall hn
  exact hgap.trans_le hlarge

/-- An elementary selection consequence: if the scalar bounds for the
metric construction hold uniformly over its entries, the two score rules have
different strict maximizers. The metric hypotheses themselves are not proved
in this file. -/

FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic.opposite_st.source:
theorem opposite_strict_maximizers {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I]
    (Q : Finset I) (g b : I) (proxy exactScore : I → ℝ) {n : ℝ}
    (hn : 8 ≤ n) (hg : g ∈ Q) (hb : b ∈ Q) (hgb : g ≠ b)
    (hproxy : proxy g = singletonProxy n)
    (hotherProxy : ∀ i ∈ Q, i ≠ g → proxy i ≤ 2)
    (hexactBad : corruptionWitness n ≤ exactScore b)
    (hexactGood : ∀ i ∈ Q, i ≠ b → exactScore i ≤ genuineBound n) :
    (g ∈ Q ∧ ∀ i ∈ Q, i ≠ g → proxy i < proxy g) ∧
    (b ∈ Q ∧ ∀ i ∈ Q, i ≠ b → exactScore i < exactScore b) ∧ g ≠ b := by
  refine ⟨⟨hg, ?_⟩, ⟨hb, ?_⟩, hgb⟩
  · intro i hi hig
    rw [hproxy]
    exact (hotherProxy i hi hig).trans_lt (singletonProxy_gt_two hn)
  · intro i hi hib
    exact (hexactGood i hi hib).trans_lt
      ((genuineBound_lt_corruptionWitness hn).trans_le hexactBad)

end

end FTC.CounterexampleArithmetic

FTC.clean_core_bounds.source:
theorem clean_core_bounds {c d : I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ}
    {U B Q : Finset I} {f : ℕ} {ε δ : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε reference (cost c U))
    (hagrees : ∀ i ∈ U, i ∉ B → ∀ s, d i s = c i s)
    (hentry : ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, c i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hQ : Q ⊆ U) (hB : B.card ≤ f) (hlost : (U \ Q).card ≤ f)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * δ ≤ ε) :
    ∀ s, (1 - 3 * ε) * reference s ≤ cost d (Q \ B) s ∧
      cost d (Q \ B) s ≤ (1 + ε) * reference s := by
  intro s
  let A := Q \ B
  have hAU : A ⊆ U := (Finset.sdiff_subset : Q \ B ⊆ Q).trans hQ
  have heq : cost d A s = cost c A s := by
    apply cost_congr
    intro i hi t
    have hiQ := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).1
    exact hagrees i (hQ hiQ) (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).2 t
  have hcompl : U \ A ⊆ B ∪ (U \ Q) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨hiU, hiA⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi
    by_cases hiB : i ∈ B
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hiB
    · apply Finset.mem_union_right
      apply Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
      refine ⟨hiU, ?_⟩
      intro hiQ
      exact hiA (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hiQ, hiB⟩)
  have hcard : (U \ A).card ≤ 2 * f := by
    have h1 := Finset.card_le_card hcompl
    have h2 := Finset.card_union_le B (U \ Q)
    omega
  have hcardR : ((U \ A).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (f : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
  have hloss : cost c (U \ A) s ≤ 2 * ε * reference s := by
    calc
      cost c (U \ A) s ≤ ((U \ A).card : ℝ) * (δ * reference s) :=
        cost_le_card_mul (fun i hi => hentry i (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).1 s)
      _ ≤ (2 * (f : ℝ)) * (δ * reference s) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcardR (mul_nonneg hδ (hreference s))
      _ = 2 * ((f : ℝ) * δ) * reference s := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * ε * reference s :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbudget (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)) (hreference s)
  have hdecomp := cost_sdiff_add c hAU s
  have hmono := cost_mono hc hAU s
  have hco := hcoreset s
  change (1 - 3 * ε) * reference s ≤ cost d A s ∧
    cost d A s ≤ (1 + ε) * reference s
  rw [heq]
  constructor <;> linarith

/-- Main deterministic filtering theorem, with the actual iterative decoder.
It includes the empty-summary and zero-fault cases. -/

FTC.filtering_decoder_correct_with_rule.source:
theorem filtering_decoder_correct_with_rule {c d : I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ}
    {U B : Finset I} {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hd : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ d i s)
    (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε reference (cost c U))
    (hB : B.card ≤ f)
    (hagrees : ∀ i ∈ U, i ∉ B → ∀ s, d i s = c i s)
    (hentry : ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, c i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε)
    (oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle d α)
    (rule : SelectionRule I) (hmaximum : rule.IsMaxFor oracle.score) :
    IsCoreset (6 * ε) reference (cost d (selectionRun rule f U)) := by
  have hα0 : 0 ≤ α := by linarith
  have hf : 0 ≤ (f : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg f
  have hfd : (f : ℝ) * δ ≤ ε := by
    calc
      (f : ℝ) * δ = ((f : ℝ) * δ) * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ ((f : ℝ) * δ) * α :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hα (mul_nonneg hf hδ)
      _ = (f : ℝ) * α * δ := by ring
      _ ≤ ε := hbudget
  let R := selectionRun rule f U
  have hR : R ⊆ U := selectionRun_subset rule f U
  have hcleanR := clean_core_bounds hc hreference hcoreset hagrees hentry hR hB
    (selection_removed_card_le rule f U) hδ hfd
  have hlower : ∀ s, (1 - 6 * ε) * reference s ≤ cost d R s := by
    intro s
    have hmono := cost_mono hd (Finset.sdiff_subset : R \ B ⊆ R) s
    have hlow := (hcleanR s).1
    have hnonneg := hreference s
    nlinarith
  by_cases hbad : (R ∩ B).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, g, hg, hgB, hmax⟩ :=
      selection_good_stage_of_bad_remaining rule hmaximum U B f hB hbad
    let Q := selectionRun rule t U
    have hQ : Q ⊆ U := selectionRun_subset rule t U
    have hRQ : R ⊆ Q := selectionRun_antitone rule ht.le U
    have hcleanQ := clean_core_bounds hc hreference hcoreset hagrees hentry hQ hB
      ((selection_removed_card_le rule t U).trans ht.le) hδ hfd
    have hgood : sensitivity d Q g ≤ 2 * δ := by
      apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le hd hg (by positivity)
      intro s
      have hsmall : d g s ≤ δ * reference s := by
        rw [hagrees g (hQ hg) hgB s]
        exact hentry g (hQ hg) s
      have hmono := cost_mono hd (Finset.sdiff_subset : Q \ B ⊆ Q) s
      have hlow := (hcleanQ s).1
      have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * reference s ≤ cost d Q s := by
        have hcoef : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - 3 * ε := by linarith
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef (hreference s)
        linarith
      have hscale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf hδ
      nlinarith
    have hbadSensitivity : ∀ b ∈ Q, sensitivity d Q b ≤ α * (2 * δ) := by
      intro b hb
      calc
        sensitivity d Q b ≤ α * oracle.score Q b := oracle.lower Q b hb
        _ ≤ α * oracle.score Q g := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmax b hb) hα0
        _ ≤ α * sensitivity d Q g :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (oracle.upper Q g hg) hα0
        _ ≤ α * (2 * δ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgood hα0
    have hupperQ : ∀ s, cost d Q s ≤ (1 + 6 * ε) * reference s := by
      intro s
      have hcost0 := cost_nonneg hd Q s
      have hbadpart : cost d (Q ∩ B) s ≤ 2 * ε * cost d Q s := by
        have hcard : ((Q ∩ B).card : ℝ) ≤ (f : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.inter_subset_right : Q ∩ B ⊆ B)).trans hB
        calc
          cost d (Q ∩ B) s ≤ ((Q ∩ B).card : ℝ) * ((α * (2 * δ)) * cost d Q s) := by
            apply cost_le_card_mul
            intro b hb
            have hbQ := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).1
            exact (contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost hd hbQ s).trans
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hbadSensitivity b hbQ) hcost0)
          _ ≤ (f : ℝ) * ((α * (2 * δ)) * cost d Q s) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (by positivity)
          _ = (2 * ((f : ℝ) * α * δ)) * cost d Q s := by ring
          _ ≤ 2 * ε * cost d Q s :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbudget (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)) hcost0
      have hdecomp := cost_sdiff_add_inter d Q B s
      have hcleanupper := (hcleanQ s).2
      have htotal : (1 - 2 * ε) * cost d Q s ≤ (1 + ε) * reference s := by
        nlinarith
      have hcoef : 1 + ε ≤ (1 - 2 * ε) * (1 + 6 * ε) := by
        have : 0 ≤ ε * (1 - 4 * ε) := mul_nonneg hε (by linarith)
        nlinarith
      have hscale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef (hreference s)
      have hden : 0 < 1 - 2 * ε := by linarith
      have hscaled : (1 - 2 * ε) * cost d Q s ≤
          (1 - 2 * ε) * ((1 + 6 * ε) * reference s) := by
        calc
          (1 - 2 * ε) * cost d Q s ≤ (1 + ε) * reference s := htotal
          _ ≤ (1 - 2 * ε) * ((1 + 6 * ε) * reference s) := by nlinarith [hscale]
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hscaled hden
    intro s
    exact ⟨hlower s, (cost_mono hd hRQ s).trans (hupperQ s)⟩
  · have hbadEmpty : R ∩ B = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hbad
    intro s
    refine ⟨hlower s, ?_⟩
    have hdecomp := cost_sdiff_add_inter d R B s
    have hcleanupper := (hcleanR s).2
    have hzero : cost d (R ∩ B) s = 0 := by simp [hbadEmpty]
    have hnonneg := hreference s
    nlinarith


/-- The original real-score decoder is a specialization of the selection-rule theorem. -/

FTC.filtering_decoder_correct.source:
theorem filtering_decoder_correct {c d : I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ}
    {U B : Finset I} {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hd : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ d i s)
    (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε reference (cost c U))
    (hB : B.card ≤ f)
    (hagrees : ∀ i ∈ U, i ∉ B → ∀ s, d i s = c i s)
    (hentry : ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, c i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε)
    (oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle d α) :
    IsCoreset (6 * ε) reference (cost d (peel oracle.score f U)) := by
  rw [peel_eq_selectionRun]
  exact filtering_decoder_correct_with_rule hc hd hreference hε hεsmall hδ hα
    hcoreset hB hagrees hentry hbudget oracle (classicalSelectionRule oracle.score)
    (classicalSelectionRule_isMaxFor oracle.score)

/-- Entry-level form: the decoder only uses the corrupted summary and the
approximate-sensitivity oracle for that summary. -/

FTC.filtering_decoder_correct_of_corrupt.source:
theorem filtering_decoder_correct_of_corruption
    (loss : X → S → ℝ) (hloss : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ loss x s)
    (reference : S → ℝ) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (U : Finset I) (entries corrupted : I → Entry X) {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε reference (cost (contribution loss entries) U))
    (hcorrupt : IsFCorruption f U entries corrupted)
    (hentry : ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, contribution loss entries i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε)
    (oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle (contribution loss corrupted) α) :
    IsCoreset (6 * ε) reference
      (cost (contribution loss corrupted) (peel oracle.score f U)) := by
  obtain ⟨B, _, hB, hagrees⟩ := hcorrupt
  apply filtering_decoder_correct
    (contribution_nonneg loss entries hloss) (contribution_nonneg loss corrupted hloss)
    hreference hε hεsmall hδ hα hcoreset hB ?_ hentry hbudget oracle
  intro i hi hiB s
  simp only [contribution, hagrees i hi hiB]

end FTC

FTC.Executable.matrixDecode.source:
def matrixDecode (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S) (f : ℕ) (U : Finset I) : Finset I :=
  decode (fun Q i => rationalSensitivity c queries Q i) f U

FTC.Executable.matrixDecodeCounted_value.source:
theorem matrixDecodeCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    (f : ℕ) (U : Finset I) :
    (matrixDecodeCounted c queries f U).remaining = matrixDecode c queries f U :=
  runCounted_remaining _ _ _

/-- Full finite-rational specialization of Theorem 3.1's deterministic core.
Both the numerical sensitivities and the filtering loop are executable. -/

FTC.Executable.matrixDecode_correct.source:
theorem matrixDecode_correct {a c : I → S → ℚ} {reference : S → ℝ}
    {queries : Finset S} {U B : Finset I} {f : ℕ} {ε δ : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ a i s) (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    (hqueries : ∀ s : S, s ∈ queries) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε reference (cost (realContribution a) U))
    (hB : B.card ≤ f)
    (hagrees : ∀ i ∈ U, i ∉ B → ∀ s, c i s = a i s)
    (hentry : ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, realContribution a i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * δ ≤ ε) :
    IsCoreset (6 * ε) reference (cost (realContribution c) (matrixDecode c queries f U)) := by
  refine decode_correct (realContribution_nonneg ha) (realContribution_nonneg hc)
    hreference hε hεsmall hδ (α := 1) (by norm_num) hcoreset hB ?_ hentry ?_
    (fun Q i => rationalSensitivity c queries Q i) ?_ ?_
  · intro i hi hiB s
    simp only [realContribution, hagrees i hi hiB s]
  · simpa using hbudget
  · intro Q i _
    rw [rationalSensitivity_cast_eq hc hqueries]
    simp
  · intro Q i _
    rw [rationalSensitivity_cast_eq hc hqueries]

FTC.Executable.stepCounted_deletions_le_.source:
theorem stepCounted_deletions_le_one (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (stepCounted score Q).deletions ≤ 1 := by
  dsimp only [stepCounted]
  split <;> simp

FTC.Executable.stepCounted_deletions_of_.source:
theorem stepCounted_deletions_of_nonempty (score : Finset I → I → ℚ)
    {Q : Finset I} (hQ : Q.Nonempty) : (stepCounted score Q).deletions = 1 := by
  have hn := selectedPair_ne_none (score Q) hQ
  cases hp : selectedPair (score Q) Q with
  | none => exact False.elim (hn hp)
  | some p =>
    have hp' : (maximumCounted (evaluateScores (score Q) (Q.sort (· ≤ ·))).1).1 =
        some p := hp
    simp only [stepCounted, hp']

FTC.Executable.stepCounted_balance.source:
theorem stepCounted_balance (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (stepCounted score Q).remaining.card + (stepCounted score Q).deletions = Q.card := by
  by_cases hQ : Q.Nonempty
  · have hcard := card_selectionStep_add_one (rationalRule score) hQ
