    rw [← stepCounted_remaining] at hcard
    simpa [stepCounted_deletions_of_nonempty score hQ] using hcard
  · have hz : Q = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hQ
    subst Q
    simp [stepCounted, evaluateScores, maximumCounted]

FTC.Executable.runCounted_balance.source:
theorem runCounted_balance (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (f : ℕ) (U : Finset I) :
    (runCounted score f U).remaining.card + (runCounted score f U).deletions = U.card := by
  induction f generalizing U with
  | zero => simp [runCounted]
  | succ f ih =>
    by_cases hU : U.Nonempty
    · have hrest := ih (stepCounted score U).remaining
      have hfirst := stepCounted_balance score U
      simp only [runCounted, if_pos hU]
      omega
    · simp [runCounted, hU]

FTC.Executable.runCounted_deletions_le.source:
theorem runCounted_deletions_le (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (f : ℕ) (U : Finset I) :
    (runCounted score f U).deletions ≤ min f U.card := by
  have hsteps : (runCounted score f U).deletions ≤ f := by
    induction f generalizing U with
    | zero => simp [runCounted]
    | succ f ih =>
      by_cases hU : U.Nonempty
      · have hrest := ih (stepCounted score U).remaining
        have hfirst := stepCounted_deletions_le_one score U
        simp only [runCounted, if_pos hU]
        omega
      · simp [runCounted, hU]
  have hbalance := runCounted_balance score f U
  omega

/-- Each actual sensitivity call on an intermediate subset has this unit-cost
arithmetic upper bound, by the backend's instrumented implementation. -/

FTC.Executable.matrixOracle_work_le.source:
theorem matrixOracle_work_le (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    {Q U : Finset I} (hQU : Q ⊆ U) (i : I) :
    (rationalSensitivityCounted c queries Q i).2 ≤ queries.card * (2 * U.card + 3) := by
  rw [rationalSensitivityCounted_work]
  split_ifs
  · exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by have := Finset.card_le_card hQU; omega)
  · exact Nat.zero_le _

/-- Worst-case charge for the actual number of backend calls and cached-score
comparisons made by the counted loop. Every intermediate state is a subset of
`U`, so `matrixOracle_work_le` applies to every call. -/

FTC.Executable.chargedMatrixWork_bound.source:
theorem chargedMatrixWork_bound (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    (f : ℕ) (U : Finset I) :
    chargedMatrixWork c queries f U ≤
      f * (U.card * queries.card * (2 * U.card + 3) + (U.card - 1)) := by
  have hcalls := runCounted_scoreCalls_le (fun Q i => rationalSensitivity c queries Q i) f U
  have hcomparisons := runCounted_comparisons_le (fun Q i => rationalSensitivity c queries Q i) f U
  have hscaled := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (queries.card * (2 * U.card + 3)) hcalls
  unfold chargedMatrixWork matrixDecodeCounted
  calc
    _ ≤ (f * U.card) * (queries.card * (2 * U.card + 3)) + f * (U.card - 1) :=
      Nat.add_le_add hscaled hcomparisons
    _ = _ := by ring

end FTC.Executable

FTC.Executable.evaluateScores.source:
def evaluateScores (score : I → ℚ) : List I → List (I × ℚ) × ℕ
  | [] => ([], 0)
  | i :: is =>
      let tail := evaluateScores score is
      ((i, score i) :: tail.1, tail.2 + 1)

FTC.Executable.evaluateScores_values.source:
@[simp] theorem evaluateScores_values (score : I → ℚ) (is : List I) :
    (evaluateScores score is).1 = is.map (fun i => (i, score i)) := by
  induction is with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i is ih => simp [evaluateScores, ih]

FTC.Executable.evaluateScores_calls.source:
@[simp] theorem evaluateScores_calls (score : I → ℚ) (is : List I) :
    (evaluateScores score is).2 = is.length := by
  induction is with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i is ih => simp [evaluateScores, ih]

/-- A maximum scan on cached values, charging exactly one comparison whenever
the nonempty tail already has a candidate. Ties retain the first candidate. -/

FTC.Executable.maximumCounted.source:
def maximumCounted : List (I × ℚ) → Option (I × ℚ) × ℕ
  | [] => (none, 0)
  | x :: xs =>
      let tail := maximumCounted xs
      match tail.1 with
      | none => (some x, tail.2)
      | some y => (some (if x.2 < y.2 then y else x), tail.2 + 1)

FTC.Executable.maximumCounted_value.source:
@[simp] theorem maximumCounted_value (xs : List (I × ℚ)) :
    (maximumCounted xs).1 = xs.argmax Prod.snd := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.argmax_cons]
    simp only [maximumCounted]
    rw [← ih]
    cases h : (maximumCounted xs).1 with
    | none => simp [h]
    | some y =>
      by_cases hxy : x.2 < y.2 <;> simp [h, hxy]

FTC.Executable.maximumCounted_comparison.source:
@[simp] theorem maximumCounted_comparisons (xs : List (I × ℚ)) :
    (maximumCounted xs).2 = xs.length - 1 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases h : (maximumCounted xs).1 with
    | none =>
      have harg : xs.argmax (Prod.snd : I × ℚ → ℚ) = none := by
        rw [← maximumCounted_value]
        exact h
      have hnil : xs = [] := List.argmax_eq_none.mp harg
      subst xs
      rfl
    | some y =>
      have hne : xs ≠ [] := by intro hz; simp [hz, maximumCounted] at h
      have hlen : 0 < xs.length := by
        cases xs with
        | nil => exact False.elim (hne rfl)
        | cons a as => simp
      simp only [maximumCounted, h, List.length_cons]
      simp only [ih]
      omega

section OrderedIndices

variable [LinearOrder I]

/-- The cached maximum on a deterministic enumeration of a finite active set. -/

FTC.Executable.selectedPair.source:
def selectedPair (score : I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I) : Option (I × ℚ) :=
  (maximumCounted (evaluateScores score (Q.sort (· ≤ ·))).1).1

FTC.Executable.selectedPair_eq_argmax.source:
theorem selectedPair_eq_argmax (score : I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I) :
    selectedPair score Q =
      ((Q.sort (· ≤ ·)).map (fun i => (i, score i))).argmax Prod.snd := by
  simp [selectedPair]

FTC.Executable.selectedPair_ne_none.source:
theorem selectedPair_ne_none (score : I → ℚ) {Q : Finset I} (hQ : Q.Nonempty) :
    selectedPair score Q ≠ none := by
  intro h
  rw [selectedPair_eq_argmax] at h
  have hnil := List.argmax_eq_none.mp h
  have hlen := congrArg List.length hnil
  simp only [List.length_map, Finset.length_sort, List.length_nil] at hlen
  exact (Finset.card_pos.mpr hQ).ne' hlen

/-- The fallback is unreachable for a nonempty set, but makes the algorithm
total without classical extraction from an existence statement. -/

FTC.Executable.rationalChoice.source:
def rationalChoice (score : I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I) (hQ : Q.Nonempty) : I :=
  match selectedPair score Q with
  | none => Q.min' hQ
  | some p => p.1

FTC.Executable.rationalChoice_spec.source:
theorem rationalChoice_spec (score : I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I) (hQ : Q.Nonempty) :
    rationalChoice score Q hQ ∈ Q ∧
      ∀ i ∈ Q, score i ≤ score (rationalChoice score Q hQ) := by
  cases hp : selectedPair score Q with
  | none => exact False.elim (selectedPair_ne_none score hQ hp)
  | some p =>
    have hp' : p ∈ ((Q.sort (· ≤ ·)).map (fun i => (i, score i))).argmax Prod.snd := by
      rw [← selectedPair_eq_argmax, hp]
      simp
    have hmem := List.argmax_mem hp'
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
    constructor
    · simpa [rationalChoice, hp] using (Finset.mem_sort (· ≤ ·)).mp hj
    · intro i hi
      have hpair : (i, score i) ∈ (Q.sort (· ≤ ·)).map (fun i => (i, score i)) := by
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, (Finset.mem_sort (· ≤ ·)).mpr hi, rfl⟩
      have hle := List.le_of_mem_argmax hpair hp'
      simpa [rationalChoice, hp] using hle

FTC.Executable.rationalRule.source:
def rationalRule (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) : SelectionRule I where
  select Q h := rationalChoice (score Q) Q h
  select_mem Q h := (rationalChoice_spec (score Q) Q h).1

FTC.Executable.rationalRule_isMaxFor.source:
theorem rationalRule_isMaxFor (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) :
    (rationalRule score).IsMaxFor (fun Q i => (score Q i : ℝ)) := by
  intro Q h i hi
  change (score Q i : ℝ) ≤ (score Q (rationalChoice (score Q) Q h) : ℝ)
  exact_mod_cast (rationalChoice_spec (score Q) Q h).2 i hi

/-- Computable decoder, suitable in particular for `I = Fin m`. -/

FTC.Executable.decode.source:
def decode (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (f : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) : Finset I :=
  selectionRun (rationalRule score) f Q

FTC.Executable.WorkResult.source:
structure WorkResult (I : Type*) where
  remaining : Finset I
  scoreCalls : ℕ
  comparisons : ℕ
  deletions : ℕ

FTC.Executable.stepCounted_scoreCalls.source:
@[simp] theorem stepCounted_scoreCalls (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (stepCounted score Q).scoreCalls = Q.card := by
  dsimp only [stepCounted]
  split <;> simp

FTC.Executable.stepCounted_comparisons.source:
@[simp] theorem stepCounted_comparisons (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (stepCounted score Q).comparisons = Q.card - 1 := by
  dsimp only [stepCounted]
  split <;> simp

FTC.Executable.stepCounted_remaining.source:
theorem stepCounted_remaining (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (stepCounted score Q).remaining = selectionStep (rationalRule score) Q := by
  by_cases hQ : Q.Nonempty
  · have hn := selectedPair_ne_none (score Q) hQ
    cases hp : selectedPair (score Q) Q with
    | none => exact False.elim (hn hp)
    | some p =>
      have hp' : (maximumCounted (evaluateScores (score Q) (Q.sort (· ≤ ·))).1).1 =
          some p := hp
      simp only [stepCounted, hp']
      simp [selectionStep, hQ, rationalRule, rationalChoice, hp]
  · have hzero : Q = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hQ
    subst Q
    simp [stepCounted, evaluateScores, maximumCounted, selectionStep]

FTC.Executable.runCounted.source:
def runCounted (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) : ℕ → Finset I → WorkResult I
  | 0, Q => ⟨Q, 0, 0, 0⟩
  | n + 1, Q =>
      if Q.Nonempty then
        let first := stepCounted score Q
        let rest := runCounted score n first.remaining
        ⟨rest.remaining, first.scoreCalls + rest.scoreCalls,
          first.comparisons + rest.comparisons, first.deletions + rest.deletions⟩
      else ⟨Q, 0, 0, 0⟩

FTC.Executable.selectionRun_empty.source:
theorem selectionRun_empty (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) :
    selectionRun rule n ∅ = ∅ := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa [selectionRun, selectionStep] using ih

FTC.Executable.runCounted_remaining.source:
theorem runCounted_remaining (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (runCounted score n Q).remaining = decode score n Q := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hQ : Q.Nonempty
    · simp only [runCounted, if_pos hQ]
      rw [ih, stepCounted_remaining]
      rfl
    · have hzero : Q = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hQ
      subst Q
      simp [runCounted, decode, selectionRun_empty]

FTC.Executable.runCounted_scoreCalls_le.source:
theorem runCounted_scoreCalls_le (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (runCounted score n Q).scoreCalls ≤ n * Q.card := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [runCounted]
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hQ : Q.Nonempty
    · simp only [runCounted, if_pos hQ]
      have hrest := ih (stepCounted score Q).remaining
      have hsub : (stepCounted score Q).remaining ⊆ Q := by
        rw [stepCounted_remaining]
        exact selectionStep_subset _ _
      have hscale := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (Finset.card_le_card hsub)
      rw [stepCounted_scoreCalls]
      nlinarith
    · simp [runCounted, hQ]

FTC.Executable.runCounted_comparisons_le.source:
theorem runCounted_comparisons_le (score : Finset I → I → ℚ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (runCounted score n Q).comparisons ≤ n * (Q.card - 1) := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [runCounted]
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hQ : Q.Nonempty
    · simp only [runCounted, if_pos hQ]
      have hrest := ih (stepCounted score Q).remaining
      have hsub : (stepCounted score Q).remaining ⊆ Q := by
        rw [stepCounted_remaining]
        exact selectionStep_subset _ _
      have hscale := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n
        (Nat.sub_le_sub_right (Finset.card_le_card hsub) 1)
      rw [stepCounted_comparisons]
      nlinarith
    · simp [runCounted, hQ]

/-- The executable rational-score decoder inherits the full deterministic
filtering guarantee from the shared selector-parametric proof. -/

FTC.Executable.decode_correct.source:
theorem decode_correct {S : Type*} {c d : I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ}
    {U B : Finset I} {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hd : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ d i s)
    (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε reference (cost c U)) (hB : B.card ≤ f)
    (hagrees : ∀ i ∈ U, i ∉ B → ∀ s, d i s = c i s)
    (hentry : ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, c i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε)
    (score : Finset I → I → ℚ)
    (hlower : ∀ Q i, i ∈ Q → sensitivity d Q i ≤ α * (score Q i : ℝ))
    (hupper : ∀ Q i, i ∈ Q → (score Q i : ℝ) ≤ sensitivity d Q i) :
    IsCoreset (6 * ε) reference (cost d (decode score f U)) := by
  let oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle d α := ⟨fun Q i => (score Q i : ℝ), hlower, hupper⟩
  exact filtering_decoder_correct_with_rule hc hd hreference hε hεsmall hδ hα
    hcoreset hB hagrees hentry hbudget oracle (rationalRule score) (rationalRule_isMaxFor score)

end OrderedIndices
end FTC.Executable

FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCosts.source:
def cachedQueryCosts (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) : List (S × ℚ) :=
  candidates.map (fun s => (s, rationalCost c U s))

FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolver.source:
def exactFiniteSolver (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) : Option S :=
  ((cachedQueryCosts c U candidates).argmin Prod.snd).map Prod.fst

FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolver_none_if.source:
theorem exactFiniteSolver_none_iff (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    exactFiniteSolver c U candidates = none ↔ candidates = [] := by
  simp [exactFiniteSolver, cachedQueryCosts, List.argmin_eq_none]

FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolver_spec.source:
theorem exactFiniteSolver_spec {c : I → S → ℚ} {U : Finset I} {candidates : List S}
    {s : S} (hsolve : exactFiniteSolver c U candidates = some s) :
    s ∈ candidates ∧ ∀ t ∈ candidates, rationalCost c U s ≤ rationalCost c U t := by
  unfold exactFiniteSolver at hsolve
  cases hbest : (cachedQueryCosts c U candidates).argmin Prod.snd with
  | none => simp [hbest] at hsolve
  | some best =>
    have hmem : best ∈ cachedQueryCosts c U candidates := List.argmin_mem hbest
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
    have hts : t = s := by simpa [hbest] using hsolve
    subst s
    refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    exact List.le_of_mem_argmin (f := Prod.snd)
      (a := (q, rationalCost c U q)) (m := (t, rationalCost c U t))
      (l := cachedQueryCosts c U candidates)
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩) hbest

/-- Filtering candidates before the scan skips precisely the infeasible ones. -/

FTC.Executable.constrainedFiniteSolver_n.source:
theorem constrainedFiniteSolver_none_iff (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I)
    (candidates : List S) (admissible : S → Prop) [DecidablePred admissible] :
    constrainedFiniteSolver c U candidates admissible = none ↔
      ¬ ∃ s ∈ candidates, admissible s := by
  rw [constrainedFiniteSolver, exactFiniteSolver_none_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h ⟨s, hs, ha⟩
    have hm : s ∈ candidates.filter (fun s => decide (admissible s)) := by simp [hs, ha]
    rw [h] at hm
    exact List.not_mem_nil hm
  · intro h
    apply List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
    intro s hs
    have hm : s ∈ candidates ∧ admissible s := by simpa using hs
    exact h ⟨s, hm.1, hm.2⟩

FTC.Executable.constrainedFiniteSolver_s.source:
theorem constrainedFiniteSolver_spec {c : I → S → ℚ} {U : Finset I}
    {candidates : List S} {admissible : S → Prop} [DecidablePred admissible]
    {s : S} (hsolve : constrainedFiniteSolver c U candidates admissible = some s) :
    s ∈ candidates ∧ admissible s ∧
      ∀ t ∈ candidates, admissible t → rationalCost c U s ≤ rationalCost c U t := by
  obtain ⟨hmem, hopt⟩ := exactFiniteSolver_spec hsolve
  have hs : s ∈ candidates ∧ admissible s := by simpa using hmem
  refine ⟨hs.1, hs.2, ?_⟩
  intro t ht ha
  exact hopt t (by simp [ht, ha])

/-! ## Counters carried by the exhaustive scan -/

FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted.source:
def cachedQueryCostsCounted (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) :
    List S → List (S × ℚ) × ℕ
  | [] => ([], 0)
  | s :: candidates =>
    let value := rationalCostCounted c U s
    let rest := cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates
    ((s, value.1) :: rest.1, value.2 + rest.2)

FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted_v.source:
theorem cachedQueryCostsCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    (cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).1 = cachedQueryCosts c U candidates := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s candidates ih =>
    simp [cachedQueryCostsCounted, cachedQueryCosts, ih]

FTC.Executable.cachedQueryCostsCounted_w.source:
theorem cachedQueryCostsCounted_work (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    (cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).2 = 2 * U.card * candidates.length := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil => simp [cachedQueryCostsCounted]
  | cons s candidates ih =>
    simp only [cachedQueryCostsCounted, rationalCostCounted_work, ih, List.length_cons,
      Nat.mul_succ]
    omega

/-- A cached minimum scan, with one comparison at each nontrivial merge. -/

FTC.Executable.argminCounted.source:
def argminCounted : List (S × ℚ) → Option (S × ℚ) × ℕ
  | [] => (none, 0)
  | a :: candidates =>
    let rest := argminCounted candidates
    match rest.1 with
    | none => (some a, rest.2)
    | some b => (some (if b.2 < a.2 then b else a), rest.2 + 1)

FTC.Executable.argminCounted_value.source:
theorem argminCounted_value (candidates : List (S × ℚ)) :
    (argminCounted candidates).1 = candidates.argmin Prod.snd := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a candidates ih =>
    rw [List.argmin_cons]
    simp only [argminCounted, ← ih]
    cases h : (argminCounted candidates).1
    · rfl
    · simp only
      split_ifs <;> rfl

FTC.Executable.argminCounted_work_le.source:
theorem argminCounted_work_le (candidates : List (S × ℚ)) :
    (argminCounted candidates).2 ≤ candidates.length := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons a candidates ih =>
    simp only [argminCounted]
    cases h : (argminCounted candidates).1 <;> simp only [h]
    · exact ih.trans (Nat.le_succ _)
    · exact Nat.succ_le_succ ih

FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolverCounted.source:
def exactFiniteSolverCounted (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    Option S × ℕ :=
  let cache := cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates
  let optimum := argminCounted cache.1
  (optimum.1.map Prod.fst, cache.2 + optimum.2)

FTC.Executable.exactFiniteSolverCounted_.source:
theorem exactFiniteSolverCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    (exactFiniteSolverCounted c U candidates).1 = exactFiniteSolver c U candidates := by
  simp [exactFiniteSolverCounted, exactFiniteSolver, argminCounted_value,
    cachedQueryCostsCounted_value]

/-- One cost evaluation per candidate and at most one cached comparison per
candidate: exponential candidate enumeration is exposed, not hidden. -/

theorem exactFiniteSolverCounted_work_le (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (candidates : List S) :
    (exactFiniteSolverCounted c U candidates).2 ≤
      (2 * U.card + 1) * candidates.length := by
  have h := argminCounted_work_le (cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).1
  rw [cachedQueryCostsCounted_value] at h
  have hlen : (cachedQueryCosts c U candidates).length = candidates.length := by
    simp [cachedQueryCosts]
  rw [hlen] at h
  change (cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).2 +
      (argminCounted (cachedQueryCostsCounted c U candidates).1).2 ≤ _
  rw [cachedQueryCostsCounted_work, cachedQueryCostsCounted_value]
  simpa [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] using
    Nat.add_le_add_left h (2 * U.card * candidates.length)

FTC.Executable.constrainedFiniteSolverCo.source:
theorem constrainedFiniteSolverCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I)
    (candidates : List S) (admissible : S → Prop) [DecidablePred admissible] :
    (constrainedFiniteSolverCounted c U candidates admissible).1 =
      constrainedFiniteSolver c U candidates admissible :=
  exactFiniteSolverCounted_value _ _ _

theorem constrainedFiniteSolverCounted_work_le (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I)
    (candidates : List S) (admissible : S → Prop) [DecidablePred admissible] :
    (constrainedFiniteSolverCounted c U candidates admissible).2 ≤
      (2 * U.card + 1) * candidates.length := by
  exact (exactFiniteSolverCounted_work_le _ _ _).trans
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (List.length_filter_le _ _))

end FTC.Executable

FTC.Executable.RationalMetric.source:
structure RationalMetric (X : Type*) where
  distance : X → X → ℚ
  self : ∀ x, distance x x = 0
  comm : ∀ x y, distance x y = distance y x
  triangle : ∀ x y z, distance x z ≤ distance x y + distance y z
  eq_of_zero : ∀ x y, distance x y = 0 → x = y

FTC.Executable.RationalMetric.toMetricSp.source:
@[reducible] noncomputable def RationalMetric.toMetricSpace (d : RationalMetric X) : MetricSpace X where
  dist x y := (d.distance x y : ℝ)
  dist_self x := by simp [d.self]
  dist_comm x y := by rw [d.comm]
  dist_triangle x y z := by exact_mod_cast d.triangle x y z
  eq_of_dist_eq_zero := by
    intro x y h
    exact d.eq_of_zero x y (by exact_mod_cast h)

FTC.Executable.RationalEntry.source:
structure RationalEntry (X : Type*) where
  point : X
  weight : ℚ
  weight_nonneg : 0 ≤ weight

FTC.Executable.RationalEntry.toReal.source:
def RationalEntry.toReal (entry : RationalEntry X) : Entry X where
  point := entry.point
  weight := entry.weight
  weight_nonneg := by exact_mod_cast entry.weight_nonneg

FTC.Executable.rationalPointLoss.source:
def rationalPointLoss (d : RationalMetric X) (p : X) (C : Finset X) : ℚ :=
  if h : C.Nonempty then C.inf' h (fun x => d.distance p x ^ 2) else 0

FTC.Executable.rationalPointLoss_nonneg.source:
theorem rationalPointLoss_nonneg (d : RationalMetric X) (p : X) (C : Finset X) :
    0 ≤ rationalPointLoss d p C := by
  unfold rationalPointLoss
  split_ifs
  · exact Finset.le_inf' _ _ (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  · exact le_rfl

FTC.Executable.rationalKmeansLoss_nonneg.source:
theorem rationalKmeansLoss_nonneg (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X) :
    ∀ i C, 0 ≤ rationalKmeansLoss d entries i C :=
  fun i C => mul_nonneg (entries i).weight_nonneg (rationalPointLoss_nonneg d _ C)

/-- All k-center subsets, in a computable canonical order. -/

FTC.Executable.centerCandidateList.source:
def centerCandidateList (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) : List (Finset X) :=
  ((Y.sort).sublistsLen k).map List.toFinset

FTC.Executable.mem_centerCandidateList.source:
theorem mem_centerCandidateList {Y C : Finset X} :
    C ∈ centerCandidateList Y k ↔ C ⊆ Y ∧ C.card = k := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    obtain ⟨hsub, hlen⟩ := List.mem_sublistsLen.mp hl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      have hxl : x ∈ l := List.mem_toFinset.mp hx
      exact (Finset.mem_sort _).mp (hsub.subset hxl)
    · rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup ((Y.sort_nodup _).sublist hsub)]
      exact hlen
  · rintro ⟨hsub, hcard⟩
    apply List.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨C.sort, ?_, by simp⟩
    apply List.mem_sublistsLen.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, by simpa using hcard⟩
    apply List.sublist_of_subperm_of_pairwise
      (List.subperm_of_subset (C.sort_nodup _) ?_)
      (C.pairwise_sort _) (Y.pairwise_sort _)
    intro x hx
    exact (Finset.mem_sort _).mpr (hsub ((Finset.mem_sort _).mp hx))

FTC.Executable.centerCandidateList_lengt.source:
theorem centerCandidateList_length (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) :
    (centerCandidateList Y k).length = Nat.choose Y.card k := by
  simp [centerCandidateList, List.length_sublistsLen]

/-- At radius r all centers must be at squared distance at least r from p. -/

FTC.Executable.rationalAdmissible.source:
def rationalAdmissible (d : RationalMetric X) (p : X) (r : ℚ) (C : Finset X) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ C, r ≤ d.distance p x ^ 2

instance rationalAdmissibleDecidable (d : RationalMetric X) (p : X) (r : ℚ) :
    DecidablePred (rationalAdmissible d p r) := by
  intro C
  unfold rationalAdmissible
  infer_instance

/-- An actual exhaustive constrained weighted k-means solver. -/

FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeans.source:
def exactRationalKmeans (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) (p : X) (r : ℚ) : Option (Finset X) :=
  constrainedFiniteSolver (rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U
    (centerCandidateList Y k) (rationalAdmissible d p r)

FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeans_spec.source:
theorem exactRationalKmeans_spec (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (p : X) (r : ℚ) {C : Finset X}
    (h : exactRationalKmeans d entries U Y k p r = some C) :
    C ⊆ Y ∧ C.card = k ∧ rationalAdmissible d p r C ∧
      ∀ D ⊆ Y, D.card = k → rationalAdmissible d p r D →
        rationalCost (rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U C ≤
          rationalCost (rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U D := by
  obtain ⟨hmem, hadm, hopt⟩ := constrainedFiniteSolver_spec h
  obtain ⟨hsub, hcard⟩ := mem_centerCandidateList.mp hmem
  refine ⟨hsub, hcard, hadm, ?_⟩
  intro D hDY hDk hDa
  exact hopt D (mem_centerCandidateList.mpr ⟨hDY, hDk⟩) hDa

FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeans_none_.source:
theorem exactRationalKmeans_none_iff (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (p : X) (r : ℚ) :
    exactRationalKmeans d entries U Y k p r = none ↔
      ¬ ∃ C ⊆ Y, C.card = k ∧ rationalAdmissible d p r C := by
  rw [exactRationalKmeans, constrainedFiniteSolver_none_iff]
  simp only [mem_centerCandidateList, and_assoc, exists_prop]

FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeansCounte.source:
def exactRationalKmeansCounted (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) (p : X) (r : ℚ) : Option (Finset X) × ℕ :=
  constrainedFiniteSolverCounted (rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U
    (centerCandidateList Y k) (rationalAdmissible d p r)

theorem exactRationalKmeansCounted_value (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) (p : X) (r : ℚ) :
    (exactRationalKmeansCounted d entries U Y k p r).1 =
      exactRationalKmeans d entries U Y k p r :=
  constrainedFiniteSolverCounted_value _ _ _ _

/-- This counts rational-loss matrix accesses/additions and cached comparisons;
each matrix access here evaluates the point-to-center minimum. Thus this is
an explicit query/matrix-call bound, not a bit-complexity runtime assertion. -/

theorem exactRationalKmeansCounted_work_le (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (U : Finset I) (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) (p : X) (r : ℚ) :
    (exactRationalKmeansCounted d entries U Y k p r).2 ≤
      (2 * U.card + 1) * Nat.choose Y.card k := by
  simpa [exactRationalKmeansCounted, centerCandidateList_length] using
    constrainedFiniteSolverCounted_work_le (rationalKmeansLoss d entries) U
      (centerCandidateList Y k) (rationalAdmissible d p r)

/-! ## Exact interpretation as the real k-means sensitivity -/

instance centerSetDecidableEq : DecidableEq (CenterSet X k) := fun C D =>
  if h : C.centers = D.centers then
    isTrue (by cases C; cases D; cases h; rfl)
  else isFalse (fun hCD => h (congrArg CenterSet.centers hCD))

/-- Finite enumeration of the actual nonempty k-center query type. -/

FTC.Executable.centerQueries.source:
def centerQueries (Y : Finset X) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : Finset (CenterSet X k) :=
  (Y.powersetCard k).attach.image (fun C =>
    ⟨C.val, (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp C.property).2,
      Finset.card_pos.mp (by simpa [(Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp C.property).2] using hk)⟩)

FTC.Executable.centerQueries_complete.source:
theorem centerQueries_complete (hk : 0 < k) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    C ∈ centerQueries (Finset.univ : Finset X) k hk := by
  apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
  have hC : C.centers ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset X).powersetCard k :=
    Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, C.card_eq⟩
  refine ⟨⟨C.centers, hC⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
  cases C
  rfl

FTC.Executable.centerQueries_card_le.source:
theorem centerQueries_card_le (Y : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (centerQueries Y k hk).card ≤ Nat.choose Y.card k := by
  exact (Finset.card_image_le).trans_eq (by simp [Finset.card_powersetCard])

FTC.Executable.rationalCenterMatrix.source:
def rationalCenterMatrix (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (i : I) (C : CenterSet X k) : ℚ := rationalKmeansLoss d entries i C.centers

FTC.Executable.rationalPointLoss_cast.source:
theorem rationalPointLoss_cast (d : RationalMetric X) (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
    (rationalPointLoss d p C.centers : ℝ) = kmeansLoss p C := by
  letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
  unfold rationalPointLoss
  rw [dif_pos C.nonempty]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Finset.le_inf'
    intro x hx
    have hq : C.centers.inf' C.nonempty (fun x => d.distance p x ^ 2) ≤ d.distance p x ^ 2 :=
      Finset.inf'_le _ hx
    change ((C.centers.inf' C.nonempty (fun x => d.distance p x ^ 2) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
      (d.distance p x : ℝ) ^ 2
    exact_mod_cast hq
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hmin⟩ :=
      Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' C.nonempty (fun x => d.distance p x ^ 2)
    rw [hmin]
    have hreal : kmeansLoss p C ≤ (d.distance p x : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      kmeansLoss_le_dist_sq p C hx
    simpa only [Rat.cast_pow] using hreal

FTC.Executable.rationalCenterMatrix_cast.source:
theorem rationalCenterMatrix_cast (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (i : I) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
    realContribution (rationalCenterMatrix d entries) i C =
      weightedLoss (fun j => (entries j).toReal) i C := by
  letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
  change (((entries i).weight * rationalPointLoss d (entries i).point C.centers : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
  push_cast
  rw [rationalPointLoss_cast]
  rfl

/-- Executable exact rational sensitivity for genuine weighted k-means. -/

FTC.Executable.exactRationalKmeansSensit.source:
def exactRationalKmeansSensitivity (d : RationalMetric X) (entries : I → RationalEntry X)
    (hk : 0 < k) (U : Finset I) (i : I) : ℚ :=
  rationalSensitivity (rationalCenterMatrix d entries)
    (centerQueries Finset.univ k hk) U i

theorem exactRationalKmeansSensitivity_cast_eq (d : RationalMetric X)
    (entries : I → RationalEntry X) (hk : 0 < k) (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
    (exactRationalKmeansSensitivity d entries hk U i : ℝ) =
      sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) (fun j => (entries j).toReal)) U i := by
  letI : MetricSpace X := d.toMetricSpace
  have hmatrix : realContribution (rationalCenterMatrix (k := k) d entries) =
      weightedLoss (k := k) (fun j => (entries j).toReal) := by
    funext j C
    exact rationalCenterMatrix_cast d entries j C
  have hc : ∀ (j : I) (C : CenterSet X k), 0 ≤ rationalCenterMatrix d entries j C :=
    fun j C => rationalKmeansLoss_nonneg d entries j C.centers
  have heq := rationalSensitivity_cast_eq
    (c := rationalCenterMatrix (k := k) d entries)
    (queries := centerQueries (Finset.univ : Finset X) k hk)
    hc (centerQueries_complete hk) U i
  rw [hmatrix] at heq
  exact heq

theorem exactRationalKmeansSensitivity_work_le (d : RationalMetric X)
    (entries : I → RationalEntry X) (hk : 0 < k) (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (rationalSensitivityCounted (rationalCenterMatrix d entries)
      (centerQueries Finset.univ k hk) U i).2 ≤
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card X) k * (2 * U.card + 3) := by
  rw [rationalSensitivityCounted_work]
  split_ifs
  · exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by simpa using centerQueries_card_le (Finset.univ : Finset X) hk)
  · exact Nat.zero_le _

end FTC.Executable

FTC.Executable.rationalMax.source:
def rationalMax (queries : Finset S) (f : S → ℚ) : ℚ :=
  queries.fold max 0 f

FTC.Executable.rationalMax_empty.source: @[simp] theorem rationalMax_empty (f : S → ℚ) : rationalMax ∅ f = 0 := rfl

FTC.Executable.rationalMax_insert.source:
theorem rationalMax_insert {queries : Finset S} {s : S} (hs : s ∉ queries)
    (f : S → ℚ) : rationalMax (insert s queries) f = max (f s) (rationalMax queries f) := by
  exact Finset.fold_insert hs

FTC.Executable.rationalMax_nonneg.source:
theorem rationalMax_nonneg (queries : Finset S) (f : S → ℚ) :
    0 ≤ rationalMax queries f := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact le_rfl
  | @insert s queries hs ih =>
    rw [rationalMax_insert hs]
    exact ih.trans (le_max_right _ _)

FTC.Executable.le_rationalMax.source:
theorem le_rationalMax {queries : Finset S} {s : S} (hs : s ∈ queries) (f : S → ℚ) :
    f s ≤ rationalMax queries f := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp at hs
  | @insert t queries ht ih =>
    rw [rationalMax_insert ht]
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hs with rfl | hs
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact (ih hs).trans (le_max_right _ _)

FTC.Executable.rationalMax_le.source:
theorem rationalMax_le {queries : Finset S} {f : S → ℚ} {r : ℚ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (h : ∀ s ∈ queries, f s ≤ r) : rationalMax queries f ≤ r := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact hr
  | @insert s queries hs ih =>
    rw [rationalMax_insert hs]
    exact max_le (h s (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
      (ih (fun t ht => h t (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem ht)))

FTC.Executable.rationalMax_cast_le.source:
theorem rationalMax_cast_le {queries : Finset S} {f : S → ℚ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (h : ∀ s ∈ queries, (f s : ℝ) ≤ r) :
    (rationalMax queries f : ℝ) ≤ r := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using hr
  | @insert s queries hs ih =>
    rw [rationalMax_insert hs, Rat.cast_max]
    exact max_le (h s (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
      (ih (fun t ht => h t (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem ht)))

/-- Rational cost of the active individual entries. -/

FTC.Executable.realContribution.source: def realContribution (c : I → S → ℚ) (i : I) (s : S) : ℝ := c i s

FTC.Executable.realContribution_nonneg.source:
theorem realContribution_nonneg {c : I → S → ℚ} (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) :
    ∀ i s, 0 ≤ realContribution c i s := by
  intro i s
  change 0 ≤ (c i s : ℝ)
  exact_mod_cast hc i s

FTC.Executable.rationalCost_cast.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalCost_cast (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S) :
    (rationalCost c U s : ℝ) = cost (realContribution c) U s := by
  simp [rationalCost, cost, realContribution]

FTC.Executable.rationalCost_nonneg.source:
theorem rationalCost_nonneg {c : I → S → ℚ} (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    (U : Finset I) (s : S) : 0 ≤ rationalCost c U s :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hc i s)

/-- Rational zero-cost ratios are zero, agreeing with the real API. -/

FTC.Executable.rationalRatio.source:
def rationalRatio (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S) : ℚ :=
  c i s / rationalCost c U s

FTC.Executable.rationalRatio_cast.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalRatio_cast (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S) :
    (rationalRatio c U i s : ℝ) = realContribution c i s / cost (realContribution c) U s := by
  simp [rationalRatio, realContribution]

/-- Executable exact sensitivity of an active entry over a finite query matrix. -/

FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivity.source:
def rationalSensitivity (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S) (U : Finset I) (i : I) : ℚ :=
  if i ∈ U then rationalMax queries (rationalRatio c U i) else 0

FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivity_nonne.source:
theorem rationalSensitivity_nonneg (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    (U : Finset I) (i : I) : 0 ≤ rationalSensitivity c queries U i := by
  unfold rationalSensitivity
  split_ifs
  · exact rationalMax_nonneg _ _
  · exact le_rfl

/-- The computed rational score casts to exactly the real supremum. This is
an equality of mathematical meanings, not an implementation of real suprema. -/

FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivity_cast_.source:
theorem rationalSensitivity_cast_eq {c : I → S → ℚ} {queries : Finset S}
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hqueries : ∀ s : S, s ∈ queries)
    (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (rationalSensitivity c queries U i : ℝ) = sensitivity (realContribution c) U i := by
  have hcR := realContribution_nonneg hc
  by_cases hi : i ∈ U
  · unfold rationalSensitivity
    rw [if_pos hi]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply rationalMax_cast_le (sensitivity_nonneg hcR U i)
      intro s _
      rw [rationalRatio_cast, sensitivity, if_pos hi]
      exact le_csSup (sensitivityRatios_bddAbove hcR hi) (Or.inr ⟨s, rfl⟩)
    · apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le hcR hi
        (by exact_mod_cast rationalMax_nonneg queries (rationalRatio c U i))
      intro s
      have hratio := le_rationalMax (hqueries s) (rationalRatio c U i)
      have hratioR : realContribution c i s / cost (realContribution c) U s ≤
          (rationalMax queries (rationalRatio c U i) : ℝ) := by
        rw [← rationalRatio_cast]
        exact_mod_cast hratio
      by_cases hz : cost (realContribution c) U s = 0
      · have hci := cost_eq_zero_contribution hcR hi hz
        simp [hz, hci]
      · have hpos : 0 < cost (realContribution c) U s :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (cost_nonneg hcR U s) (Ne.symm hz)
        exact (div_le_iff₀ hpos).1 hratioR
  · simp [rationalSensitivity, hi, sensitivity_of_not_mem hi]

/-- A finite rational matrix gives the exact real oracle used by the filtering
theorem, while its score values are produced by executable rational code. -/

FTC.Executable.rationalExactOracle.source:
def rationalExactOracle (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hqueries : ∀ s : S, s ∈ queries) :
    ApproxSensitivityOracle (realContribution c) 1 where
  score U i := (rationalSensitivity c queries U i : ℝ)
  lower U i _ := by rw [rationalSensitivity_cast_eq hc hqueries]; simp
  upper U i _ := by rw [rationalSensitivity_cast_eq hc hqueries]

/-! ## An instrumented arithmetic implementation

One charge is made for each matrix lookup, rational addition, rational
division, and maximum comparison. Finite-container enumeration and the bit
complexity of rational arithmetic are outside this unit-cost model. Counters
are carried by the evaluation itself, rather than attached to its result
afterward.
-/

/-- The first component is the cost; each row requires one lookup and one
addition to the accumulating sum. -/

FTC.Executable.rationalCostCounted.source:
def rationalCostCounted (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S) : ℚ × ℕ :=
  ∑ i ∈ U, (c i s, 2)

FTC.Executable.rationalCostCounted_value.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalCostCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S) :
    (rationalCostCounted c U s).1 = rationalCost c U s := by
  induction U using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @insert i U hi ih =>
    change (∑ j ∈ insert i U, (c j s, 2)).1 = ∑ j ∈ insert i U, c j s
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi]
    change c i s + (rationalCostCounted c U s).1 = c i s + rationalCost c U s
    rw [ih]

FTC.Executable.rationalCostCounted_work.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalCostCounted_work (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (s : S) :
    (rationalCostCounted c U s).2 = 2 * U.card := by
  induction U using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @insert i U hi ih =>
    change (∑ j ∈ insert i U, (c j s, 2)).2 = 2 * (insert i U).card
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hi]
    change 2 + (rationalCostCounted c U s).2 = 2 * (U.card + 1)
    rw [ih]
    omega

/-- In addition to the denominator, a ratio evaluates one numerator lookup
and one division. The zero-denominator convention is executable. -/

FTC.Executable.rationalRatioCounted_valu.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalRatioCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S) :
    (rationalRatioCounted c U i s).1 = rationalRatio c U i s := by
  simp [rationalRatioCounted, rationalRatio]

FTC.Executable.rationalRatioCounted_work.source:
@[simp] theorem rationalRatioCounted_work (c : I → S → ℚ) (U : Finset I) (i : I) (s : S) :
    (rationalRatioCounted c U i s).2 = 2 * U.card + 2 := by
  simp [rationalRatioCounted]

/-- Combining two counted maxima executes one comparison. Associativity and
commutativity make the fold independent of finite-set representation. -/

FTC.Executable.maxWithWork.source:
def maxWithWork (a b : ℚ × ℕ) : ℚ × ℕ := (max a.1 b.1, a.2 + b.2 + 1)

instance : Std.Commutative maxWithWork where
  comm a b := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact max_comm _ _
    · simp [maxWithWork, Nat.add_comm]

instance : Std.Associative maxWithWork where
  assoc a b c := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact max_assoc _ _ _
    · simp [maxWithWork, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm]

FTC.Executable.countedMax_value.source:
theorem countedMax_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S) (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (queries.fold maxWithWork (0, 0) (rationalRatioCounted c U i)).1 =
      rationalMax queries (rationalRatio c U i) := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @insert s queries hs ih =>
    rw [Finset.fold_insert hs, rationalMax_insert hs]
    simp only [maxWithWork, rationalRatioCounted_value, ih]

FTC.Executable.countedMax_work.source:
theorem countedMax_work (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S) (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (queries.fold maxWithWork (0, 0) (rationalRatioCounted c U i)).2 =
      queries.card * (2 * U.card + 3) := by
  induction queries using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert s queries hs ih =>
    rw [Finset.fold_insert hs, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hs]
    simp only [maxWithWork, rationalRatioCounted_work, ih, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    omega

/-- The instrumented program computes exactly the uninstrumented score. -/

FTC.Executable.rationalSensitivityCounte.source:
theorem rationalSensitivityCounted_value (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (rationalSensitivityCounted c queries U i).1 = rationalSensitivity c queries U i := by
  unfold rationalSensitivityCounted rationalSensitivity
  split_ifs
  · exact countedMax_value c queries U i
  · rfl

/-- Exact unit-cost arithmetic count: one denominator scan and ratio/max step
per query; inactive indices are not evaluated. -/

theorem rationalSensitivityCounted_work (c : I → S → ℚ) (queries : Finset S)
    (U : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (rationalSensitivityCounted c queries U i).2 =
      if i ∈ U then queries.card * (2 * U.card + 3) else 0 := by
  unfold rationalSensitivityCounted
  split_ifs
  · exact countedMax_work c queries U i
  · rfl

end FTC.Executable

FTC.chosenMax.source:
noncomputable def chosenMax (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I)
    (h : Q.Nonempty) : I :=
  Classical.choose (Q.exists_max_image (score Q) h)

FTC.chosenMax_spec.source:
theorem chosenMax_spec (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I)
    (h : Q.Nonempty) :
    chosenMax score Q h ∈ Q ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q (chosenMax score Q h) :=
  Classical.choose_spec (Q.exists_max_image (score Q) h)

/-- The classical real maximizer as an explicit selection routine. -/

FTC.classicalSelectionRule.source:
noncomputable def classicalSelectionRule (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) : SelectionRule I where
  select := chosenMax score
  select_mem := fun Q h => (chosenMax_spec score Q h).1

FTC.classicalSelectionRule_isMaxFor.source:
theorem classicalSelectionRule_isMaxFor (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) :
    (classicalSelectionRule score).IsMaxFor score :=
  fun Q h => (chosenMax_spec score Q h).2

FTC.peelStep.source:
noncomputable def peelStep (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I) : Finset I :=
  if h : Q.Nonempty then Q.erase (chosenMax score Q h) else Q

FTC.peel.source:
noncomputable def peel (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) : ℕ → Finset I → Finset I
  | 0, Q => Q
  | n + 1, Q => peel score n (peelStep score Q)

FTC.peel_eq_selectionRun.source:
theorem peel_eq_selectionRun (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    peel score n Q = selectionRun (classicalSelectionRule score) n Q := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simpa [peel, selectionRun, peelStep, selectionStep, classicalSelectionRule] using
      (ih (peelStep score Q))

FTC.peelStep_removes.source:
theorem peelStep_removes (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {Q : Finset I}
    (h : Q.Nonempty) :
    ∃ g ∈ Q, peelStep score Q = Q.erase g ∧ ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q g := by
  refine ⟨chosenMax score Q h, (chosenMax_spec score Q h).1, ?_,
    (chosenMax_spec score Q h).2⟩
  simp [peelStep, h]

FTC.peelStep_subset.source:
theorem peelStep_subset (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I) :
    peelStep score Q ⊆ Q := by
  unfold peelStep
  split
  · exact Finset.erase_subset _ _
  · exact Finset.Subset.refl _

FTC.card_le_peelStep_add_one.source:
theorem card_le_peelStep_add_one (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (Q : Finset I) :
    Q.card ≤ (peelStep score Q).card + 1 := by
  by_cases h : Q.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep, _⟩ := peelStep_removes score h
    rw [hstep]
    have := Finset.card_erase_add_one hg
    omega
  · simp [peelStep, h]

FTC.card_peelStep_add_one.source:
theorem card_peelStep_add_one (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {Q : Finset I}
    (h : Q.Nonempty) : (peelStep score Q).card + 1 = Q.card := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep, _⟩ := peelStep_removes score h
  rw [hstep]
  exact Finset.card_erase_add_one hg

FTC.peel_subset.source:
theorem peel_subset (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    peel score n Q ⊆ Q := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => exact Finset.Subset.refl _
  | succ n ih => exact (ih _).trans (peelStep_subset score Q)

FTC.peel_add.source:
theorem peel_add (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n m : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    peel score (n + m) Q = peel score m (peel score n Q) := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [peel]
  | succ n ih => simpa [Nat.succ_add, peel] using ih (peelStep score Q)

FTC.peel_antitone.source:
theorem peel_antitone (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (Q : Finset I) : peel score m Q ⊆ peel score n Q := by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [peel_add]
  exact peel_subset score d _

FTC.card_le_peel_add.source:
theorem card_le_peel_add (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    Q.card ≤ (peel score n Q).card + n := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [peel]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := ih (peelStep score Q)
    have hstep := card_le_peelStep_add_one score Q
    change Q.card ≤ (peel score n (peelStep score Q)).card + (n + 1)
    omega

FTC.card_peel_add_of_nonempty.source:
theorem card_peel_add_of_nonempty (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (Q : Finset I) (h : (peel score n Q).Nonempty) :
    (peel score n Q).card + n = Q.card := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [peel]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hs : (peelStep score Q).Nonempty := h.mono (peel_subset score n _)
    have hq : Q.Nonempty := hs.mono (peelStep_subset score Q)
    have hcard := card_peelStep_add_one score hq
    have hind := ih (peelStep score Q) h
    change (peel score n (peelStep score Q)).card + (n + 1) = Q.card
    omega

FTC.removed_card_le.source:
theorem removed_card_le (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (Q \ peel score n Q).card ≤ n := by
  rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (peel_subset score n Q)]
  have := card_le_peel_add score n Q
  omega

FTC.removed_card_eq_of_nonempty.source:
theorem removed_card_eq_of_nonempty (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (Q : Finset I) (h : (peel score n Q).Nonempty) :
    (Q \ peel score n Q).card = n := by
  rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (peel_subset score n Q)]
  have := card_peel_add_of_nonempty score n Q h
  omega

/-- Every removed index was a maximum at an actual stage of the algorithm. -/

FTC.removed_has_stage.source:
theorem removed_has_stage (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) {n : ℕ} {Q : Finset I}
    {x : I} (hx : x ∈ Q) (hgone : x ∉ peel score n Q) :
    ∃ t < n, x ∈ peel score t Q ∧
      ∀ y ∈ peel score t Q, score (peel score t Q) y ≤ score (peel score t Q) x := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => exact False.elim (hgone hx)
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hs : x ∈ peelStep score Q
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt, hmax⟩ := ih hs hgone
      refine ⟨t + 1, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [peel] using hxt
      · simpa [peel] using hmax
    · obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep, hmax⟩ := peelStep_removes score ⟨x, hx⟩
      have heq : x = g := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hs (hstep.symm ▸ Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, hx⟩)
      subst x
      exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n, hg, hmax⟩

/-- If a bad index survives `f` deletions, a good maximum was deleted earlier. -/

FTC.good_stage_of_bad_remaining.source:
theorem good_stage_of_bad_remaining (score : Finset I → I → ℝ)
    (U B : Finset I) (f : ℕ) (hB : B.card ≤ f)
    (hbad : (peel score f U ∩ B).Nonempty) :
    ∃ t < f, ∃ g ∈ peel score t U, g ∉ B ∧
      ∀ y ∈ peel score t U, score (peel score t U) y ≤ score (peel score t U) g := by
  let R := peel score f U
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hbad
  have hbR : b ∈ R := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).1
  have hbB : b ∈ B := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).2
  have hcard : (U \ R).card = f := removed_card_eq_of_nonempty score f U ⟨b, hbR⟩
  have hex : ∃ g ∈ U \ R, g ∉ B := by
    by_contra h
    have hsub : insert b (U \ R) ⊆ B := by
      intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact hbB
      · by_contra hxB
        exact h ⟨x, hx, hxB⟩
    have hbnot : b ∉ U \ R := by simp [hbR]
    have hlarge := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hbnot, hcard] at hlarge
    omega
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgB⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨hgU, hgR⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hg
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hgt, hmax⟩ := removed_has_stage score hgU hgR
  exact ⟨t, ht, g, hgt, hgB, hmax⟩

end FTC

FTC.FiniteMetric.CenterSet.source:
structure CenterSet (X : Type*) (k : ℕ) where
  centers : Finset X
  card_eq : centers.card = k
  nonempty : centers.Nonempty

/-- Squared distance to the closest center. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss.source:
noncomputable def kmeansLoss (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k) : ℝ :=
  C.centers.inf' C.nonempty (fun x => dist p x ^ 2)

FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss_nonneg.source:
theorem kmeansLoss_nonneg (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k) : 0 ≤ kmeansLoss p C := by
  apply Finset.le_inf'
  intro x _
  exact sq_nonneg (dist p x)

FTC.FiniteMetric.kmeansLoss_le_dist_sq.source:
theorem kmeansLoss_le_dist_sq (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ C.centers) : kmeansLoss p C ≤ dist p x ^ 2 := by
  exact Finset.inf'_le _ hx

FTC.FiniteMetric.exists_closest_center.source:
theorem exists_closest_center (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    ∃ x ∈ C.centers, kmeansLoss p C = dist p x ^ 2 := by
  exact Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' C.nonempty (fun x => dist p x ^ 2)

/-- Every center must lie outside the open ball of squared radius `r`. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.Admissible.source:
def Admissible (p : X) (r : ℝ) (C : CenterSet X k) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ C.centers, r ≤ dist p x ^ 2

FTC.FiniteMetric.admissible_iff.source:
theorem admissible_iff (p : X) (r : ℝ) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    Admissible p r C ↔ r ≤ kmeansLoss p C := by
  exact (Finset.le_inf'_iff C.nonempty _).symm

/-- A trial is feasible when at least `k` admissible centers can be selected. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.FeasibleRadius.source:
def FeasibleRadius (p x : X) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : CenterSet X k, Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) C

/-- The finite admissible-center set; feasibility can be tested without an
optimization-oracle call by counting these centers. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.admissibleCenters.source:
noncomputable def admissibleCenters (p : X) (r : ℝ) : Finset X := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.univ : Finset X).filter (fun y => r ≤ dist p y ^ 2)

FTC.FiniteMetric.feasibleRadius_iff_card.source:
theorem feasibleRadius_iff_card (p x : X) :
    FeasibleRadius (k := k) p x ↔
      0 < k ∧ k ≤ (admissibleCenters p (dist p x ^ 2)).card := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, hC⟩
    constructor
    · simpa [C.card_eq] using C.nonempty.card_pos
    · have hsub : C.centers ⊆ admissibleCenters p (dist p x ^ 2) := by
        intro y hy
        simp only [admissibleCenters, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact hC y hy
      simpa [C.card_eq] using Finset.card_le_card hsub
  · rintro ⟨hk, hcard⟩
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hcard
    have hQnonempty : Q.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by simpa [hQcard] using hk)
    refine ⟨⟨Q, hQcard, hQnonempty⟩, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hmem := hQ hy
    simpa only [admissibleCenters, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hmem

/-- The specification of a constrained approximation oracle, restricted to the
at most `|X|` instances needed for one sensitivity estimate. The comparison
against every feasible solution is equivalent to comparison against the
optimum, and avoids choosing an optimal solution in the interface. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.ConstrainedOracle.source:
structure ConstrainedOracle (P : Finset X) (p : X) (ρ : ℝ) where
  solve : ∀ x : X, FeasibleRadius (k := k) p x → CenterSet X k
  admissible : ∀ x h, Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) (solve x h)
  approximation : ∀ x h (C : CenterSet X k), Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) C →
    cost kmeansLoss P (solve x h) ≤ ρ * cost kmeansLoss P C

variable {P : Finset X} {p : X} {ρ : ℝ}

/-- Score from one trial; infeasible radii contribute zero. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.trialScore.source:
noncomputable def trialScore (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ)
    (x : X) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if h : FeasibleRadius (k := k) p x then
    dist p x ^ 2 / cost kmeansLoss P (oracle.solve x h)
  else 0

/-- The largest of at most `|X|` trial scores. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate.source:
noncomputable def estimate (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) : ℝ :=
  (Finset.univ : Finset X).sup' ⟨p, Finset.mem_univ p⟩ (trialScore oracle)

FTC.FiniteMetric.trialScore_nonneg.source:
theorem trialScore_nonneg (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) (x : X) :
    0 ≤ trialScore oracle x := by
  unfold trialScore
  split_ifs
  · exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (cost_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg _ _)
  · exact le_rfl

FTC.FiniteMetric.trialScore_le_estimate.source:
theorem trialScore_le_estimate (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) (x : X) :
    trialScore oracle x ≤ estimate oracle := by
  exact Finset.le_sup' (trialScore oracle) (Finset.mem_univ x)

FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate_nonneg.source:
theorem estimate_nonneg (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) :
    0 ≤ estimate oracle :=
  (trialScore_nonneg oracle p).trans (trialScore_le_estimate oracle p)

/-- Every feasible trial provides a lower bound on exact sensitivity. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.trialScore_le_sensitivi.source:
theorem trialScore_le_sensitivity (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ)
    (hp : p ∈ P) (x : X) :
    trialScore oracle x ≤ sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p := by
  unfold trialScore
  split_ifs with h
  · let C := oracle.solve x h
    change dist p x ^ 2 / cost kmeansLoss P C ≤ sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p
    have hr : dist p x ^ 2 ≤ kmeansLoss p C :=
      (admissible_iff p _ C).1 (oracle.admissible x h)
    have hc : 0 ≤ cost kmeansLoss P C := cost_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg P C
    by_cases hz : cost kmeansLoss P C = 0
    · simpa [hz] using sensitivity_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg P p
    · have hcpos : 0 < cost kmeansLoss P C := lt_of_le_of_ne hc (Ne.symm hz)
      have hs := contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost kmeansLoss_nonneg hp C
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hcpos).2 (hr.trans hs)
  · exact sensitivity_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg P p

FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate_le_sensitivity.source:
theorem estimate_le_sensitivity (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ)
    (hp : p ∈ P) : estimate oracle ≤ sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p := by
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro x _
  exact trialScore_le_sensitivity oracle hp x

/-- For every query, the trial at its closest-center radius recovers at least
`1 / ρ` of that query's sensitivity ratio. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.contribution_le_estimat.source:
theorem contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost
    (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) (hp : p ∈ P) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (C : CenterSet X k) :
    kmeansLoss p C ≤ (ρ * estimate oracle) * cost kmeansLoss P C := by
  have he : 0 ≤ estimate oracle := estimate_nonneg oracle
  have hc : 0 ≤ cost kmeansLoss P C := cost_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg P C
  by_cases hz : kmeansLoss p C = 0
  · rw [hz]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hρ.le he) hc
  · have hlpos : 0 < kmeansLoss p C :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (kmeansLoss_nonneg p C) (Ne.symm hz)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hclosest⟩ := exists_closest_center p C
    have hCadm : Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) C := by
      rw [admissible_iff, ← hclosest]
    have hfeas : FeasibleRadius (k := k) p x := ⟨C, hCadm⟩
    let D := oracle.solve x hfeas
    have hD : kmeansLoss p C ≤ kmeansLoss p D := by
      rw [hclosest]
      exact (admissible_iff p _ D).1 (oracle.admissible x hfeas)
    have hdpos : 0 < cost kmeansLoss P D :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hlpos.trans_le hD) (contribution_le_cost kmeansLoss_nonneg hp D)
    have htrial : trialScore oracle x = kmeansLoss p C / cost kmeansLoss P D := by
      simp only [trialScore, dif_pos hfeas]
      rw [← hclosest]
    have hscore : kmeansLoss p C ≤ estimate oracle * cost kmeansLoss P D := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hdpos).1
      rw [← htrial]
      exact trialScore_le_estimate oracle x
    have happ : cost kmeansLoss P D ≤ ρ * cost kmeansLoss P C :=
      oracle.approximation x hfeas C hCadm
    calc
      kmeansLoss p C ≤ estimate oracle * cost kmeansLoss P D := hscore
      _ ≤ estimate oracle * (ρ * cost kmeansLoss P C) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left happ he
      _ = (ρ * estimate oracle) * cost kmeansLoss P C := by ring

/-- Theorem 4.1, with all infeasible-radius and zero-cost cases explicit. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.estimate_approximates_s.source:
theorem estimate_approximates_sensitivity
    (oracle : ConstrainedOracle (k := k) P p ρ) (hp : p ∈ P) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p / ρ ≤ estimate oracle ∧
      estimate oracle ≤ sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p := by
  constructor
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hρ).2
    have hbound : sensitivity (kmeansLoss (k := k)) P p ≤ ρ * estimate oracle :=
      sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le kmeansLoss_nonneg hp
        (mul_nonneg hρ.le (estimate_nonneg oracle))
        (contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost oracle hp hρ)
    simpa [mul_comm] using hbound
  · exact estimate_le_sensitivity oracle hp

/-- Exactly the feasible trials are sent to the constrained oracle. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.queriedRadii.source:
noncomputable def queriedRadii (p : X) : Finset X := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.univ : Finset X).filter (FeasibleRadius (k := k) p)

/-- The reduction makes at most `|X|` constrained optimization calls. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.oracle_calls_le_card.source:
theorem oracle_calls_le_card (p : X) : (queriedRadii (k := k) p).card ≤ Fintype.card X := by
  classical
  simpa [queriedRadii] using
    (Finset.card_filter_le (s := (Finset.univ : Finset X)) (FeasibleRadius (k := k) p))

end FTC.FiniteMetric

FTC.FiniteMetric.admissible_dist_iff.source:
theorem admissible_dist_iff (p x : X) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    Admissible p (dist p x ^ 2) C ↔ ∀ y ∈ C.centers, dist p x ≤ dist p y := by
  constructor
  · intro h y hy
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).1 (h y hy)
  · intro h y hy
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).2 (h y hy)

/-- A separate weighted contribution for each stored index. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss.source:
noncomputable def weightedLoss (entries : I → Entry X) (i : I) (C : CenterSet X k) : ℝ :=
  contribution kmeansLoss entries i C

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedLoss_nonneg.source:
theorem weightedLoss_nonneg (entries : I → Entry X) (i : I) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    0 ≤ weightedLoss entries i C :=
  contribution_nonneg kmeansLoss entries kmeansLoss_nonneg i C

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedSensitivity_of_.source:
theorem weightedSensitivity_of_weight_zero (entries : I → Entry X)
    (U : Finset I) (p : I) (hw : (entries p).weight = 0) :
    sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p = 0 := by
  by_cases hp : p ∈ U
  · apply le_antisymm
    · apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) hp le_rfl
      intro C
      simp [weightedLoss, contribution, hw]
    · exact sensitivity_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) U p
  · exact sensitivity_of_not_mem hp

/-- Specification of the weighted constrained oracle needed for one indexed
sensitivity. Its output cost is compared with every feasible competitor. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.IndexedConstrainedOracl.source:
structure IndexedConstrainedOracle (U : Finset I) (entries : I → Entry X)
    (p : I) (ρ : ℝ) where
  solve : ∀ x : X,
    FeasibleRadius (k := k) (entries p).point x → CenterSet X k
  admissible : ∀ x h,
    Admissible (entries p).point (dist (entries p).point x ^ 2) (solve x h)
  approximation : ∀ x h (C : CenterSet X k),
    Admissible (entries p).point (dist (entries p).point x ^ 2) C →
    cost (weightedLoss entries) U (solve x h) ≤ ρ * cost (weightedLoss entries) U C

variable {U : Finset I} {entries : I → Entry X} {p : I} {ρ : ℝ}

/-- A weighted trial score; the numerator uses the queried entry's own weight. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore.source:
noncomputable def weightedTrialScore
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) (x : X) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if h : FeasibleRadius (k := k) (entries p).point x then
    ((entries p).weight * dist (entries p).point x ^ 2) /
      cost (weightedLoss entries) U (oracle.solve x h)
  else 0

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate.source:
noncomputable def weightedEstimate
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) : ℝ :=
  (Finset.univ : Finset X).sup' ⟨(entries p).point, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    (weightedTrialScore oracle)

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore_nonn.source:
theorem weightedTrialScore_nonneg
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) (x : X) :
    0 ≤ weightedTrialScore oracle x := by
  unfold weightedTrialScore
  split_ifs
  · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (entries p).weight_nonneg (sq_nonneg _))
      (cost_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) _ _)
  · exact le_rfl

omit [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq X] in

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore_le_e.source:
theorem weightedTrialScore_le_estimate
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) (x : X) :
    weightedTrialScore oracle x ≤ weightedEstimate oracle := by
  exact Finset.le_sup' (weightedTrialScore oracle) (Finset.mem_univ x)

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate_nonneg.source:
theorem weightedEstimate_nonneg
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) :
    0 ≤ weightedEstimate oracle :=
  (weightedTrialScore_nonneg oracle (entries p).point).trans
    (weightedTrialScore_le_estimate oracle (entries p).point)

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedTrialScore_le_s.source:
theorem weightedTrialScore_le_sensitivity
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ)
    (hp : p ∈ U) (x : X) :
    weightedTrialScore oracle x ≤ sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p := by
  unfold weightedTrialScore
  split_ifs with h
  · let C := oracle.solve x h
    change ((entries p).weight * dist (entries p).point x ^ 2) /
        cost (weightedLoss entries) U C ≤ sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p
    have hr : (entries p).weight * dist (entries p).point x ^ 2 ≤ weightedLoss entries p C := by
      have hd := (admissible_iff (entries p).point _ C).1 (oracle.admissible x h)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (entries p).weight_nonneg
    have hc : 0 ≤ cost (weightedLoss entries) U C :=
      cost_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) U C
    by_cases hz : cost (weightedLoss entries) U C = 0
    · simpa [hz] using sensitivity_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) U p
    · have hcpos : 0 < cost (weightedLoss entries) U C := lt_of_le_of_ne hc (Ne.symm hz)
      have hs := contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) hp C
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hcpos).2 (hr.trans hs)
  · exact sensitivity_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) U p

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate_le_sen.source:
theorem weightedEstimate_le_sensitivity
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) (hp : p ∈ U) :
    weightedEstimate oracle ≤ sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p := by
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro x _
  exact weightedTrialScore_le_sensitivity oracle hp x

FTC.FiniteMetric.weighted_contribution_l.source:
theorem weighted_contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ)
    (hp : p ∈ U) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    weightedLoss entries p C ≤
      (ρ * weightedEstimate oracle) * cost (weightedLoss entries) U C := by
  have he : 0 ≤ weightedEstimate oracle := weightedEstimate_nonneg oracle
  have hc : 0 ≤ cost (weightedLoss entries) U C :=
    cost_nonneg (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) U C
  by_cases hz : weightedLoss entries p C = 0
  · rw [hz]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hρ.le he) hc
  · have hlpos : 0 < weightedLoss entries p C :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (weightedLoss_nonneg entries p C) (Ne.symm hz)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hclosest⟩ := exists_closest_center (entries p).point C
    have hCadm : Admissible (entries p).point (dist (entries p).point x ^ 2) C := by
      rw [admissible_iff, ← hclosest]
    have hfeas : FeasibleRadius (k := k) (entries p).point x := ⟨C, hCadm⟩
    let D := oracle.solve x hfeas
    have hD : weightedLoss entries p C ≤ weightedLoss entries p D := by
      have hd := (admissible_iff (entries p).point _ D).1 (oracle.admissible x hfeas)
      rw [← hclosest] at hd
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (entries p).weight_nonneg
    have hdpos : 0 < cost (weightedLoss entries) U D :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hlpos.trans_le hD)
        (contribution_le_cost (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) hp D)
    have htrial : weightedTrialScore oracle x =
        weightedLoss entries p C / cost (weightedLoss entries) U D := by
      simp only [weightedTrialScore, dif_pos hfeas]
      rw [weightedLoss, contribution, hclosest]
    have hscore : weightedLoss entries p C ≤
        weightedEstimate oracle * cost (weightedLoss entries) U D := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hdpos).1
      rw [← htrial]
      exact weightedTrialScore_le_estimate oracle x
    have happ : cost (weightedLoss entries) U D ≤ ρ * cost (weightedLoss entries) U C :=
      oracle.approximation x hfeas C hCadm
    calc
      weightedLoss entries p C ≤
          weightedEstimate oracle * cost (weightedLoss entries) U D := hscore
      _ ≤ weightedEstimate oracle * (ρ * cost (weightedLoss entries) U C) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left happ he
      _ = (ρ * weightedEstimate oracle) * cost (weightedLoss entries) U C := by ring

/-- The weighted extension of Theorem 4.1, with separately indexed copies. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.weightedEstimate_approx.source:
theorem weightedEstimate_approximates_sensitivity
    (oracle : IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ)
    (hp : p ∈ U) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p / ρ ≤ weightedEstimate oracle ∧
      weightedEstimate oracle ≤ sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p := by
  constructor
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hρ).2
    have hbound : sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) U p ≤
        ρ * weightedEstimate oracle :=
      sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le (weightedLoss_nonneg entries) hp
        (mul_nonneg hρ.le (weightedEstimate_nonneg oracle))
        (weighted_contribution_le_estimate_mul_cost oracle hp hρ)
    simpa [mul_comm] using hbound
  · exact weightedEstimate_le_sensitivity oracle hp

/-- A family of constrained weighted solvers supplies exactly the oracle API
used by the deterministic filtering theorem. -/

FTC.FiniteMetric.indexedApproxSensitivit.source:
noncomputable def indexedApproxSensitivityOracle
    (entries : I → Entry X) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (solvers : ∀ (U : Finset I) (p : I), IndexedConstrainedOracle (k := k) U entries p ρ) :
    ApproxSensitivityOracle (weightedLoss (k := k) entries) ρ where
  score U p := weightedEstimate (solvers U p)
  lower U p hp := by
    have h := (weightedEstimate_approximates_sensitivity (solvers U p) hp hρ).1
    have h' := (div_le_iff₀ hρ).1 h
    simpa [mul_comm] using h'
  upper U p hp :=
    (weightedEstimate_approximates_sensitivity (solvers U p) hp hρ).2

omit [DecidableEq I] in

FTC.FiniteMetric.weighted_oracle_calls_l.source:
theorem weighted_oracle_calls_le_card (entries : I → Entry X) (p : I) :
    (queriedRadii (k := k) (entries p).point).card ≤ Fintype.card X :=
  oracle_calls_le_card (entries p).point

end FTC.FiniteMetric

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.source:
inductive Ty where
  | nat
  | bool
  | pair : Ty → Ty → Ty
  | list : Ty → Ty
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.Value.source:
@[reducible] def Ty.Value : Ty → Type
  | .nat => ℕ
  | .bool => Bool
  | .pair a b => a.Value × b.Value
  | .list a => List a.Value

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.size.source:
def Ty.size : (t : Ty) → t.Value → ℕ
  | .nat, n => n.size + 1
  | .bool, _ => 1
  | .pair a b, x => a.size x.1 + b.size x.2 + 1
  | .list a, xs => (xs.map a.size).sum + xs.length + 1

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.size_nat.source: @[simp] theorem Ty.size_nat (n : ℕ) : Ty.nat.size n = n.size + 1 := rfl

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.size_bool.source: @[simp] theorem Ty.size_bool (b : Bool) : Ty.bool.size b = 1 := rfl

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.size_pair.source:
@[simp] theorem Ty.size_pair {a b : Ty} (x : (Ty.pair a b).Value) :
    (Ty.pair a b).size x = a.size x.1 + b.size x.2 + 1 := rfl

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.size_list.source:
@[simp] theorem Ty.size_list {a : Ty} (xs : List a.Value) :
    (Ty.list a).size xs = (xs.map a.size).sum + xs.length + 1 := rfl

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.size_pos.source:
theorem Ty.size_pos (t : Ty) (x : t.Value) : 0 < t.size x := by
  cases t <;> simp only [Ty.size] <;> omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Ty.size_mem_le.source:
theorem Ty.size_mem_le {t : Ty} {xs : List t.Value} {x : t.Value} (hx : x ∈ xs) :
    t.size x ≤ (Ty.list t).size xs := by
  have h := List.single_le_sum (l := xs.map t.size) (fun n _ => Nat.zero_le n) _
    (List.mem_map_of_mem hx)
  simp only [Ty.size]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.size_add_le.source:
theorem size_add_le (a b : ℕ) : (a + b).size ≤ a.size + b.size + 1 := by
  rw [Nat.size_le]
  have ha : a < 2 ^ (a.size + b.size) :=
    (Nat.lt_size_self a).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
  have hb : b < 2 ^ (a.size + b.size) :=
    (Nat.lt_size_self b).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
  rw [pow_succ]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.size_mul_le.source:
theorem size_mul_le (a b : ℕ) : (a * b).size ≤ a.size + b.size := by
  rw [Nat.size_le, pow_add]
  exact mul_lt_mul'' (Nat.lt_size_self a) (Nat.lt_size_self b) (Nat.zero_le _) (Nat.zero_le _)

FTC.Hardness.Computation.size_sub_le.source:
theorem size_sub_le (a b : ℕ) : (a - b).size ≤ a.size := by
  rw [Nat.size_le]
  exact (Nat.sub_le a b).trans_lt (Nat.lt_size_self a)

FTC.Hardness.Computation.maximum.source:
def maximum : List ℕ → ℕ
  | [] => 0
  | a :: xs => max a (maximum xs)

FTC.Hardness.Computation.le_maximum_of_m.source:
theorem le_maximum_of_mem {x : ℕ} {xs : List ℕ} (hx : x ∈ xs) : x ≤ maximum xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons y ys ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx
    · exact Nat.le_max_left _ _
    · exact (ih hx).trans (Nat.le_max_right _ _)

FTC.Hardness.Computation.maximum_size_le.source:
theorem maximum_size_le (xs : List ℕ) :
    (maximum xs).size ≤ (xs.map fun n => n.size + 1).sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [maximum]
  | cons a xs ih =>
    simp only [maximum, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    by_cases h : a ≤ maximum xs
    · rw [max_eq_right h]
      omega
    · rw [max_eq_left (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h))]
      omega

/-- Value iteration, with one charged loop step per iteration. -/

FTC.Hardness.Computation.iterateValue.source:
def iterateValue {A : Type} (f : A → A) : ℕ → A → A
  | 0, x => x
  | n + 1, x => iterateValue f n (f x)

FTC.Hardness.Computation.iterateCost.source:
def iterateCost {A : Type} (f : A → A) (charge : A → ℕ) : ℕ → A → ℕ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n + 1, x => charge x + iterateCost f charge n (f x) + 1

/-- A closed programming language. In particular, no constructor accepts an
arbitrary function together with an invented cost. -/

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.source:
inductive Code : Ty → Ty → Type where
  | id {a} : Code a a
  | const {a b} (v : b.Value) : Code a b
  | comp {a b c} : Code a b → Code b c → Code a c
  | pair {a b c} : Code a b → Code a c → Code a (.pair b c)
  | fst {a b} : Code (.pair a b) a
  | snd {a b} : Code (.pair a b) b
  | branch {a b} : Code a .bool → Code a b → Code a b → Code a b
  | add : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .nat
  | mul : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .nat
  | sub : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .nat
  | div : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .nat
  | mod : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .nat
  | le : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .bool
  | eq : Code (.pair .nat .nat) .bool
  | cons {a} : Code (.pair a (.list a)) (.list a)
  | append {a} : Code (.pair (.list a) (.list a)) (.list a)
  | head {a} : Code (.pair a (.list a)) a
  | tail {a} : Code (.list a) (.list a)
  | length {a} : Code (.list a) .nat
  | map {a b} : Code a b → Code (.list a) (.list b)
  | mapWith {s a b} : Code (.pair s a) b → Code (.pair s (.list a)) (.list b)
  | flatten {a} : Code (.list (.list a)) (.list a)
  | maximum : Code (.list .nat) .nat
  | size {a} : Code a .nat
  | range : Code .nat (.list .nat)
  | iterate {a} : Code a a → Code (.pair .nat a) a

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.eval.source:
def Code.eval : {a b : Ty} → Code a b → a.Value → b.Value
  | _, _, .id, x => x
  | _, _, .const v, _ => v
  | _, _, .comp f g, x => g.eval (f.eval x)
  | _, _, .pair f g, x => (f.eval x, g.eval x)
  | _, _, .fst, x => x.1
  | _, _, .snd, x => x.2
  | _, _, .branch c f g, x => if c.eval x then f.eval x else g.eval x
  | _, _, .add, x => x.1 + x.2
  | _, _, .mul, x => x.1 * x.2
  | _, _, .sub, x => x.1 - x.2
  | _, _, .div, x => x.1 / x.2
  | _, _, .mod, x => x.1 % x.2
  | _, _, .le, x => decide (x.1 ≤ x.2)
  | _, _, .eq, x => decide (x.1 = x.2)
  | _, _, .cons, x => x.1 :: x.2
  | _, _, .append, x => x.1 ++ x.2
  | _, _, .head, x => x.2.headD x.1
  | _, _, .tail, x => x.tail
  | _, _, .length, x => x.length
  | _, _, .map f, x => x.map f.eval
  | _, _, .mapWith f, x => x.2.map (fun y => f.eval (x.1, y))
  | _, _, .flatten, x => x.flatten
  | _, _, .maximum, x => Computation.maximum x
  | a, _, .size, x => a.size x
  | _, _, .range, x => List.range x
  | _, _, .iterate f, x => iterateValue f.eval x.1 x.2

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.cost.source:
def Code.cost : {a b : Ty} → Code a b → a.Value → ℕ
  | a, _, .id, x => a.size x + 1
  | _, b, .const v, _ => b.size v + 1
  | _, _, .comp f g, x => f.cost x + g.cost (f.eval x) + 1
  | _, _, .pair f g, x => f.cost x + g.cost x + 1
  | _, _, .branch c f g, x => c.cost x + (if c.eval x then f.cost x else g.cost x) + 1
  | _, _, .map f, xs => (xs.map f.cost).sum + (Ty.list _).size xs + 1
  | _, _, .mapWith f, x => (x.2.map (fun y => f.cost (x.1, y))).sum +
      (Ty.pair _ (.list _)).size x + 1
  | _, _, .iterate f, x => iterateCost f.eval f.cost x.1 x.2 + (Ty.pair .nat _).size x
  | _, _, .range, n => (n + 1) ^ 2 * (n.size + 1)
  | a, _, _, x => (a.size x + 1) ^ 2

FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound.source: def bound (C d n : ℕ) : ℕ := C * (n + 1) ^ d

FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound_mono.source:
theorem bound_mono {C C' d d' n n' : ℕ}
    (hC : C ≤ C') (hd : d ≤ d') (hn : n ≤ n') : bound C d n ≤ bound C' d' n' := by
  unfold bound
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul hC ((Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) d).trans
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hd))

FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound_add.source:
theorem bound_add {C d E e n u v : ℕ}
    (hu : u ≤ bound C d n) (hv : v ≤ bound E e n) :
    u + v ≤ bound (C + E) (d + e) n := by
  have hu' := hu.trans (bound_mono le_rfl (Nat.le_add_right d e) le_rfl)
  have hv' := hv.trans (bound_mono le_rfl (Nat.le_add_left e d) le_rfl)
  simpa only [bound, add_mul] using Nat.add_le_add hu' hv'

FTC.Hardness.Computation.bound_comp.source:
theorem bound_comp {C d E e n m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ bound C d n) :
    bound E e m ≤ bound (E * (C + 1) ^ e) (d * e) n := by
  unfold bound at *
  have hone : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ d := Nat.one_le_pow d (n + 1) (by omega)
  calc
    E * (m + 1) ^ e ≤ E * ((C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ d) ^ e := by
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      apply Nat.pow_le_pow_left
      nlinarith
    _ = E * (C + 1) ^ e * (n + 1) ^ (d * e) := by
      rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
      ring

/-- Both actual charged computation and the materialized result have a
polynomial bound in the binary/structural input size. -/

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.source:
def Code.IsPoly {a b : Ty} (p : Code a b) : Prop :=
  ∃ C d : ℕ, ∀ x, p.cost x + b.size (p.eval x) ≤ bound C d (a.size x)

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_of_si.source:
theorem Code.poly_of_size_le {a b : Ty} (p : Code a b)
    (hcost : ∀ x, p.cost x ≤ (a.size x + 1) ^ 2)
    (hsize : ∀ x, b.size (p.eval x) ≤ a.size x + 1) : p.IsPoly := by
  refine ⟨2, 2, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hc := hcost x
  have hs := hsize x
  unfold bound
  nlinarith

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_id.source:
theorem Code.poly_id {a : Ty} : (Code.id (a := a)).IsPoly := by
  refine ⟨2, 1, ?_⟩
  intro x
  simp only [Code.cost, Code.eval, bound, pow_one]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_const.source:
theorem Code.poly_const {a b : Ty} (v : b.Value) : (Code.const (a := a) v).IsPoly := by
  refine ⟨2 * b.size v + 1, 0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  simp only [Code.cost, Code.eval, bound, pow_zero, Nat.mul_one]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.com.source:
theorem Code.IsPoly.comp {a b c : Ty} {f : Code a b} {g : Code b c}
    (hf : f.IsPoly) (hg : g.IsPoly) : (Code.comp f g).IsPoly := by
  obtain ⟨C, d, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨E, e, hg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨C + E * (C + 1) ^ e + 1, d + d * e + 0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hfx := hf x
  have hsize : b.size (f.eval x) ≤ bound C d (a.size x) := by omega
  have hsecond := (hg (f.eval x)).trans (bound_comp hsize)
  have hfirst : f.cost x ≤ bound C d (a.size x) := by omega
  have hsum := bound_add hfirst hsecond
  have hone : 1 ≤ bound 1 0 (a.size x) := by simp [bound]
  have htotal := bound_add hsum hone
  simpa only [Code.cost, Code.eval, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using htotal

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.pai.source:
theorem Code.IsPoly.pair {a b c : Ty} {f : Code a b} {g : Code a c}
    (hf : f.IsPoly) (hg : g.IsPoly) : (Code.pair f g).IsPoly := by
  obtain ⟨C, d, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨E, e, hg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨C + E + 2, d + e + 0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hsum := bound_add (hf x) (hg x)
  have htwo : 2 ≤ bound 2 0 (a.size x) := by simp [bound]
  have htotal := bound_add hsum htwo
  simp only [Code.cost, Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_fst.source:
theorem Code.poly_fst {a b : Ty} : (Code.fst (a := a) (b := b)).IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_snd.source:
theorem Code.poly_snd {a b : Ty} : (Code.snd (a := a) (b := b)).IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega
