FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_add.source:
theorem Code.poly_add : Code.add.IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  have := size_add_le x.1 x.2
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_mul.source:
theorem Code.poly_mul : Code.mul.IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  have := size_mul_le x.1 x.2
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_sub.source:
theorem Code.poly_sub : Code.sub.IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  have := size_sub_le x.1 x.2
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_maxim.source:
theorem Code.poly_maximum : Code.maximum.IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  change (Computation.maximum x).size + 1 ≤
    (x.map (fun n : ℕ => n.size + 1)).sum + x.length + 1 + 1
  have := maximum_size_le x
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_le.source:
theorem Code.poly_le : Code.le.IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.sum_map_le_leng.source:
theorem sum_map_le_length_mul {A : Type} (xs : List A) (f : A → ℕ) (M : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ xs, f x ≤ M) : (xs.map f).sum ≤ xs.length * M := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx := h x (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hxs := ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy))
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.sum_map_add.source:
theorem sum_map_add {A : Type} (xs : List A) (f g : A → ℕ) :
    (xs.map (fun x => f x + g x)).sum = (xs.map f).sum + (xs.map g).sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih => simp [ih, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.map.source:
theorem Code.IsPoly.map {a b : Ty} {f : Code a b} (hf : f.IsPoly) :
    (Code.map f).IsPoly := by
  obtain ⟨C, d, hf⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨C + 2, d + 1, ?_⟩
  intro xs
  let s := (Ty.list a).size xs
  have hlen : xs.length ≤ s := by dsimp [s, Ty.size]; omega
  have heach : ∀ x ∈ xs, f.cost x + b.size (f.eval x) ≤ bound C d s := by
    intro x hx
    exact (hf x).trans (bound_mono le_rfl le_rfl (Ty.size_mem_le hx))
  have hsum := sum_map_le_length_mul xs (fun x => f.cost x + b.size (f.eval x)) _ heach
  rw [sum_map_add] at hsum
  have hsum' := hsum.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (bound C d s) hlen)
  have hone : 1 ≤ (s + 1) ^ d := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hm1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (C * (s + 1) ^ d) (Nat.le_succ s)
  have hm2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * (s + 1)) hone
  change ((xs.map f.cost).sum + s + 1) +
    (((xs.map f.eval).map b.size).sum + (xs.map f.eval).length + 1) ≤ _
  simp only [List.map_map, List.length_map, Function.comp_def]
  change ((xs.map f.cost).sum + s + 1) +
    ((xs.map (fun x => b.size (f.eval x))).sum + xs.length + 1) ≤ bound (C + 2) (d + 1) s
  simp only [bound, pow_succ] at hsum' ⊢
  nlinarith

FTC.Hardness.Computation.size_flatten_le.source:
theorem size_flatten_le {a : Ty} (xs : List (List a.Value)) :
    (Ty.list a).size xs.flatten ≤ (Ty.list (.list a)).size xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [Ty.size]
  | cons ys xs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatten_cons, Ty.size, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
      List.length_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons] at *
    omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_flatt.source:
theorem Code.poly_flatten {a : Ty} : (Code.flatten (a := a)).IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro xs
  exact (size_flatten_le xs).trans (Nat.le_succ _)

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_cons.source:
theorem Code.poly_cons {a : Ty} : (Code.cons (a := a)).IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro x
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.poly_lengt.source:
theorem Code.poly_length {a : Ty} : (Code.length (a := a)).IsPoly := by
  apply Code.poly_of_size_le _ (fun _ => le_rfl)
  intro xs
  have hs : xs.length.size ≤ xs.length + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.size_le]
    exact (Nat.lt_succ_self _).trans_le (Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le)
  simp only [Code.eval, Ty.size]
  omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.bra.source:
theorem Code.IsPoly.branch {a b : Ty} {c : Code a .bool} {f g : Code a b}
    (hc : c.IsPoly) (hf : f.IsPoly) (hg : g.IsPoly) : (Code.branch c f g).IsPoly := by
  obtain ⟨C, d, hc⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨E, e, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨F, q, hg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨C + (E + F) + 1, d + (e + q) + 0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hcx : c.cost x ≤ bound C d (a.size x) := (Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans (hc x)
  have hfg := bound_add (hf x) (hg x)
  have hone : 1 ≤ bound 1 0 (a.size x) := by simp [bound]
  have htotal := bound_add (bound_add hcx hfg) hone
  simp only [Nat.add_zero] at htotal
  simp only [Code.cost, Code.eval]
  cases c.eval x <;> simp <;> omega

FTC.Hardness.Computation.Code.IsPoly.map.source:
theorem Code.IsPoly.mapWith {s a b : Ty} {f : Code (.pair s a) b} (hf : f.IsPoly) :
    (Code.mapWith f).IsPoly := by
  obtain ⟨C, d, hf⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨C + 2, d + 1, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let n := (Ty.pair s (.list a)).size x
  have hlen : x.2.length ≤ n := by dsimp [n, Ty.size]; omega
  have heach : ∀ y ∈ x.2, f.cost (x.1, y) + b.size (f.eval (x.1, y)) ≤ bound C d n := by
    intro y hy
    have hpair : (Ty.pair s a).size (x.1, y) ≤ n :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add_left (Ty.size_mem_le hy) _) _
    exact (hf _).trans (bound_mono le_rfl le_rfl hpair)
  have hsum := sum_map_le_length_mul x.2
    (fun y => f.cost (x.1, y) + b.size (f.eval (x.1, y))) _ heach
  rw [sum_map_add] at hsum
  have hsum' := hsum.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (bound C d n) hlen)
  have hone : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ d := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hm1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (C * (n + 1) ^ d) (Nat.le_succ n)
  have hm2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * (n + 1)) hone
  change ((x.2.map (fun y => f.cost (x.1, y))).sum + n + 1) +
    (((x.2.map (fun y => f.eval (x.1, y))).map b.size).sum +
      (x.2.map (fun y => f.eval (x.1, y))).length + 1) ≤ bound (C + 2) (d + 1) n
  simp only [List.map_map, List.length_map, Function.comp_def]
  simp only [bound, pow_succ] at hsum' ⊢
  nlinarith

-- Keep downstream certificate search at the program-syntax level. Unfolding
-- the semantic cost bound during failed `apply` attempts causes unnecessary
-- normalization of whole interpreters.
attribute [irreducible] Code.IsPoly

end FTC.Hardness.Computation

namespace FTC.Hardness.Complexity

open Computation

/-- YES and NO sets are disjoint. Inputs outside their union are unpromised. -/

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PromiseProblem.source:
structure PromiseProblem (t : Ty) where
  yes : t.Value → Prop
  no : t.Value → Prop
  disjoint : ∀ x, yes x → no x → False

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.languageProblem.source:
def languageProblem (L : List Bool → Prop) : PromiseProblem (.list .bool) where
  yes := L
  no x := ¬ L x
  disjoint _ hy hn := hn hy

/-- Polynomial-time many-one reduction, with an actual program witness. -/

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction.source:
structure PolyReduction {a b : Ty} (P : PromiseProblem a) (Q : PromiseProblem b) where
  program : Code a b
  polynomial : program.IsPoly
  yes : ∀ x, P.yes x → Q.yes (program.eval x)
  no : ∀ x, P.no x → Q.no (program.eval x)

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.PolyReduction.co.source:
def PolyReduction.comp {a b c : Ty} {P : PromiseProblem a} {Q : PromiseProblem b}
    {R : PromiseProblem c} (f : PolyReduction P Q) (g : PolyReduction Q R) :
    PolyReduction P R where
  program := .comp f.program g.program
  polynomial := f.polynomial.comp g.polynomial
  yes x hx := g.yes _ (f.yes x hx)
  no x hx := g.no _ (f.no x hx)

/-- Polynomial certificate verification in the explicit bit-cost model. -/

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InNP.source:
def InNP (L : List Bool → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ (verifier : Code (.pair (.list .bool) (.list .bool)) .bool),
    verifier.IsPoly ∧ ∃ C d : ℕ, ∀ x,
      L x ↔ ∃ witness : List Bool,
        witness.length ≤ bound C d x.length ∧ verifier.eval (x, witness) = true

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.InP.source:
def InP (L : List Bool → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ (decider : Code (.list .bool) .bool), decider.IsPoly ∧
    ∀ x, L x ↔ decider.eval x = true

/-- NP-hardness for a promise problem, in the same explicit program model. -/

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard.source:
def NPHard {t : Ty} (P : PromiseProblem t) : Prop :=
  ∀ L : List Bool → Prop, InNP L → Nonempty (PolyReduction (languageProblem L) P)

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard.of_reduct.source:
theorem NPHard.of_reduction {a b : Ty} {P : PromiseProblem a} {Q : PromiseProblem b}
    (hP : NPHard P) (r : PolyReduction P Q) : NPHard Q := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := hP L hL
  exact ⟨f.comp r⟩

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.Solves.source:
def Solves {a : Ty} (p : Code a .bool) (P : PromiseProblem a) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, P.yes x → p.eval x = true) ∧ (∀ x, P.no x → p.eval x = false)

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.NPHard.inP_of_so.source:
theorem NPHard.inP_of_solver {a : Ty} {P : PromiseProblem a} (hP : NPHard P)
    {p : Code a .bool} (hpoly : p.IsPoly) (hsolve : Solves p P)
    {L : List Bool → Prop} (hL : InNP L) : InP L := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := hP L hL
  refine ⟨.comp r.program p, r.polynomial.comp hpoly, ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact hsolve.1 _ (r.yes x hx)
  · intro hx
    by_contra hn
    have hfalse := hsolve.2 _ (r.no x hn)
    change p.eval (r.program.eval x) = true at hx
    simp [hfalse] at hx

FTC.Hardness.Complexity.inNP_of_inP.source:
theorem inNP_of_inP {L : List Bool → Prop} (h : InP L) : InNP L := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, h⟩ := h
  refine ⟨.comp .fst p, Code.poly_fst.comp hp, 0, 0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨[], by simp [bound], (h x).mp hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, _, hw⟩
    exact (h x).mpr hw

end FTC.Hardness.Complexity

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullRationalEntrie.source:
def fullRationalEntries (x : FullData) (i : Option (Fin x.1)) : RationalEntry (Option (Fin x.1)) where
  point := i
  weight := rational ((fullWeights x).getD (position i) (0, 0))
  weight_nonneg := rational_nonneg _

/-- The previously verified exhaustive numerical algorithm on the new ordinary
input format. Its use here is only a small demonstration, not a polynomial
algorithm for the hard optimization problem. -/

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.exactFullSensitivi.source:
theorem exactFullSensitivity_cast_eq (x : FullData) (h : ValidFull x) :
    (exactFullSensitivity x h : ℝ) = fullSensitivity x h := by
  unfold exactFullSensitivity
  rw [exactRationalKmeansSensitivity_cast_eq]
  rfl

end FTC.Hardness.Encoding

namespace FTC.Hardness.Examples

open FTC.FiniteMetric Encoding

FTC.Hardness.Examples.toyBase_valid.source:
theorem toyBase_valid : ValidBase toyBase where
  square := by
    intro row hr
    simp only [toyBase, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hr
    rcases hr with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
  clients_length := rfl
  self := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [matrixDistance, toyBase, pointCount, rational]
  comm := by
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [matrixDistance, toyBase, pointCount, rational]
  triangle := by
    intro i j z
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases z <;>
      norm_num [matrixDistance, toyBase, pointCount, rational]
  eq_of_zero := by
    intro i j h
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    all_goals first | rfl | norm_num [matrixDistance, toyBase, pointCount, rational] at h
  centers_pos := by decide
  centers_le := by decide

FTC.Hardness.Examples.clients_toy.source: theorem clients_toy : clients toyBase = Finset.univ := by decide

FTC.Hardness.Examples.toy_cost.source:
theorem toy_cost (C : CenterSet (Fin (pointCount toyBase)) (centerCount toyBase)) :
    letI := toyBase_valid.metric.toMetricSpace
    cost kmeansLoss (clients toyBase) C = 1 := by
  letI := toyBase_valid.metric.toMetricSpace
  have hcard : C.centers.card = 1 := C.card_eq
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
  simp only [cost, clients_toy, kmeansLoss, hp, Finset.inf'_singleton]
  change (∑ x : Fin 2, (matrixDistance toyBase.1 x p : ℝ) ^ 2) = 1
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  fin_cases p <;> norm_num [matrixDistance, toyBase, rational]

FTC.Hardness.Examples.toy_optimum.source:
theorem toy_optimum : originalOptimum toyBase toyBase_valid = 1 := by
  unfold originalOptimum optimum
  exact toy_cost _

FTC.Hardness.Examples.parameters.source:
def parameters : GapParameters (3 : ℝ) 2 where
  copies := 4
  copies_pos := by decide
  threshold := 1 / 11
  threshold_pos := by norm_num
  no_lt := by norm_num
  yes_le := by norm_num

FTC.Hardness.Examples.yesSource_valid.source: theorem yesSource_valid : ValidSource yesSource := ⟨toyBase_valid, by decide⟩

FTC.Hardness.Examples.noSource_valid.source: theorem noSource_valid : ValidSource noSource := ⟨toyBase_valid, by decide⟩

FTC.Hardness.Examples.yes_promised.source:
theorem yes_promised : (gapKMeans 3 (by norm_num)).yes yesSource := by
  refine ⟨yesSource_valid, ?_⟩
  norm_num [yesSource, toy_optimum, rational]

FTC.Hardness.Examples.no_promised.source:
theorem no_promised : (gapKMeans 3 (by norm_num)).no noSource := by
  refine ⟨noSource_valid, ?_⟩
  norm_num [noSource, toy_optimum, rational]

FTC.Hardness.Examples.yesFull_valid.source:
theorem yesFull_valid : ValidFull yesFull :=
  materialize_valid _ (reduce_valid (by decide : 0 < 4) yesSource_valid)

FTC.Hardness.Examples.noFull_valid.source:
theorem noFull_valid : ValidFull noFull :=
  materialize_valid _ (reduce_valid (by decide : 0 < 4) noSource_valid)

FTC.Hardness.Examples.yes_sensitivity.source:
theorem yes_sensitivity : fullSensitivity yesFull yesFull_valid = 1 / 5 := by
  change fullSensitivity (materialize (reduce 4 yesSource))
    (materialize_valid _ (reduce_valid (by decide : 0 < 4) yesSource_valid)) = _
  rw [fullSensitivity_materialize _ (reduce_valid (by decide : 0 < 4) yesSource_valid),
    reduce_sensitivity_formula (by decide : 0 < 4) yesSource yesSource_valid]
  norm_num [yesSource, toy_optimum, rational]

FTC.Hardness.Examples.no_sensitivity.source:
theorem no_sensitivity : fullSensitivity noFull noFull_valid = 1 / 17 := by
  change fullSensitivity (materialize (reduce 4 noSource))
    (materialize_valid _ (reduce_valid (by decide : 0 < 4) noSource_valid)) = _
  rw [fullSensitivity_materialize _ (reduce_valid (by decide : 0 < 4) noSource_valid),
    reduce_sensitivity_formula (by decide : 0 < 4) noSource noSource_valid]
  norm_num [noSource, toy_optimum, rational]

FTC.Hardness.Examples.yes_exact_value.source:
theorem yes_exact_value : exactFullSensitivity yesFull yesFull_valid = 1 / 5 := by
  have h := exactFullSensitivity_cast_eq yesFull yesFull_valid
  rw [yes_sensitivity] at h
  apply Rat.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
  push_cast
  exact h

FTC.Hardness.Examples.no_exact_value.source:
theorem no_exact_value : exactFullSensitivity noFull noFull_valid = 1 / 17 := by
  have h := exactFullSensitivity_cast_eq noFull noFull_valid
  rw [no_sensitivity] at h
  apply Rat.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
  push_cast
  exact h

end FTC.Hardness.Examples

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullFlags.source: def fullFlags (x : FullData) : List Bool := x.2.2.1

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullWeights.source: def fullWeights (x : FullData) : List RatData := x.2.2.2.1

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.position.source:
def position {n : ℕ} : Option (Fin n) → ℕ
  | none => 0
  | some i => i.val + 1

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullDistance.source:
def fullDistance (x : FullData) (i j : Option (Fin x.1)) : ℚ :=
  rational (((fullMatrix x).getD (position i) []).getD (position j) (0, 0))

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidFull.source:
structure ValidFull (x : FullData) : Prop where
  matrix_length : (fullMatrix x).length = x.1 + 1
  square : ∀ row ∈ fullMatrix x, row.length = x.1 + 1
  flags_length : (fullFlags x).length = x.1 + 1
  weights_length : (fullWeights x).length = x.1 + 1
  self : ∀ i, fullDistance x i i = 0
  comm : ∀ i j, fullDistance x i j = fullDistance x j i
  triangle : ∀ i j z, fullDistance x i z ≤ fullDistance x i j + fullDistance x j z
  eq_of_zero : ∀ i j, fullDistance x i j = 0 → i = j
  centers_pos : 0 < fullK x
  centers_le : fullK x ≤ x.1 + 1
  query_active : (fullFlags x).getD 0 false = true

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidFull.metric.source:
def ValidFull.metric {x : FullData} (h : ValidFull x) : RationalMetric (Option (Fin x.1)) where
  distance := fullDistance x
  self := h.self
  comm := h.comm
  triangle := h.triangle
  eq_of_zero := h.eq_of_zero

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullClients.source:
def fullClients (x : FullData) : Finset (Option (Fin x.1)) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (fullFlags x).getD (position i) false = true)

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullEntries.source:
noncomputable def fullEntries (x : FullData) (i : Option (Fin x.1)) : Entry (Option (Fin x.1)) where
  point := i
  weight := (rational ((fullWeights x).getD (position i) (0, 0)) : ℝ)
  weight_nonneg := real_weight_nonneg _

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullContribution.source:
noncomputable def fullContribution (x : FullData) (h : ValidFull x) :
    Option (Fin x.1) → CenterSet (Option (Fin x.1)) (fullK x) → ℝ :=
  letI := h.metric.toMetricSpace
  weightedLoss (fullEntries x)

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullSensitivity.source:
noncomputable def fullSensitivity (x : FullData) (h : ValidFull x) : ℝ :=
  sensitivity (fullContribution x h) (fullClients x) none

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materialize.source:
@[reducible] def materialize (x : TargetData) : FullData :=
  (pointCount x.1, (expandedMatrix x, (true :: x.1.2.1,
    ((1, 0) :: x.1.1.map (fun _ => x.2.2), centerCount x.1))))

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.getD_map_inBounds.source:
theorem getD_map_inBounds {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (xs : List A) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < xs.length) (da : A) (db : B) :
    (xs.map f).getD i db = f (xs.getD i da) := by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hi), List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi]
  simp

/-- Every entry of the materialized distance matrix has the intended value. -/

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materializedDistan.source:
theorem materializedDistance (x : TargetData) (i j : Option (Fin (pointCount x.1))) :
    fullDistance (materialize x) i j =
      match i, j with
      | none, none => 0
      | none, some _ => (x.2.1 : ℚ)
      | some _, none => (x.2.1 : ℚ)
      | some a, some b => matrixDistance x.1.1 a b := by
  cases i with
  | none =>
    cases j with
    | none => simp [fullDistance, materialize, expandedMatrix, fullMatrix, position, rational]
    | some j =>
      simp only [fullDistance, materialize, fullMatrix, expandedMatrix, position,
        List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ]
      rw [getD_map_inBounds _ _ j j.isLt [] (0, 0)]
      simp [rational]
  | some i =>
    cases j with
    | none =>
      simp only [fullDistance, materialize, fullMatrix, expandedMatrix, position,
        List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ]
      rw [getD_map_inBounds _ _ i i.isLt [] []]
      simp [rational]
    | some j =>
      simp only [fullDistance, materialize, fullMatrix, expandedMatrix, position,
        List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ]
      rw [getD_map_inBounds _ _ i i.isLt [] []]
      simp only [List.getD_cons_succ, matrixDistance]

theorem materializedDistance_cast (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x)
    (i j : Option (Fin (pointCount x.1))) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    (fullDistance (materialize x) i j : ℝ) = extensionDist (x.2.1 : ℝ) i j := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  rw [materializedDistance]
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp only [extensionDist, Rat.cast_zero, Rat.cast_natCast]
  rfl

/-- Materialization produces an ordinary valid finite weighted metric instance. -/

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materialize_valid.source:
theorem materialize_valid (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x) : ValidFull (materialize x) := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  letI := extensionMetric (x.2.1 : ℝ) h.real_radius_pos h.real_radius_bound
  have hdist (i j : Option (Fin (pointCount x.1))) :
      (fullDistance (materialize x) i j : ℝ) = dist i j := materializedDistance_cast x h i j
  refine {
    matrix_length := by simp [materialize, expandedMatrix, fullMatrix, pointCount]
    square := ?_
    flags_length := ?_
    weights_length := by simp [materialize, fullWeights, pointCount]
    self := ?_
    comm := ?_
    triangle := ?_
    eq_of_zero := ?_
    centers_pos := h.base.centers_pos
    centers_le := h.base.centers_le.trans (Nat.le_succ _)
    query_active := by simp [materialize, fullFlags]
  }
  · intro row hr
    simp only [materialize, fullMatrix, expandedMatrix, List.mem_cons, List.mem_map] at hr
    rcases hr with rfl | ⟨old, hold, rfl⟩
    · simp [pointCount, materialize]
    · have := h.base.square old hold
      simpa only [List.length_cons, materialize] using congrArg Nat.succ this
  · have := h.base.clients_length
    simpa only [materialize, fullFlags, List.length_cons] using congrArg Nat.succ this
  · intro i
    have hr : (fullDistance (materialize x) i i : ℝ) = 0 := by rw [hdist, dist_self]
    exact_mod_cast hr
  · intro i j
    have hr : (fullDistance (materialize x) i j : ℝ) =
        (fullDistance (materialize x) j i : ℝ) := by rw [hdist, hdist, dist_comm]
    exact_mod_cast hr
  · intro i j z
    have hr : (fullDistance (materialize x) i z : ℝ) ≤
        (fullDistance (materialize x) i j : ℝ) + (fullDistance (materialize x) j z : ℝ) := by
      rw [hdist, hdist, hdist]
      exact dist_triangle _ _ _
    exact_mod_cast hr
  · intro i j hij
    apply dist_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← hdist, hij, Rat.cast_zero]

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullClients_materi.source:
theorem fullClients_materialize (x : TargetData) :
    fullClients (materialize x) = extendedClients (clients x.1) := by
  ext i
  cases i <;> simp [fullClients, materialize, fullFlags, position, extendedClients,
    clients, Finset.mem_map]

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullEntries_materi.source:
theorem fullEntries_materialize_weight (x : TargetData) (i : Option (Fin (pointCount x.1))) :
    (fullEntries (materialize x) i).weight =
      match i with | none => 1 | some _ => (rational x.2.2 : ℝ) := by
  cases i with
  | none => simp [fullEntries, materialize, fullWeights, position, rational]
  | some i =>
    simp only [fullEntries, materialize, fullWeights, position, List.getD_cons_succ]
    rw [getD_map_inBounds _ _ i i.isLt [] (0, 0)]

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullLoss_materiali.source:
theorem fullLoss_materialize (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x)
    (p : Option (Fin (pointCount x.1)))
    (C : CenterSet (Option (Fin (pointCount x.1))) (centerCount x.1)) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    letI := (materialize_valid x h).metric.toMetricSpace
    kmeansLoss p C = extensionLoss (x.2.1 : ℝ) p C := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  letI := (materialize_valid x h).metric.toMetricSpace
  unfold kmeansLoss extensionLoss
  apply Finset.inf'_congr C.nonempty rfl
  intro q _
  change (fullDistance (materialize x) p q : ℝ) ^ 2 = extensionDist (x.2.1 : ℝ) p q ^ 2
  rw [materializedDistance_cast x h]

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullContribution_m.source:
theorem fullContribution_materialize (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    fullContribution (materialize x) (materialize_valid x h) =
      gadgetContribution (k := centerCount x.1) (x.2.1 : ℝ) (rational x.2.2 : ℝ) := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  funext i C
  change (fullEntries (materialize x) i).weight *
      @kmeansLoss (Option (Fin (pointCount x.1)))
        (materialize_valid x h).metric.toMetricSpace _ i C = _
  rw [fullEntries_materialize_weight, fullLoss_materialize x h]
  cases i <;> simp only [gadgetContribution, one_mul]

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullSensitivity_ma.source:
theorem fullSensitivity_materialize (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x) :
    fullSensitivity (materialize x) (materialize_valid x h) = targetSensitivity x h := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  unfold fullSensitivity
  rw [fullClients_materialize, fullContribution_materialize x h]
  exact (targetSensitivity_eq_gadget x h).symm

end FTC.Hardness.Encoding

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.otherRowsCode.source:
def otherRowsCode : Code TargetTy MatrixTy :=
  .comp (.pair targetRadiusCode baseMatrixCode) (.mapWith .cons)

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.expandedMatrixCode.source:
def expandedMatrixCode : Code TargetTy MatrixTy :=
  .comp (.pair firstRowCode otherRowsCode) .cons

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materializeCode_ev.source:
@[simp] theorem materializeCode_eval (x : TargetData) : materializeCode.eval x = materialize x := by
  simp only [materializeCode, baseMatrixCode, expandedMatrixCode, firstRowCode, otherRowsCode,
    targetRadiusCode, targetWeightCode, flagsCode, weightsCode, targetCentersCode, Code.eval,
    materialize, expandedMatrix, pointCount, centerCount]

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.materializeCode_po.source:
theorem materializeCode_polynomial : materializeCode.IsPoly := by
  simp only [materializeCode, baseMatrixCode, expandedMatrixCode, firstRowCode, otherRowsCode,
    targetRadiusCode, targetWeightCode, flagsCode, weightsCode, targetCentersCode]
  repeat first
    | apply Code.IsPoly.comp
    | apply Code.IsPoly.pair
    | apply Code.IsPoly.mapWith
    | exact Code.poly_fst
    | exact Code.poly_snd
    | exact Code.poly_const _
    | exact Code.poly_cons
    | exact Code.poly_length

/-- A single executable program produces the entire explicit output instance. -/

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullReductionCode.source:
def fullReductionCode (c : ℕ) : Code SourceTy FullTy :=
  .comp (reductionCode c) materializeCode

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.fullReductionCode_.source:
theorem fullReductionCode_polynomial (c : ℕ) : (fullReductionCode c).IsPoly :=
  (reductionCode_polynomial c).comp materializeCode_polynomial

@[simp] theorem fullReductionCode_eval (c : ℕ) (x : SourceData) :
    (fullReductionCode c).eval x = materialize (reduce c x) := by
  simp only [fullReductionCode, Code.eval, reductionCode_eval, materializeCode_eval]

/-- Both the bit-cost of the construction and the encoded output size have a
polynomial bound, uniformly over all raw inputs, even malformed ones. -/

theorem fullReductionCode_cost_size (c : ℕ) :
    ∃ C d : ℕ, ∀ x : SourceData,
      (fullReductionCode c).cost x + FullTy.size (materialize (reduce c x)) ≤
        bound C d (SourceTy.size x) := by
  have h := fullReductionCode_polynomial c
  unfold Code.IsPoly at h
  simpa only [fullReductionCode_eval] using h

end FTC.Hardness.Encoding

namespace FTC.Hardness

open Computation Complexity Encoding

/-- The target problem on complete distance matrices and per-entry weights. -/

FTC.Hardness.fullGapSensitivity.source:
def fullGapSensitivity (α : ℝ) (hα : 1 ≤ α) (t : ℚ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    PromiseProblem FullTy where
  yes x := ∃ h : ValidFull x, α * (t : ℝ) ≤ fullSensitivity x h
  no x := ∃ h : ValidFull x, fullSensitivity x h < (t : ℝ)
  disjoint x hy hn := by
    obtain ⟨hy, hyes⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨hn, hno⟩ := hn
    have htR : 0 < (t : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ht
    change fullSensitivity x hy < (t : ℝ) at hno
    nlinarith

FTC.Hardness.materializeReduction.source:
def materializeReduction (α : ℝ) (hα : 1 ≤ α) (t : ℚ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    PolyReduction (gapSensitivity α hα t ht) (fullGapSensitivity α hα t ht) where
  program := materializeCode
  polynomial := materializeCode_polynomial
  yes x hx := by
    obtain ⟨h, hyes⟩ := hx
    rw [materializeCode_eval]
    exact ⟨materialize_valid x h, by rw [fullSensitivity_materialize x h]; exact hyes⟩
  no x hx := by
    obtain ⟨h, hno⟩ := hx
    rw [materializeCode_eval]
    exact ⟨materialize_valid x h, by rw [fullSensitivity_materialize x h]; exact hno⟩

FTC.Hardness.fullGapReduction.source:
def fullGapReduction {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (params : GapParameters ρ α) :
    PolyReduction (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ))
      (fullGapSensitivity α hα params.threshold params.threshold_pos) :=
  (gapReduction hα hαρ params).comp
    (materializeReduction α hα params.threshold params.threshold_pos)

/-- Theorem 4.2 with an ordinary explicit matrix/weight-list target encoding. -/

FTC.Hardness.theorem_4_2_full_matrix.source:
theorem theorem_4_2_full_matrix {ρ δ : ℝ}
    (hρ : 1 < ρ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδsmall : δ < ρ - 1)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ hρ)) :
    ∃ params : GapParameters ρ (ρ - δ),
      NPHard (fullGapSensitivity (ρ - δ) (by linarith)
        params.threshold params.threshold_pos) := by
  obtain ⟨params⟩ := paper_gapParameters_nonempty hρ hδ hδsmall
  exact ⟨params, hhard.of_reduction (fullGapReduction (by linarith) (by linarith) params)⟩

/-- An approximation algorithm on unrestricted ordinary matrix inputs. -/

FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesFullSensitivity.source:
def ApproximatesFullSensitivity (α : ℝ) (algorithm : Code FullTy RatTy) : Prop :=
  ∀ x (h : ValidFull x),
    fullSensitivity x h / α ≤ (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) ∧
      (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) ≤ fullSensitivity x h

FTC.Hardness.approximation_on_materializ.source:
theorem approximation_on_materialized_inputs {α : ℝ} {algorithm : Code FullTy RatTy}
    (h : ApproximatesFullSensitivity α algorithm) :
    ApproximatesSensitivity α (.comp materializeCode algorithm) := by
  intro x hx
  have happrox := h (materialize x) (materialize_valid x hx)
  rw [fullSensitivity_materialize x hx] at happrox
  simpa only [Code.eval, materializeCode_eval] using happrox

FTC.Hardness.full_approximation_implies_.source:
theorem full_approximation_implies_np_subset_p {ρ α : ℝ}
    (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) (params : GapParameters ρ α)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ)))
    {algorithm : Code FullTy RatTy} (hpoly : algorithm.IsPoly)
    (happrox : ApproximatesFullSensitivity α algorithm) :
    ∀ L : List Bool → Prop, InNP L → InP L :=
  approximation_implies_np_subset_p hα hαρ params hhard
    (materializeCode_polynomial.comp hpoly) (approximation_on_materialized_inputs happrox)

/-- The usual impossibility consequence, with NP ≠ P stated as an explicit
language witness in the same bit-cost model. -/

FTC.Hardness.no_polynomial_full_approxim.source:
theorem no_polynomial_full_approximation {ρ α : ℝ}
    (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) (params : GapParameters ρ α)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ)))
    (hseparation : ∃ L : List Bool → Prop, InNP L ∧ ¬ InP L) :
    ¬ ∃ algorithm : Code FullTy RatTy,
      algorithm.IsPoly ∧ ApproximatesFullSensitivity α algorithm := by
  rintro ⟨algorithm, hpoly, happrox⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hnot⟩ := hseparation
  exact hnot (full_approximation_implies_np_subset_p hα hαρ params hhard hpoly happrox L hL)

/-- Any externally established open interval of gap-hardness factors transfers
to pointwise sensitivity approximation on full matrix inputs. In particular,
the paper's cited k-means hardness family can be supplied with R = 1 + 8/e. -/

FTC.Hardness.sensitivity_hardness_below_.source:
theorem sensitivity_hardness_below_limit {R α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαR : α < R)
    (hbase : ∀ ρ : ℝ, ∀ hρ : 1 < ρ, ρ < R → NPHard (gapKMeans ρ hρ)) :
    ∃ (t : ℚ) (ht : 0 < t), NPHard (fullGapSensitivity α hα t ht) := by
  let ρ := (α + R) / 2
  have hαρ : α < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; linarith
  have hρR : ρ < R := by dsimp [ρ]; linarith
  obtain ⟨params⟩ := gapParameters_nonempty hα hαρ
  exact ⟨params.threshold, params.threshold_pos,
    (hbase ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ) hρR).of_reduction (fullGapReduction hα hαρ params)⟩

end FTC.Hardness

FTC.Hardness.GapParameters.source:
structure GapParameters (ρ α : ℝ) where
  copies : ℕ
  copies_pos : 0 < copies
  threshold : ℚ
  threshold_pos : 0 < threshold
  no_lt : 1 / (1 + (copies : ℝ) * ρ) < (threshold : ℝ)
  yes_le : (threshold : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (α * (1 + (copies : ℝ)))

/-- Explicit integer amplification and rational separation exist for every
constant slack, including irrational approximation factors. -/

FTC.Hardness.gapParameters_nonempty.source:
theorem gapParameters_nonempty {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ) :
    Nonempty (GapParameters ρ α) := by
  have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hα
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := hαpos.trans hαρ
  have hgap : 0 < ρ - α := sub_pos.mpr hαρ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_nat_gt (ρ / (ρ - α))
  have hcposR : 0 < (c : ℝ) := (div_pos hρpos hgap).trans hc
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by exact_mod_cast hcposR
  have hlarge : ρ < (c : ℝ) * (ρ - α) := (div_lt_iff₀ hgap).mp hc
  have hsep : α * (1 + (c : ℝ)) < 1 + (c : ℝ) * ρ := by nlinarith
  have hleft : 0 < 1 + (c : ℝ) * ρ := by positivity
  have hright : 0 < α * (1 + (c : ℝ)) := by positivity
  have hinv : 1 / (1 + (c : ℝ) * ρ) < 1 / (α * (1 + (c : ℝ))) := by
    exact (div_lt_div_iff₀ hleft hright).mpr (by simpa using hsep)
  obtain ⟨t, htleft, htright⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hinv
  have htpos : 0 < t := by
    exact_mod_cast (div_pos zero_lt_one hleft).trans htleft
  exact ⟨⟨c, hcpos, t, htpos, htleft, htright.le⟩⟩

/-- A concrete weight, using only the input threshold and a diameter bound. -/

FTC.Hardness.amplification.source: noncomputable def amplification (c : ℕ) (D B : ℝ) : ℝ := (c : ℝ) * D ^ 2 / B

FTC.Hardness.amplified_sensitivity_formu.source:
theorem amplified_sensitivity_formula (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) {D B : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hB : 0 < B)
    {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := k) D (amplification c D B))
      (extendedClients P) none = B / (B + (c : ℝ) * optimum P hk hkX) := by
  have hL := amplification_pos hc hD hB
  have hopt := optimum_nonneg P hk hkX
  have hcR : 0 ≤ (c : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg c
  have hden : 0 < D ^ 2 + amplification c D B * optimum P hk hkX := by positivity
  have hden' : 0 < B + (c : ℝ) * optimum P hk hkX := by positivity
  rw [sensitivity_formula P hk hkX D hD hL.le]
  apply (div_eq_div_iff hden.ne' hden'.ne').mpr
  unfold amplification
  field_simp

/-- YES instances land above the α-times-threshold side of the target gap. -/

FTC.Hardness.sensitivity_yes.source:
theorem sensitivity_yes (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X)
    {ρ α D B : ℝ} (params : GapParameters ρ α) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hD : 0 < D) (hB : 0 < B) (hyes : optimum P hk hkX ≤ B) :
    α * (params.threshold : ℝ) ≤
      sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := k) D (amplification params.copies D B))
        (extendedClients P) none := by
  rw [amplified_sensitivity_formula P hk hkX hD hB params.copies_pos]
  have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hα
  have hc : 0 ≤ (params.copies : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hc1 : 0 < 1 + (params.copies : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hden : 0 < B + (params.copies : ℝ) * optimum P hk hkX :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hB (mul_nonneg hc (optimum_nonneg P hk hkX))
  have hsmall : α * (params.threshold : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (1 + (params.copies : ℝ)) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hc1).mpr
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hαpos hc1)).mp params.yes_le
    nlinarith
  apply hsmall.trans
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hc1 hden).mpr
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyes hc
  nlinarith

/-- NO instances land strictly below the rational threshold. -/

FTC.Hardness.sensitivity_no.source:
theorem sensitivity_no (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X)
    {ρ α D B : ℝ} (params : GapParameters ρ α) (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (hD : 0 < D) (hB : 0 < B) (hno : ρ * B < optimum P hk hkX) :
    sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := k) D (amplification params.copies D B))
      (extendedClients P) none < (params.threshold : ℝ) := by
  rw [amplified_sensitivity_formula P hk hkX hD hB params.copies_pos]
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hα).trans hαρ
  have hc : 0 < (params.copies : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast params.copies_pos
  have hden : 0 < B + (params.copies : ℝ) * optimum P hk hkX :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hB (mul_nonneg hc.le (optimum_nonneg P hk hkX))
  have hden' : 0 < 1 + (params.copies : ℝ) * ρ := by positivity
  apply lt_trans _ params.no_lt
  apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ hden hden').mpr
  have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hno hc
  nlinarith

/-- A single approximate sensitivity value decides the promised gap instance.
The bound is the approximation convention used throughout the paper:
`σ / α ≤ score ≤ σ`. -/

FTC.Hardness.gap_decision_of_approximati.source:
theorem gap_decision_of_approximation (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) {ρ α D B score : ℝ}
    (params : GapParameters ρ α) (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (hD : 0 < D) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hpromise : optimum P hk hkX ≤ B ∨ ρ * B < optimum P hk hkX)
    (hlower : sensitivity
      (gadgetContribution (k := k) D (amplification params.copies D B))
      (extendedClients P) none / α ≤ score)
    (hupper : score ≤ sensitivity
      (gadgetContribution (k := k) D (amplification params.copies D B))
      (extendedClients P) none) :
    (params.threshold : ℝ) ≤ score ↔ optimum P hk hkX ≤ B := by
  have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hα
  constructor
  · intro ht
    rcases hpromise with hy | hn
    · exact hy
    · have hbad := sensitivity_no P hk hkX params hα hαρ hD hB hn
      exact False.elim ((not_le_of_gt hbad) (ht.trans hupper))
  · intro hy
    have hgood := sensitivity_yes P hk hkX params hα hD hB hy
    have h := (div_le_iff₀ hαpos).mp hlower
    nlinarith

/-- The parameters in Theorem 4.2 satisfy the more general reduction above. -/

FTC.Hardness.paper_gapParameters_nonempt.source:
theorem paper_gapParameters_nonempty {ρ δ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδsmall : δ < ρ - 1) :
    Nonempty (GapParameters ρ (ρ - δ)) :=
  gapParameters_nonempty (by linarith) (by linarith)

end FTC.Hardness

FTC.Hardness.gapKMeans.source:
def gapKMeans (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 1 < ρ) : PromiseProblem SourceTy where
  yes x := ∃ h : ValidSource x, originalOptimum x.1 h.base ≤ (rational x.2 : ℝ)
  no x := ∃ h : ValidSource x, ρ * (rational x.2 : ℝ) < originalOptimum x.1 h.base
  disjoint x hy hn := by
    obtain ⟨hy, hyes⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨hn, hno⟩ := hn
    have hB : 0 < (rational x.2 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast rational_pos hy.budget_pos
    change ρ * (rational x.2 : ℝ) < originalOptimum x.1 hy.base at hno
    nlinarith

/-- The sensitivity gap that every α-approximation can decide by comparison
with t. The metric has one distinguished point and otherwise arbitrary
rational distances; all k centers may be chosen anywhere in the metric. -/

FTC.Hardness.gapSensitivity.source:
def gapSensitivity (α : ℝ) (hα : 1 ≤ α) (t : ℚ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    PromiseProblem TargetTy where
  yes x := ∃ h : ValidTarget x, α * (t : ℝ) ≤ targetSensitivity x h
  no x := ∃ h : ValidTarget x, targetSensitivity x h < (t : ℝ)
  disjoint x hy hn := by
    obtain ⟨hy, hyes⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨hn, hno⟩ := hn
    have htR : 0 < (t : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ht
    change targetSensitivity x hy < (t : ℝ) at hno
    nlinarith

/-- The executable, polynomial, promise-preserving reduction of Appendix B. -/

FTC.Hardness.gapReduction.source:
def gapReduction {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (params : GapParameters ρ α) :
    PolyReduction (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ))
      (gapSensitivity α hα params.threshold params.threshold_pos) where
  program := reductionCode params.copies
  polynomial := reductionCode_polynomial params.copies
  yes x hx := by
    obtain ⟨h, hyes⟩ := hx
    rw [reductionCode_eval]
    refine ⟨reduce_valid params.copies_pos h, ?_⟩
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    rw [reduce_sensitivity_eq_gadget params.copies_pos x h]
    exact sensitivity_yes (clients x.1) h.base.centers_pos h.base.centers_le_card
      params hα (by exact_mod_cast radius_pos x.1)
      (by exact_mod_cast rational_pos h.budget_pos) hyes
  no x hx := by
    obtain ⟨h, hno⟩ := hx
    rw [reductionCode_eval]
    refine ⟨reduce_valid params.copies_pos h, ?_⟩
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    rw [reduce_sensitivity_eq_gadget params.copies_pos x h]
    exact sensitivity_no (clients x.1) h.base.centers_pos h.base.centers_le_card
      params hα hαρ (by exact_mod_cast radius_pos x.1)
      (by exact_mod_cast rational_pos h.budget_pos) hno

FTC.Hardness.npHard_sensitivity_of_gap.source:
theorem npHard_sensitivity_of_gap {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (params : GapParameters ρ α)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ))) :
    NPHard (gapSensitivity α hα params.threshold params.threshold_pos) :=
  hhard.of_reduction (gapReduction hα hαρ params)

/-- Theorem 4.2, with the paper's parameters and its source-hardness premise.
The rational threshold is fixed independently of the input instance. -/

FTC.Hardness.theorem_4_2.source:
theorem theorem_4_2 {ρ δ : ℝ} (hρ : 1 < ρ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδsmall : δ < ρ - 1)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ hρ)) :
    ∃ params : GapParameters ρ (ρ - δ),
      NPHard (gapSensitivity (ρ - δ) (by linarith) params.threshold params.threshold_pos) := by
  obtain ⟨params⟩ := paper_gapParameters_nonempty hρ hδ hδsmall
  exact ⟨params, npHard_sensitivity_of_gap (by linarith) (by linarith) params hhard⟩

/-! ## Thresholding any polynomial approximation program -/

FTC.Hardness.rational_encodeRational.source:
theorem rational_encodeRational (t : ℚ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : rational (encodeRational t) = t := by
  have hden : t.den - 1 + 1 = t.den := Nat.sub_add_cancel t.pos
  have hdenQ : ((t.den - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1 = (t.den : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hden
  have hnumZ : (t.num.natAbs : ℤ) = t.num := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (Rat.num_nonneg.mpr ht)
  have hnumQ : (t.num.natAbs : ℚ) = (t.num : ℚ) := by
    simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℚ)) hnumZ
  change (t.num.natAbs : ℚ) / (((t.den - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) = t
  rw [hnumQ, hdenQ]
  exact t.num_div_den

FTC.Hardness.rational_le_iff.source:
theorem rational_le_iff (q r : RatData) :
    rational q ≤ rational r ↔ q.1 * (r.2 + 1) ≤ r.1 * (q.2 + 1) := by
  unfold rational
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (q.2 : ℚ) + 1)
    (by positivity : 0 < (r.2 : ℚ) + 1)]
  exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl

FTC.Hardness.thresholdCode.source:
def thresholdCode (q : RatData) : Code RatTy .bool :=
  .comp
    (.pair
      (.comp (.pair (.const q.1) (.comp (.pair .snd (.const 1)) .add)) .mul)
      (.comp (.pair .fst (.const (q.2 + 1))) .mul)) .le

FTC.Hardness.thresholdCode_correct.source:
theorem thresholdCode_correct (q r : RatData) :
    (thresholdCode q).eval r = true ↔ rational q ≤ rational r := by
  simp only [thresholdCode, Code.eval, decide_eq_true_eq, rational_le_iff]

FTC.Hardness.thresholdCode_polynomial.source:
theorem thresholdCode_polynomial (q : RatData) : (thresholdCode q).IsPoly := by
  unfold thresholdCode
  repeat first
    | apply Code.IsPoly.comp
    | apply Code.IsPoly.pair
    | exact Code.poly_const _
    | exact Code.poly_fst
    | exact Code.poly_snd
    | exact Code.poly_add
    | exact Code.poly_mul
    | exact Code.poly_le

/-- The paper's one-sided approximation convention, on every valid input. -/

FTC.Hardness.ApproximatesSensitivity.source:
def ApproximatesSensitivity (α : ℝ) (algorithm : Code TargetTy RatTy) : Prop :=
  ∀ x (h : ValidTarget x),
    targetSensitivity x h / α ≤ (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) ∧
      (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) ≤ targetSensitivity x h

FTC.Hardness.approximationDecider.source:
def approximationDecider (t : ℚ) (algorithm : Code TargetTy RatTy) : Code TargetTy .bool :=
  .comp algorithm (thresholdCode (encodeRational t))

FTC.Hardness.approximationDecider_solves.source:
theorem approximationDecider_solves {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) {t : ℚ} (ht : 0 < t)
    {algorithm : Code TargetTy RatTy} (happrox : ApproximatesSensitivity α algorithm) :
    Solves (approximationDecider t algorithm) (gapSensitivity α hα t ht) := by
  have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hα
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h, hyes⟩ := hx
    have ha := (happrox x h).1
    have hscore : (t : ℝ) ≤ (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) := by
      have h := (div_le_iff₀ hαpos).mp ha
      nlinarith
    apply (thresholdCode_correct _ _).mpr
    rw [rational_encodeRational t ht.le]
    exact_mod_cast hscore
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h, hno⟩ := hx
    have hscore : (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) < (t : ℝ) :=
      (happrox x h).2.trans_lt hno
    apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
    intro heq
    have hle := (thresholdCode_correct (encodeRational t) (algorithm.eval x)).mp heq
    rw [rational_encodeRational t ht.le] at hle
    have hleR : (t : ℝ) ≤ (rational (algorithm.eval x) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
    exact (not_le_of_gt hscore) hleR

/-- A polynomial α-approximation, together with source gap hardness, puts
every NP language in P in the specified bit-cost model. -/

FTC.Hardness.approximation_implies_np_su.source:
theorem approximation_implies_np_subset_p {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (params : GapParameters ρ α)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ)))
    {algorithm : Code TargetTy RatTy} (hpoly : algorithm.IsPoly)
    (happrox : ApproximatesSensitivity α algorithm) :
    ∀ L : List Bool → Prop, InNP L → InP L := by
  intro L hL
  exact (npHard_sensitivity_of_gap hα hαρ params hhard).inP_of_solver
    (approximationDecider_polynomial params.threshold hpoly)
    (approximationDecider_solves hα params.threshold_pos happrox) hL

FTC.Hardness.no_polynomial_approximation.source:
theorem no_polynomial_approximation {ρ α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) (hαρ : α < ρ)
    (params : GapParameters ρ α)
    (hhard : NPHard (gapKMeans ρ (lt_of_le_of_lt hα hαρ)))
    (hseparation : ∃ L : List Bool → Prop, InNP L ∧ ¬ InP L) :
    ¬ ∃ algorithm : Code TargetTy RatTy, algorithm.IsPoly ∧ ApproximatesSensitivity α algorithm := by
  rintro ⟨algorithm, hpoly, happrox⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hnot⟩ := hseparation
  exact hnot (approximation_implies_np_subset_p hα hαρ params hhard hpoly happrox L hL)

end FTC.Hardness

FTC.Hardness.oldPoint.source: def oldPoint : X ↪ Option X := ⟨some, Option.some_injective X⟩

FTC.Hardness.oldPoint_apply.source: @[simp] theorem oldPoint_apply (x : X) : oldPoint x = some x := rfl

FTC.Hardness.extensionDist.source:
noncomputable def extensionDist (D : ℝ) : Option X → Option X → ℝ
  | none, none => 0
  | none, some _ => D
  | some _, none => D
  | some x, some y => dist x y

/-- The actual metric used by the hardness gadget. -/

FTC.Hardness.extensionMetric.source:
@[reducible] noncomputable def extensionMetric (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hdiam : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ D) : MetricSpace (Option X) where
  dist := extensionDist D
  dist_self x := by cases x <;> simp [extensionDist]
  dist_comm x y := by cases x <;> cases y <;> simp [extensionDist, dist_comm]
  dist_triangle x y z := by
    cases x <;> cases y <;> cases z <;> simp only [extensionDist]
    · norm_num
    · simp
    · linarith
    · rename_i x y
      have := dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y); linarith
    · simp
    · rename_i x y
      have := hdiam x y; linarith
    · rename_i x y
      have := dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y); linarith
    · exact dist_triangle _ _ _
  eq_of_dist_eq_zero := by
    intro x y h
    cases x <;> cases y
    · rfl
    · exact False.elim (hD.ne' h)
    · exact False.elim (hD.ne' h)
    · exact congrArg some (dist_eq_zero.mp h)

FTC.Hardness.extensionDist_old.source:
@[simp] theorem extensionDist_old (D : ℝ) (x y : X) :
    extensionDist D (some x) (some y) = dist x y := rfl

FTC.Hardness.extensionDist_new_old.source:
@[simp] theorem extensionDist_new_old (D : ℝ) (x : X) :
    extensionDist D none (some x) = D := rfl

omit [DecidableEq X] [MetricSpace X] in

FTC.Hardness.centerSet_ext.source:
theorem centerSet_ext {C E : CenterSet X k} (h : C.centers = E.centers) : C = E := by
  cases C
  cases E
  cases h
  rfl

/-- Lift an original query without adding a center. -/

FTC.Hardness.liftCenters.source:
def liftCenters (C : CenterSet X k) : CenterSet (Option X) k where
  centers := C.centers.map oldPoint
  card_eq := by simpa using C.card_eq
  nonempty := C.nonempty.map

FTC.Hardness.none_not_liftCenters.source:
@[simp] theorem none_not_liftCenters (C : CenterSet X k) :
    none ∉ (liftCenters C).centers := by simp [liftCenters, Finset.mem_map]

FTC.Hardness.some_mem_liftCenters.source:
@[simp] theorem some_mem_liftCenters (C : CenterSet X k) (x : X) :
    some x ∈ (liftCenters C).centers ↔ x ∈ C.centers := by
  simp [liftCenters, Finset.mem_map]

section Finite

variable [Fintype X]

FTC.Hardness.oldCenters.source:
def oldCenters (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) : Finset X :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x => some x ∈ C.centers)

FTC.Hardness.mem_oldCenters.source:
@[simp] theorem mem_oldCenters (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) (x : X) :
    x ∈ oldCenters C ↔ some x ∈ C.centers := by simp [oldCenters]

FTC.Hardness.map_oldCenters.source:
theorem map_oldCenters (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) (h : none ∉ C.centers) :
    (oldCenters C).map oldPoint = C.centers := by
  ext x
  cases x with
  | none => simp [Finset.mem_map, h]
  | some x => simp [Finset.mem_map]

/-- A query avoiding the new point is precisely an original k-center query. -/

FTC.Hardness.lowerCenters.source:
def lowerCenters (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) (h : none ∉ C.centers) : CenterSet X k where
  centers := oldCenters C
  card_eq := by
    have hc := congrArg Finset.card (map_oldCenters C h)
    simpa [C.card_eq] using hc
  nonempty := by
    have hn : ((oldCenters C).map oldPoint).Nonempty :=
      (map_oldCenters C h).symm ▸ C.nonempty
    exact Finset.map_nonempty.mp hn

FTC.Hardness.lift_lowerCenters.source:
theorem lift_lowerCenters (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) (h : none ∉ C.centers) :
    liftCenters (lowerCenters C h) = C :=
  centerSet_ext (map_oldCenters C h)

end Finite

/-- Squared-distance loss in the extended metric, kept independent of the
metric-space instance so the numerical formulas have no proof parameters. -/

FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss.source:
noncomputable def extensionLoss (D : ℝ) (p : Option X)
    (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) : ℝ :=
  C.centers.inf' C.nonempty (fun x => extensionDist D p x ^ 2)

FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss_nonneg.source:
theorem extensionLoss_nonneg (D : ℝ) (p : Option X) (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) :
    0 ≤ extensionLoss D p C :=
  Finset.le_inf' _ _ (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)

FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss_eq_kmeansLoss.source:
theorem extensionLoss_eq_kmeansLoss (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hdiam : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ D) (p : Option X) (C : CenterSet (Option X) k) :
    letI := extensionMetric D hD hdiam
    extensionLoss D p C = kmeansLoss p C := rfl

FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss_old_lift.source:
@[simp] theorem extensionLoss_old_lift (D : ℝ) (p : X) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    extensionLoss D (some p) (liftCenters C) = kmeansLoss p C := by
  simp [extensionLoss, liftCenters, Finset.inf'_map, extensionDist, kmeansLoss]

FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss_new_lift.source:
@[simp] theorem extensionLoss_new_lift (D : ℝ) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    extensionLoss D none (liftCenters C) = D ^ 2 := by
  simp [extensionLoss, liftCenters, Finset.inf'_map, extensionDist]

FTC.Hardness.extensionLoss_new_of_mem.source:
theorem extensionLoss_new_of_mem (D : ℝ) (C : CenterSet (Option X) k)
    (h : none ∈ C.centers) : extensionLoss D none C = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · change C.centers.inf' C.nonempty (fun x => extensionDist D none x ^ 2) ≤ 0
    calc
      _ ≤ extensionDist D none none ^ 2 := Finset.inf'_le _ h
      _ = 0 := by simp [extensionDist]
  · exact extensionLoss_nonneg D none C

/-- One old entry per original client, plus the single distinguished entry. -/

FTC.Hardness.extendedClients.source:
def extendedClients (P : Finset X) : Finset (Option X) :=
  insert none (P.map oldPoint)

FTC.Hardness.none_mem_extendedClients.source:
@[simp] theorem none_mem_extendedClients (P : Finset X) : none ∈ extendedClients P := by
  simp [extendedClients]

FTC.Hardness.extendedClients_card.source:
@[simp] theorem extendedClients_card (P : Finset X) : (extendedClients P).card = P.card + 1 := by
  simp [extendedClients, Finset.mem_map]

/-- Old clients have weight L, while the distinguished point has weight one. -/

FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution.source:
noncomputable def gadgetContribution (D L : ℝ) : Option X → CenterSet (Option X) k → ℝ
  | none, C => extensionLoss D none C
  | some x, C => L * extensionLoss D (some x) C

FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution_nonneg.source:
theorem gadgetContribution_nonneg (D : ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∀ i (C : CenterSet (Option X) k), 0 ≤ gadgetContribution D L i C := by
  intro i C
  cases i
  · exact extensionLoss_nonneg D none C
  · exact mul_nonneg hL (extensionLoss_nonneg D _ C)

FTC.Hardness.gadgetContribution_eq_weigh.source:
theorem gadgetContribution_eq_weightedLoss (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hdiam : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ D) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    letI := extensionMetric D hD hdiam
    gadgetContribution (X := X) (k := k) D L = weightedLoss (gadgetEntries L hL) := by
  letI := extensionMetric D hD hdiam
  funext i C
  cases i <;> simp only [gadgetContribution, weightedLoss, contribution, gadgetEntries, one_mul]
  all_goals rfl

FTC.Hardness.gadgetCost_lift.source:
@[simp] theorem gadgetCost_lift (P : Finset X) (D L : ℝ) (C : CenterSet X k) :
    cost (gadgetContribution D L) (extendedClients P) (liftCenters C) =
      D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P C := by
  simp [cost, extendedClients, Finset.sum_insert, Finset.mem_map,
    gadgetContribution, Finset.sum_map, ← Finset.mul_sum]

end FTC.Hardness

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational.source: def rational (q : RatData) : ℚ := (q.1 : ℚ) / ((q.2 : ℚ) + 1)

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational_nonneg.source:
theorem rational_nonneg (q : RatData) : 0 ≤ rational q := by
  unfold rational
  positivity

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational_pos.source:
theorem rational_pos {q : RatData} (h : 0 < q.1) : 0 < rational q := by
  unfold rational
  positivity

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.rational_le_numera.source:
theorem rational_le_numerator (q : RatData) : rational q ≤ (q.1 : ℚ) := by
  unfold rational
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (q.2 : ℚ) + 1)).mpr
  have h := mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℚ) ≤ q.1 by positivity)
    (show (0 : ℚ) ≤ q.2 by positivity)
  nlinarith

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidBase.source:
structure ValidBase (b : BaseData) : Prop where
  square : ∀ row ∈ b.1, row.length = pointCount b
  clients_length : b.2.1.length = pointCount b
  self : ∀ x, matrixDistance b.1 x x = 0
  comm : ∀ x y, matrixDistance b.1 x y = matrixDistance b.1 y x
  triangle : ∀ x y z, matrixDistance b.1 x z ≤ matrixDistance b.1 x y + matrixDistance b.1 y z
  eq_of_zero : ∀ x y, matrixDistance b.1 x y = 0 → x = y
  centers_pos : 0 < centerCount b
  centers_le : centerCount b ≤ pointCount b

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidBase.metric.source:
def ValidBase.metric {b : BaseData} (h : ValidBase b) : RationalMetric (Fin (pointCount b)) where
  distance := matrixDistance b.1
  self := h.self
  comm := h.comm
  triangle := h.triangle
  eq_of_zero := h.eq_of_zero

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.clients.source:
def clients (b : BaseData) : Finset (Fin (pointCount b)) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x => b.2.1.getD x false = true)

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidBase.centers_.source:
theorem ValidBase.centers_le_card {b : BaseData} (h : ValidBase b) :
    centerCount b ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (pointCount b)) := by simpa using h.centers_le

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.originalOptimum.source:
noncomputable def originalOptimum (b : BaseData) (h : ValidBase b) : ℝ :=
  letI := h.metric.toMetricSpace
  optimum (clients b) h.centers_pos h.centers_le_card

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidSource.source:
structure ValidSource (x : SourceData) : Prop where
  base : ValidBase x.1
  budget_pos : 0 < x.2.1

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidTarget.source:
structure ValidTarget (x : TargetData) : Prop where
  base : ValidBase x.1
  radius_pos : 0 < x.2.1
  radius_bound : ∀ i j : Fin (pointCount x.1), matrixDistance x.1.1 i j ≤ (x.2.1 : ℚ)
  weight_pos : 0 < x.2.2.1

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.radius.source: def radius (b : BaseData) : ℕ := maximum (b.1.flatten.map Prod.fst) + 1

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.radius_pos.source: theorem radius_pos (b : BaseData) : 0 < radius b := Nat.succ_pos _

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.matrixDistance_le_.source:
theorem matrixDistance_le_radius {b : BaseData} (h : ValidBase b)
    (i j : Fin (pointCount b)) : matrixDistance b.1 i j ≤ (radius b : ℚ) := by
  have hrow : b.1.getD i [] ∈ b.1 := by
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ i.isLt]
    exact List.getElem_mem _
  have hlen := h.square _ hrow
  have hj : (j : ℕ) < (b.1.getD i []).length := hlen.symm ▸ j.isLt
  have hentry : (b.1.getD i []).getD j (0, 0) ∈ b.1.flatten := by
    apply List.mem_flatten.mpr
    refine ⟨b.1.getD i [], hrow, ?_⟩
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hj]
    exact List.getElem_mem _
  have hnum := le_maximum_of_mem (List.mem_map_of_mem (f := Prod.fst) hentry)
  calc
    matrixDistance b.1 i j ≤ (((b.1.getD i []).getD j (0, 0)).1 : ℚ) :=
      rational_le_numerator _
    _ ≤ (maximum (b.1.flatten.map Prod.fst) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hnum
    _ ≤ (radius b : ℚ) := by unfold radius; push_cast; linarith

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.weight.source:
def weight (c D : ℕ) (B : RatData) : RatData :=
  (c * D ^ 2 * (B.2 + 1), B.1 - 1)

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.weight_pos.source:
theorem weight_pos {c D : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) (hD : 0 < D)
    {B : RatData} (hB : 0 < B.1) : 0 < (weight c D B).1 := by
  dsimp [weight]
  positivity

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.weight_value.source:
theorem weight_value (c D : ℕ) (B : RatData) (hB : 0 < B.1) :
    (rational (weight c D B) : ℝ) = amplification c (D : ℝ) (rational B : ℝ) := by
  have hsub : B.1 - 1 + 1 = B.1 := Nat.sub_add_cancel hB
  have hnum : (B.1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hB)
  have hden : (B.2 : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hsubR : ((B.1 - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = (B.1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsub
  simp only [rational, weight, amplification, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_add,
    Rat.cast_natCast, Rat.cast_one, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hsubR]
  push_cast
  field_simp

/-- The complete raw transformation. It is defined even on malformed inputs;
the correctness proof uses only the source promise. -/

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reduce.source:
def reduce (c : ℕ) (x : SourceData) : TargetData :=
  (x.1, (radius x.1, weight c (radius x.1) x.2))

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reduce_valid.source:
theorem reduce_valid {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) {x : SourceData} (h : ValidSource x) :
    ValidTarget (reduce c x) where
  base := h.base
  radius_pos := radius_pos x.1
  radius_bound := matrixDistance_le_radius h.base
  weight_pos := weight_pos hc (radius_pos x.1) h.budget_pos

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.ValidTarget.real_r.source:
theorem ValidTarget.real_radius_pos {x : TargetData} (h : ValidTarget x) :
    0 < (x.2.1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h.radius_pos

theorem ValidTarget.real_radius_bound {x : TargetData} (h : ValidTarget x) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    ∀ i j : Fin (pointCount x.1), dist i j ≤ (x.2.1 : ℝ) := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  intro i j
  change (matrixDistance x.1.1 i j : ℝ) ≤ (x.2.1 : ℝ)
  exact_mod_cast h.radius_bound i j

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.real_weight_nonneg.source:
theorem real_weight_nonneg (q : RatData) : 0 ≤ (rational q : ℝ) := by
  exact_mod_cast rational_nonneg q

/-- The target's value is the genuine weighted k-means sensitivity on its
explicit `(n+1)`-point metric, with exactly k unrestricted centers. -/

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.targetSensitivity.source:
noncomputable def targetSensitivity (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x) : ℝ :=
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  letI := extensionMetric (x.2.1 : ℝ) h.real_radius_pos h.real_radius_bound
  sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := centerCount x.1)
    (gadgetEntries (rational x.2.2 : ℝ) (real_weight_nonneg x.2.2)))
    (extendedClients (clients x.1)) none

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.targetSensitivity_.source:
theorem targetSensitivity_eq_gadget (x : TargetData) (h : ValidTarget x) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    targetSensitivity x h =
      sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := centerCount x.1)
        (x.2.1 : ℝ) (rational x.2.2 : ℝ)) (extendedClients (clients x.1)) none := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  unfold targetSensitivity
  rw [← gadgetContribution_eq_weightedLoss (x.2.1 : ℝ) h.real_radius_pos
    h.real_radius_bound (real_weight_nonneg x.2.2)]

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reduce_sensitivity.source:
theorem reduce_sensitivity_formula {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : SourceData) (h : ValidSource x) :
    targetSensitivity (reduce c x) (reduce_valid hc h) =
      (rational x.2 : ℝ) / ((rational x.2 : ℝ) + (c : ℝ) * originalOptimum x.1 h.base) := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  rw [targetSensitivity_eq_gadget]
  change sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := centerCount x.1)
    (radius x.1 : ℝ) (rational (weight c (radius x.1) x.2) : ℝ))
      (extendedClients (clients x.1)) none = _
  rw [weight_value c (radius x.1) x.2 h.budget_pos]
  exact amplified_sensitivity_formula (clients x.1) h.base.centers_pos h.base.centers_le_card
    (by exact_mod_cast radius_pos x.1) (by exact_mod_cast rational_pos h.budget_pos) hc

theorem reduce_sensitivity_eq_gadget {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (x : SourceData) (h : ValidSource x) :
    letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
    targetSensitivity (reduce c x) (reduce_valid hc h) =
      sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := centerCount x.1) (radius x.1 : ℝ)
        (amplification c (radius x.1 : ℝ) (rational x.2 : ℝ)))
        (extendedClients (clients x.1)) none := by
  letI := h.base.metric.toMetricSpace
  rw [targetSensitivity_eq_gadget]
  change sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := centerCount x.1)
    (radius x.1 : ℝ) (rational (weight c (radius x.1) x.2) : ℝ))
      (extendedClients (clients x.1)) none = _
  rw [weight_value c (radius x.1) x.2 h.budget_pos]

/-! ## The actual program and its polynomial certificate -/

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.weightCode.source:
def weightCode (c : ℕ) : Code SourceTy RatTy :=
  .pair
    (.comp
      (.pair
        (.comp (.pair (.const c) (.comp (.pair sourceRadiusCode sourceRadiusCode) .mul)) .mul)
        (.comp (.pair (.comp .snd .snd) (.const 1)) .add)) .mul)
    (.comp (.pair (.comp .snd .fst) (.const 1)) .sub)

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reductionCode.source:
def reductionCode (c : ℕ) : Code SourceTy TargetTy :=
  .pair .fst (.pair sourceRadiusCode (weightCode c))

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.radiusCode_eval.source:
@[simp] theorem radiusCode_eval (x : BaseData) : radiusCode.eval x = radius x := by
  simp only [radiusCode, Code.eval, radius]

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reductionCode_eval.source:
@[simp] theorem reductionCode_eval (c : ℕ) (x : SourceData) :
    (reductionCode c).eval x = reduce c x := by
  simp only [reductionCode, weightCode, sourceRadiusCode, Code.eval, radiusCode_eval,
    reduce, weight, pow_two]

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in

FTC.Hardness.Encoding.reductionCode_poly.source:
theorem reductionCode_polynomial (c : ℕ) : (reductionCode c).IsPoly := by
  unfold reductionCode weightCode sourceRadiusCode radiusCode
  repeat first
    | apply Code.IsPoly.comp
    | apply Code.IsPoly.pair
    | apply Code.IsPoly.map
    | exact Code.poly_fst
    | exact Code.poly_snd
    | exact Code.poly_const _
    | exact Code.poly_flatten
    | exact Code.poly_maximum
    | exact Code.poly_add
    | exact Code.poly_mul
    | exact Code.poly_sub

end FTC.Hardness.Encoding

FTC.Hardness.centerSet_nonempty.source:
theorem centerSet_nonempty (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) :
    Nonempty (CenterSet X k) := by
  obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq
    (show k ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset X).card by simpa using hkX)
  exact ⟨⟨C, hC, Finset.card_pos.mp (hC ▸ hk)⟩⟩

FTC.Hardness.exists_optimalCenters.source:
theorem exists_optimalCenters (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) :
    ∃ C : CenterSet X k, ∀ E : CenterSet X k, cost kmeansLoss P C ≤ cost kmeansLoss P E := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (CenterSet X k) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Nonempty (CenterSet X k) := centerSet_nonempty hk hkX
  obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image
    (Finset.univ : Finset (CenterSet X k)) (cost kmeansLoss P) Finset.univ_nonempty
  exact ⟨C, fun E => hC E (Finset.mem_univ E)⟩

FTC.Hardness.optimalCenters.source:
noncomputable def optimalCenters (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) :
    CenterSet X k := (exists_optimalCenters P hk hkX).choose

FTC.Hardness.optimum.source:
noncomputable def optimum (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) : ℝ :=
  cost kmeansLoss P (optimalCenters P hk hkX)

FTC.Hardness.optimum_nonneg.source:
theorem optimum_nonneg (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) :
    0 ≤ optimum P hk hkX := cost_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg _ _

FTC.Hardness.optimum_le.source:
theorem optimum_le (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X)
    (C : CenterSet X k) : optimum P hk hkX ≤ cost kmeansLoss P C :=
  (exists_optimalCenters P hk hkX).choose_spec C

/-- Exact identity, first stated with an arbitrary globally optimal center set. -/

FTC.Hardness.sensitivity_eq_of_optimal.source:
theorem sensitivity_eq_of_optimal (P : Finset X) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (Copt : CenterSet X k)
    (hopt : ∀ E : CenterSet X k, cost kmeansLoss P Copt ≤ cost kmeansLoss P E) :
    sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := k) D L) (extendedClients P) none =
      D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt) := by
  have hD2 : 0 < D ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hD
  have hc : 0 ≤ cost kmeansLoss P Copt := cost_nonneg kmeansLoss_nonneg _ _
  have hden : 0 < D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hD2 (mul_nonneg hL hc)
  have hr : 0 ≤ D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt) :=
    div_nonneg hD2.le hden.le
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le (gadgetContribution_nonneg D hL)
      (none_mem_extendedClients P) hr
    intro C
    by_cases hnew : none ∈ C.centers
    · simp only [gadgetContribution, extensionLoss_new_of_mem D C hnew]
      exact mul_nonneg hr (cost_nonneg (gadgetContribution_nonneg D hL) _ _)
    · rw [← lift_lowerCenters C hnew]
      simp only [gadgetContribution, extensionLoss_new_lift, gadgetCost_lift]
      calc
        D ^ 2 = (D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt)) *
            (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt) :=
          (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden.ne').symm
        _ ≤ (D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P Copt)) *
            (D ^ 2 + L * cost kmeansLoss P (lowerCenters C hnew)) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hopt _) hL) _) hr
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    have h := contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost (gadgetContribution_nonneg D hL)
      (none_mem_extendedClients P) (liftCenters Copt)
    simpa only [gadgetContribution, extensionLoss_new_lift, gadgetCost_lift] using h

/-- The exact identity claimed in the proof of Theorem 4.2. -/

FTC.Hardness.sensitivity_formula.source:
theorem sensitivity_formula (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k) (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X)
    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    sensitivity (gadgetContribution (k := k) D L) (extendedClients P) none =
      D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * optimum P hk hkX) :=
  sensitivity_eq_of_optimal P D hD hL (optimalCenters P hk hkX)
    (optimum_le P hk hkX)

/-- The same identity for the project's actual weighted metric k-means API. -/

FTC.Hardness.weighted_sensitivity_formul.source:
theorem weighted_sensitivity_formula (P : Finset X) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hkX : k ≤ Fintype.card X) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hdiam : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ D) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    letI := extensionMetric D hD hdiam
    sensitivity (weightedLoss (k := k) (gadgetEntries L hL)) (extendedClients P) none =
      D ^ 2 / (D ^ 2 + L * optimum P hk hkX) := by
  rw [← gadgetContribution_eq_weightedLoss D hD hdiam hL]
  exact sensitivity_formula P hk hkX D hD hL

end FTC.Hardness

FTC.LowerBound.BasisSpace.source:
abbrev BasisSpace (k : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)

/-- The standard basis vector `e_i`. -/

FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint.source:
noncomputable def basisPoint {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : BasisSpace k :=
  EuclideanSpace.single i 1

FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint_apply.source:
@[simp] theorem basisPoint_apply {k : ℕ} (i j : Fin k) :
    basisPoint i j = if j = i then 1 else 0 := by
  simp [basisPoint, PiLp.single_apply]

FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint_ne_zero.source:
@[simp] theorem basisPoint_ne_zero {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : basisPoint i ≠ 0 := by
  simp [basisPoint]

FTC.LowerBound.basisPoint_injective.source:
theorem basisPoint_injective {k : ℕ} : Function.Injective (@basisPoint k) := by
  intro i j h
  have h' := congrArg (fun x : BasisSpace k => x i) h
  by_contra hij
  simpa [basisPoint_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij] using h'

FTC.LowerBound.norm_basisPoint.source:
@[simp] theorem norm_basisPoint {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : ‖basisPoint i‖ = 1 := by
  simp [basisPoint]

FTC.LowerBound.dist_basisPoint_zero_sq.source:
@[simp] theorem dist_basisPoint_zero_sq {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    dist (basisPoint i) 0 ^ 2 = 1 := by
  simp

FTC.LowerBound.dist_basisPoint_sq_of_ne.source:
theorem dist_basisPoint_sq_of_ne {k : ℕ} {i j : Fin k} (h : i ≠ j) :
    dist (basisPoint i) (basisPoint j) ^ 2 = 2 := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_sq_real]
  norm_num [basisPoint, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, h]

/-- A genuine `k`-point Euclidean center set. -/

FTC.LowerBound.EuclideanQuery.source:
structure EuclideanQuery (k : ℕ) where
  centers : Finset (BasisSpace k)
  card_centers : centers.card = k
  nonempty : centers.Nonempty

/-- Squared distance to the closest center, the Euclidean `k`-means loss. -/

FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters.source:
noncomputable def sqDistToCenters {k : ℕ} (x : BasisSpace k) (S : EuclideanQuery k) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact S.centers.inf' S.nonempty (fun y => dist x y ^ 2)

FTC.LowerBound.sqDistToCenters_nonneg.source:
theorem sqDistToCenters_nonneg {k : ℕ} (x : BasisSpace k) (S : EuclideanQuery k) :
    0 ≤ sqDistToCenters x S := by
  classical
  apply Finset.le_inf'
  intro y _
  exact sq_nonneg _

/-- The query `{e_j : j ≠ i} ∪ {0}` used in Claim A.2. -/

FTC.LowerBound.witnessCenters.source:
noncomputable def witnessCenters {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : Finset (BasisSpace k) := by
  classical
  exact insert 0 ((Finset.univ.erase i).image basisPoint)

FTC.LowerBound.zero_mem_witnessCenters.source:
@[simp] theorem zero_mem_witnessCenters {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    (0 : BasisSpace k) ∈ witnessCenters i := by
  classical
  simp [witnessCenters]

FTC.LowerBound.mem_witnessCenters.source:
@[simp] theorem mem_witnessCenters {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (x : BasisSpace k) :
    x ∈ witnessCenters i ↔ x = 0 ∨ ∃ j : Fin k, j ≠ i ∧ basisPoint j = x := by
  classical
  simp [witnessCenters, Finset.mem_image]

FTC.LowerBound.card_witnessCenters.source:
@[simp] theorem card_witnessCenters {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    (witnessCenters i).card = k := by
  classical
  have hz : (0 : BasisSpace k) ∉ (Finset.univ.erase i).image basisPoint := by
    simp [Finset.mem_image]
  rw [witnessCenters, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hz,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ basisPoint_injective]
  simpa using Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_univ i)

FTC.LowerBound.witnessQuery.source:
noncomputable def witnessQuery {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : EuclideanQuery k where
  centers := witnessCenters i
  card_centers := card_witnessCenters i
  nonempty := ⟨0, zero_mem_witnessCenters i⟩

/-- The separating query charges exactly one unit at its omitted basis vector. -/

FTC.LowerBound.loss_witnessQuery_same.source:
theorem loss_witnessQuery_same {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    sqDistToCenters (basisPoint i) (witnessQuery i) = 1 := by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (Finset.inf'_le (fun y : BasisSpace k => dist (basisPoint i) y ^ 2)
      (zero_mem_witnessCenters i)).trans_eq (dist_basisPoint_zero_sq i)
  · apply Finset.le_inf'
    intro y hy
    rcases (mem_witnessCenters i y).1 hy with rfl | ⟨j, hji, rfl⟩
    · simp
    · rw [dist_basisPoint_sq_of_ne (Ne.symm hji)]
      norm_num

/-- Every other basis vector is itself a center and has zero loss. -/

FTC.LowerBound.loss_witnessQuery_other.source:
theorem loss_witnessQuery_other {k : ℕ} {i j : Fin k} (hji : j ≠ i) :
    sqDistToCenters (basisPoint j) (witnessQuery i) = 0 := by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hmem : basisPoint j ∈ witnessCenters i :=
      (mem_witnessCenters i (basisPoint j)).2 (Or.inr ⟨j, hji, rfl⟩)
    change (witnessCenters i).inf' _ (fun y => dist (basisPoint j) y ^ 2) ≤ 0
    calc
      _ ≤ dist (basisPoint j) (basisPoint j) ^ 2 := Finset.inf'_le _ hmem
      _ = 0 := by simp
  · apply Finset.le_inf'
    intro y _
    exact sq_nonneg _

FTC.LowerBound.loss_witnessQuery.source:
theorem loss_witnessQuery {k : ℕ} (i j : Fin k) :
    sqDistToCenters (basisPoint j) (witnessQuery i) = if j = i then 1 else 0 := by
  split_ifs with h
  · subst j
    exact loss_witnessQuery_same i
  · exact loss_witnessQuery_other h

/-- Unweighted cost of the basis input `P = {e_1, …, e_k}`. -/

FTC.LowerBound.basisReferenceCost.source:
noncomputable def basisReferenceCost {k : ℕ} (S : EuclideanQuery k) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j : Fin k, sqDistToCenters (basisPoint j) S

/-- Cost of a separately indexed weighted summary supported on the basis input. -/

FTC.LowerBound.basisReferenceCost_witnes.source:
@[simp] theorem basisReferenceCost_witness {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    basisReferenceCost (witnessQuery i) = 1 := by
  simp [basisReferenceCost, loss_witnessQuery]

/-- The witness query reads exactly the total weight at its omitted coordinate. -/

FTC.LowerBound.supportedCost_witness.source:
@[simp] theorem supportedCost_witness {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ}
    (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    supportedCost Q loc a (witnessQuery i) =
      ∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), a j := by
  classical
  simp [supportedCost, loss_witnessQuery, Finset.sum_filter, mul_ite]

/-- Claim A.2: any Euclidean `k`-means coreset supported on the basis input
approximately preserves the total weight at each coordinate. -/

FTC.LowerBound.weight_preservation.source:
theorem weight_preservation {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ}
    {ε : ℝ} (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ S : EuclideanQuery k,
      (1 - ε) * basisReferenceCost S ≤ supportedCost Q loc a S ∧
      supportedCost Q loc a S ≤ (1 + ε) * basisReferenceCost S) (i : Fin k) :
    1 - ε ≤ ∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), a j ∧
      (∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), a j) ≤ 1 + ε := by
  simpa only [basisReferenceCost_witness, supportedCost_witness, mul_one]
    using h (witnessQuery i)

end FTC.LowerBound

FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight.source:
def coordinateWeight (Q : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ) (loc : I → Fin k)
    (i : Fin k) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), a j

/-- Corrupt exactly the indices in `J` by replacing their weight by zero. -/

FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights.source:
def zeroWeights (a : I → ℝ) (J : Finset I) (j : I) : ℝ :=
  if j ∈ J then 0 else a j

FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights_of_mem.source:
@[simp] theorem zeroWeights_of_mem (a : I → ℝ) {J : Finset I} {j : I}
    (hj : j ∈ J) : zeroWeights a J j = 0 := by simp [zeroWeights, hj]

FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights_of_notMem.source:
@[simp] theorem zeroWeights_of_notMem (a : I → ℝ) {J : Finset I} {j : I}
    (hj : j ∉ J) : zeroWeights a J j = a j := by simp [zeroWeights, hj]

FTC.LowerBound.zeroWeights_nonneg.source:
theorem zeroWeights_nonneg {a : I → ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j)
    (J : Finset I) (j : I) : 0 ≤ zeroWeights a J j := by
  unfold zeroWeights
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact ha j

FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight_mono.source:
theorem coordinateWeight_mono {Q R : Finset I} {a : I → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (loc : I → Fin k) (i : Fin k) (hRQ : R ⊆ Q) :
    coordinateWeight R a loc i ≤ coordinateWeight Q a loc i := by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · exact Finset.filter_subset_filter _ hRQ
  · intro j _ _
    exact ha j

/-- The weights outside the corrupted set are unchanged. -/

FTC.LowerBound.coordinateWeight_zeroWeig.source:
theorem coordinateWeight_zeroWeights (Q : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ)
    (loc : I → Fin k) (i : Fin k) {J : Finset I}
    (hJ : J ⊆ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)) :
    coordinateWeight Q (zeroWeights a J) loc i =
      coordinateWeight Q a loc i - ∑ j ∈ J, a j := by
  classical
  have hz : (∑ j ∈ J, zeroWeights a J j) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    exact zeroWeights_of_mem a hj
  have hpart := Finset.sum_sdiff hJ (f := zeroWeights a J)
  have hpartA := Finset.sum_sdiff hJ (f := a)
  unfold coordinateWeight
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), zeroWeights a J j) =
        ∑ j ∈ (Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)) \ J, a j := by
      rw [← hpart, hz, add_zero]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      exact zeroWeights_of_notMem a (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hj).2
    _ = (∑ j ∈ Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i), a j) - ∑ j ∈ J, a j := by
      linarith

/-- If the total number of copies is below `f*k/(2 ε)`, some bin is below
`f/(2 ε)`. This includes the empty-bin case. -/

FTC.LowerBound.exists_small_bin.source:
theorem exists_small_bin (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k)
    (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (_hε : 0 < ε)
    (hsmall : (Q.card : ℝ) < (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε)) :
    ∃ i : Fin k, ((Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)).card : ℝ) <
      (f : ℝ) / (2 * ε) := by
  classical
  by_contra! h
  have hcount : (∑ i : Fin k, (Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)).card) = Q.card := by
    simpa using Finset.sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter Q Finset.univ loc
  have hcountR : (∑ i : Fin k, ((Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)).card : ℝ)) =
      (Q.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcount
  have hle := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)))
    (f := fun _ => (f : ℝ) / (2 * ε))
    (g := fun i => ((Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)).card : ℝ))
    (fun i _ => h i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hle
  rw [hcountR] at hle
  have heq : (k : ℝ) * ((f : ℝ) / (2 * ε)) =
      (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε) := by ring
  linarith

/-- Quantitative form of the lower bound. The robustness assumption only asks
for the necessary coordinate lower bounds after zeroing corruptions; it is
therefore weaker than successful filtering into an ε-coreset. -/

FTC.LowerBound.quantitative_filtering_lo.source:
theorem quantitative_filtering_lower_bound
    (Q : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ) (loc : I → Fin k)
    (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hclean : ∀ i : Fin k,
      1 - ε ≤ coordinateWeight Q a loc i ∧ coordinateWeight Q a loc i ≤ 1 + ε)
    (hrobust : ∀ J ⊆ Q, J.card ≤ f →
      ∃ R ⊆ Q, ∀ i : Fin k,
        1 - ε ≤ coordinateWeight R (zeroWeights a J) loc i) :
    (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  by_contra! hsmall
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_small_bin Q loc f ε hε hsmall
  have hA : 0 < coordinateWeight Q a loc i := by
    have := (hclean i).1
    linarith
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hJf, hmass⟩ :=
    exists_destructive_subset (Q.filter (fun j => loc j = i)) a f ε hε hεhalf hA hi
  have hJQ : J ⊆ Q := fun j hj => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hJ hj)).1
  obtain ⟨R, hRQ, hR⟩ := hrobust J hJQ hJf
  have hmono := coordinateWeight_mono (zeroWeights_nonneg ha J) loc i hRQ
  have hzero := coordinateWeight_zeroWeights Q a loc i hJ
  have hAupper := (hclean i).2
  have hRlower := hR i
  have hstrict : coordinateWeight Q (zeroWeights a J) loc i <
      (1 - 2 * ε) * coordinateWeight Q a loc i := by
    rw [hzero]
    change 2 * ε * coordinateWeight Q a loc i < _ at hmass
    linarith
  have hproduct : (1 - 2 * ε) * coordinateWeight Q a loc i ≤
      (1 - 2 * ε) * (1 + ε) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAupper
    linarith
  nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hε]

end FTC.LowerBound

FTC.LowerBound.exists_largest_weights.source:
theorem exists_largest_weights (s : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ) (f : ℕ)
    (hf : f ≤ s.card) :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, t.card = f ∧
