      (f : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ s, a i) ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ t, a i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hmax⟩ :=
    (s.powersetCard f).exists_max_image (fun t => ∑ i ∈ t, a i)
      (Finset.powersetCard_nonempty.mpr hf)
  obtain ⟨hts, htf⟩ := Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp ht
  have horder : ∀ x ∈ t, ∀ y ∈ s \ t, a y ≤ a x := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have hys : y ∈ s := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy).1
    have hyt : y ∉ t := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy).2
    have hyerase : y ∉ t.erase x := by
      exact fun h => hyt (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h)
    have hsub : insert y (t.erase x) ⊆ s := by
      intro z hz
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hys
      · exact hts (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hz)
    have hcard : (insert y (t.erase x)).card = f := by
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hyerase, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hx]
      have : 0 < t.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x, hx⟩
      omega
    have hle := hmax (insert y (t.erase x))
      (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨hsub, hcard⟩)
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hyerase] at hle
    have herase := Finset.sum_erase_add t a hx
    linarith
  have hcross : (t.card : ℝ) * (∑ y ∈ s \ t, a y) ≤
      ((s \ t).card : ℝ) * ∑ x ∈ t, a x := by
    calc
      (t.card : ℝ) * (∑ y ∈ s \ t, a y) =
          ∑ y ∈ s \ t, (t.card : ℝ) * a y := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ s \ t, ∑ x ∈ t, a x := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro y hy
        calc
          (t.card : ℝ) * a y = ∑ x ∈ t, a y := by simp
          _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ t, a x := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x hx => horder x hx y hy)
      _ = ((s \ t).card : ℝ) * ∑ x ∈ t, a x := by simp
  have hsum := Finset.sum_sdiff hts (f := a)
  have hcard := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card hts
  have hcardR : ((s \ t).card : ℝ) + (t.card : ℝ) = (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  refine ⟨t, hts, htf, ?_⟩
  rw [← htf, ← hsum, ← hcardR]
  nlinarith

/-- The precise mass-removal inequality used in the paper: if the number of
copies is less than `f / (2 ε)`, at most `f` entries remove more than a
`2 ε` fraction of their total weight. -/

FTC.LowerBound.exists_destructive_subset.source:
theorem exists_destructive_subset (s : Finset I) (a : I → ℝ)
    (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hA : 0 < ∑ i ∈ s, a i)
    (hsmall : (s.card : ℝ) < (f : ℝ) / (2 * ε)) :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, t.card ≤ f ∧
      2 * ε * (∑ i ∈ s, a i) < ∑ i ∈ t, a i := by
  by_cases hsf : s.card ≤ f
  · refine ⟨s, Finset.Subset.refl s, hsf, ?_⟩
    nlinarith
  · have hfs : f ≤ s.card := by omega
    obtain ⟨t, hts, htf, hmass⟩ := exists_largest_weights s a f hfs
    have hsmall' : (s.card : ℝ) * (2 * ε) < (f : ℝ) :=
      (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hsmall
    have hcardpos : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
      have hs : 0 < s.card := by
        by_contra h
        have : s = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by omega)
        simp [this] at hA
      exact_mod_cast hs
    refine ⟨t, hts, htf.le, ?_⟩
    have hstrict := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsmall' hA
    nlinarith

end FTC.LowerBound

FTC.LowerBound.basisEntries.source:
noncomputable def basisEntries (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (j : I) : FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k) where
  point := basisPoint (loc j)
  weight := a j
  weight_nonneg := ha j

/-- The explicit quantitative bound established by the proof of Theorem 3.4.
It holds for each successful coreset realization, independent of any
randomization used in constructing that realization. -/

FTC.LowerBound.theorem_3_4.source:
theorem theorem_3_4
    (Q : Finset I) (loc : I → Fin k) (a : I → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j)
    (decoder : (I → FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k)) → Finset I)
    (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hFT : FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f basisReferenceCost
      (@sqDistToCenters k) Q (basisEntries loc a ha) decoder) :
    (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  apply quantitative_filtering_lower_bound Q a loc ha f ε hε hεhalf
  · intro i
    have hclean : ∀ S : EuclideanQuery k,
        (1 - ε) * basisReferenceCost S ≤ supportedCost Q loc a S ∧
        supportedCost Q loc a S ≤ (1 + ε) * basisReferenceCost S := by
      simpa only [FTC.IsCoreset, FTC.cost, FTC.contribution, basisEntries,
        supportedCost] using hFT.1
    exact weight_preservation Q loc a hclean i
  · intro J hJ hJf
    let corrupted := basisEntries loc (zeroWeights a J) (zeroWeights_nonneg ha J)
    have hcorrupt : FTC.IsFCorruption f Q (basisEntries loc a ha) corrupted := by
      refine ⟨J, hJ, hJf, ?_⟩
      intro j _ hjJ
      simp [corrupted, basisEntries, zeroWeights, hjJ]
    obtain ⟨hsub, hco⟩ := hFT.2 corrupted hcorrupt
    refine ⟨decoder corrupted, hsub, ?_⟩
    intro i
    have hcorrect : ∀ S : EuclideanQuery k,
        (1 - ε) * basisReferenceCost S ≤
          supportedCost (decoder corrupted) loc (zeroWeights a J) S ∧
        supportedCost (decoder corrupted) loc (zeroWeights a J) S ≤
          (1 + ε) * basisReferenceCost S := by
      simpa only [FTC.IsCoreset, FTC.cost, FTC.contribution, corrupted,
        basisEntries, supportedCost] using hco
    exact (weight_preservation (decoder corrupted) loc (zeroWeights a J) hcorrect i).1

end FTC.LowerBound

namespace FTC.LowerBound

/-- The same bound for arbitrary stored entries whose active locations are
basis vectors, without requiring a canonical representation outside `Q`. -/

FTC.LowerBound.theorem_3_4_of_supported.source:
theorem theorem_3_4_of_supported
    {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ}
    (Q : Finset I) (entries : I → FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k))
    (loc : I → Fin k)
    (hsupport : ∀ j ∈ Q, (entries j).point = basisPoint (loc j))
    (decoder : (I → FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k)) → Finset I)
    (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hFT : FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f basisReferenceCost
      (@sqDistToCenters k) Q entries decoder) :
    (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  let a : I → ℝ := fun j => (entries j).weight
  have ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j := fun j => (entries j).weight_nonneg
  have hagree : ∀ j ∈ Q, basisEntries loc a ha j = entries j := by
    intro j hj
    have hp := hsupport j hj
    cases he : entries j with
    | mk p w hw =>
      simp only [he] at hp
      simp [basisEntries, a, he, hp]
  have hcost : ∀ S : EuclideanQuery k,
      FTC.cost (FTC.contribution (@sqDistToCenters k) (basisEntries loc a ha)) Q S =
        FTC.cost (FTC.contribution (@sqDistToCenters k) entries) Q S := by
    intro S
    apply FTC.cost_congr
    intro j hj T
    unfold FTC.contribution
    rw [hagree j hj]
  have hFT' : FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f basisReferenceCost
      (@sqDistToCenters k) Q (basisEntries loc a ha) decoder := by
    constructor
    · intro S
      simpa only [hcost S] using hFT.1 S
    · intro corrupted hcorrupt
      apply hFT.2 corrupted
      obtain ⟨B, hBQ, hBf, hB⟩ := hcorrupt
      refine ⟨B, hBQ, hBf, ?_⟩
      intro j hj hjB
      exact (hB j hj hjB).trans (hagree j hj)
  exact theorem_3_4 Q loc a ha decoder f ε hε hεhalf hFT'

end FTC.LowerBound

namespace FTC.LowerBound

/-- The source theorem stated using only support on `P = {e_i}`. Locations of
inactive indices are unrestricted; a coordinate label is chosen only for the
proof. The empty-dimensional case has a zero required lower bound. -/

FTC.LowerBound.theorem_3_4_of_support.source:
theorem theorem_3_4_of_support
    {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] {k : ℕ}
    (Q : Finset I) (entries : I → FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k))
    (hsupport : ∀ j ∈ Q, ∃ i : Fin k, (entries j).point = basisPoint i)
    (decoder : (I → FTC.Entry (BasisSpace k)) → Finset I)
    (f : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hFT : FTC.IsFilteringFaultTolerant ε f basisReferenceCost
      (@sqDistToCenters k) Q entries decoder) :
    (f : ℝ) * k / (2 * ε) ≤ (Q.card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k
    simp
  · have hkpos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
    let loc : I → Fin k := fun j =>
      if hj : j ∈ Q then Classical.choose (hsupport j hj) else ⟨0, hkpos⟩
    have hloc : ∀ j ∈ Q, (entries j).point = basisPoint (loc j) := by
      intro j hj
      dsimp only [loc]
      rw [dif_pos hj]
      exact Classical.choose_spec (hsupport j hj)
    exact theorem_3_4_of_supported Q entries loc hloc decoder f ε hε hεhalf hFT

end FTC.LowerBound

FTC.Probability.mass.source: noncomputable def mass (p : PMF J) (x : J) : ℝ := (p x).toReal

FTC.Probability.mass_nonneg.source: theorem mass_nonneg (p : PMF J) (x : J) : 0 ≤ mass p x := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

FTC.Probability.mass_le_one.source:
theorem mass_le_one (p : PMF J) (x : J) : mass p x ≤ 1 := by
  simpa [mass] using ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.one_ne_top (p.coe_le_one x)

/-- A normalized finite probability mass function from real probabilities. -/

FTC.Probability.pmfOfMass.source:
noncomputable def pmfOfMass (q : J → ℝ) (hq : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x)
    (hsum : ∑ x, q x = 1) : PMF J :=
  PMF.ofFintype (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (q x)) (by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun x _ => hq x), hsum]
    simp)

FTC.Probability.mass_pmfOfMass.source:
@[simp] theorem mass_pmfOfMass (q : J → ℝ) (hq : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x)
    (hsum : ∑ x, q x = 1) (x : J) : mass (pmfOfMass q hq hsum) x = q x := by
  simp [mass, pmfOfMass, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hq x)]

/-- The actual law of `m` independent draws with replacement. -/

FTC.Probability.iidLaw.source:
noncomputable def iidLaw (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) : Measure (Fin m → J) :=
  Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => p.toMeasure

instance iidLaw_isProbabilityMeasure (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (iidLaw p m) := by
  unfold iidLaw
  infer_instance

/-- The joint mass is the product of the individual masses. -/

FTC.Probability.iidLaw_singleton.source:
theorem iidLaw_singleton (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) (sample : Fin m → J) :
    iidLaw p m {sample} = ∏ i, p (sample i) := by
  simp [iidLaw, Measure.pi_singleton, PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton]

/-- Every coordinate has precisely the specified one-draw distribution. -/

FTC.Probability.iidLaw_eval_map.source:
theorem iidLaw_eval_map (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin m) :
    (iidLaw p m).map (Function.eval i) = p.toMeasure := by
  exact (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin m => p.toMeasure) i).map_eq

/-- The sample coordinates are independent for the actual product law. -/

FTC.Probability.iidLaw_independent.source:
theorem iidLaw_independent (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) :
    iIndepFun (fun i : Fin m => Function.eval i) (iidLaw p m) := by
  simpa [iidLaw] using
    (iIndepFun_pi (μ := fun _ : Fin m => p.toMeasure)
      (X := fun _ : Fin m => fun x : J => x) (fun _ => measurable_id.aemeasurable))

FTC.Probability.integral_hit.source:
theorem integral_hit (p : PMF J) (x : J) :
    ∫ y, hit x y ∂p.toMeasure = mass p x := by
  simp [PMF.integral_eq_sum, hit, mass]

FTC.Probability.variance_hit.source:
theorem variance_hit (p : PMF J) (x : J) :
    variance (hit x) p.toMeasure = mass p x * (1 - mass p x) := by
  rw [variance_eq_sub (MemLp.of_discrete : MemLp (hit x) 2 p.toMeasure)]
  have hsquare : (hit x) ^ 2 = hit x := by
    funext y
    simp only [Pi.pow_apply, hit]
    split <;> norm_num
  rw [hsquare, integral_hit]
  ring

FTC.Probability.integral_iid_eval.source:
theorem integral_iid_eval (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin m) (f : J → ℝ) :
    ∫ sample, f (sample i) ∂iidLaw p m = ∫ x, f x ∂p.toMeasure := by
  calc
    _ = ∫ x, f x ∂((iidLaw p m).map (Function.eval i)) :=
      (integral_map (measurable_pi_apply i).aemeasurable
        (by exact AEStronglyMeasurable.of_discrete)).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [iidLaw_eval_map]

/-- The expected count is `m p(x)`. -/

FTC.Probability.histogram_expectation.source:
theorem histogram_expectation (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) (x : J) :
    ∫ sample, histogram sample x ∂iidLaw p m = (m : ℝ) * mass p x := by
  unfold histogram
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun _ _ => Integrable.of_finite)]
  simp [integral_iid_eval, integral_hit]

/-- The binomial variance, derived from independence of the product law. -/

FTC.Probability.histogram_variance.source:
theorem histogram_variance (p : PMF J) (m : ℕ) (x : J) :
    variance (fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x) (iidLaw p m) =
      (m : ℝ) * (mass p x * (1 - mass p x)) := by
  have hfun : (fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x) =
      ∑ i : Fin m, fun sample : Fin m → J => hit x (sample i) := by
    funext sample
    simp [histogram]
  rw [hfun, iidLaw, variance_sum_pi (fun _ =>
    (MemLp.of_discrete : MemLp (hit x) 2 p.toMeasure))]
  simp [variance_hit]

/-- Chebyshev's inequality for one input frequency, with computed moments. -/

FTC.Probability.histogram_deviation_le.source:
theorem histogram_deviation_le (p : PMF J) {m : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (x : J) (hx : 0 < mass p x) :
    iidLaw p m {sample | ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x) ≤
        |histogram sample x - (m : ℝ) * mass p x|} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / mass p x) / ((m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2)) := by
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  have hthreshold : 0 < ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x) := mul_pos hε (mul_pos hmR hx)
  have hcheb := meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq
    (μ := iidLaw p m) (X := fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x)
    (MemLp.of_discrete : MemLp (fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x) 2
      (iidLaw p m)) hthreshold
  rw [histogram_expectation] at hcheb
  have hvar : variance (fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x) (iidLaw p m) ≤
      (m : ℝ) * mass p x := by
    rw [histogram_variance]
    have hq := mass_nonneg p x
    have hmq : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) * mass p x := mul_nonneg hmR.le hq
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_self (1 : ℝ) hq) hmq
    nlinarith
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (variance (fun sample : Fin m → J => histogram sample x) (iidLaw p m) /
          (ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x)) ^ 2) := hcheb
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((m : ℝ) * mass p x) /
          (ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x)) ^ 2) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hvar (sq_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      field_simp [hmR.ne', hε.ne', hx.ne']
      <;> ring

/-- At least one input index has a deviation at or above its tolerance. -/

FTC.Probability.inverseMassSum.source: noncomputable def inverseMassSum (p : PMF J) : ℝ := ∑ x, 1 / mass p x

FTC.Probability.inverseMassSum_nonneg.source:
theorem inverseMassSum_nonneg (p : PMF J) : 0 ≤ inverseMassSum p :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => div_nonneg (by norm_num) (mass_nonneg p x)

/-- A finite union bound, with no assumption on the number of solutions. -/

FTC.Probability.badHistogram_measure_le.source:
theorem badHistogram_measure_le (p : PMF J) {m : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < mass p x) :
    iidLaw p m (badHistogram p ε m) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (inverseMassSum p / ((m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2)) := by
  have hset : badHistogram p ε m = ⋃ x : J,
      {sample | ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x) ≤
        |histogram sample x - (m : ℝ) * mass p x|} := by
    ext sample
    simp [badHistogram]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ x, iidLaw p m {sample | ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x) ≤
        |histogram sample x - (m : ℝ) * mass p x|} := measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / mass p x) / ((m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => histogram_deviation_le p hm hε x (hp x)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun x _ =>
        div_nonneg (div_nonneg (by norm_num) (mass_nonneg p x))
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (sq_nonneg ε)))]
      congr 1
      simp [inverseMassSum, Finset.sum_div]

FTC.Probability.accurateHistogram_of_not.source:
theorem accurateHistogram_of_not_bad (p : PMF J) {m : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    {sample : Fin m → J} (h : sample ∉ badHistogram p ε m) :
    AccurateHistogram (mass p) ε sample := by
  intro x
  have hn : ¬ ε * ((m : ℝ) * mass p x) ≤
      |histogram sample x - (m : ℝ) * mass p x| := fun hx => h ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact (not_le.mp hn).le

/-- Complete ordinary coreset guarantee for the actual iid law. The finite
histogram-complement event is a measurable witness for the probability bound. -/

FTC.Probability.iid_coreset_success.source:
theorem iid_coreset_success {S : Type*} (p : PMF J) {a : J → S → ℝ}
    {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ} (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < mass p x)
    (hbound : inverseMassSum p / ((m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2) ≤ failure) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
      (fun sample => IsCoreset ε (cost a Finset.univ)
        (cost (inverseProbabilityContribution a (mass p) m sample) Finset.univ)) := by
  have hbad : iidLaw p m (badHistogram p ε m) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal failure :=
    (badHistogram_measure_le p hm hε hp).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbound)
  refine ⟨(badHistogram p ε m)ᶜ, MeasurableSet.of_discrete, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [measure_compl MeasurableSet.of_discrete (measure_ne_top _ _), measure_univ]
    exact tsub_le_tsub_left hbad 1
  · intro sample hsample
    exact (accurateHistogram_of_not_bad p hsample).isCoreset ha hm hp

/-- A loose but explicit finite-input ordinary sample count. It works for
every larger count, so it can be used as `m_sc` in the additive construction. -/

FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize.source:
noncomputable def fallbackSampleSize (p : PMF J) (ε failure : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈inverseMassSum p / (failure * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ + 1

FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize_pos.source:
theorem fallbackSampleSize_pos (p : PMF J) (ε failure : ℝ) :
    0 < fallbackSampleSize p ε failure := Nat.zero_lt_succ _

FTC.Probability.fallbackSampleSize_bound.source:
theorem fallbackSampleSize_bound (p : PMF J) {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hfailure : 0 < failure)
    (hsize : fallbackSampleSize p ε failure ≤ m) :
    inverseMassSum p / ((m : ℝ) * ε ^ 2) ≤ failure := by
  have hm : 0 < m := (fallbackSampleSize_pos p ε failure).trans_le hsize
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  have hceil : ⌈inverseMassSum p / (failure * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ ≤ m :=
    (Nat.le_succ _).trans hsize
  have hceilR : (⌈inverseMassSum p / (failure * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hceil
  have hratio := (Nat.le_ceil (inverseMassSum p / (failure * ε ^ 2))).trans hceilR
  have hprod := (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hfailure (sq_pos_of_pos hε))).1 hratio
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hmR (sq_pos_of_pos hε))).2
  nlinarith

FTC.Probability.iid_coreset_success_of_s.source:
theorem iid_coreset_success_of_sampleSize {S : Type*} (p : PMF J) {a : J → S → ℝ}
    {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ} (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hfailure : 0 < failure) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < mass p x)
    (hsize : fallbackSampleSize p ε failure ≤ m) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
      (fun sample => IsCoreset ε (cost a Finset.univ)
        (cost (inverseProbabilityContribution a (mass p) m sample) Finset.univ)) :=
  iid_coreset_success p ha ((fallbackSampleSize_pos p ε failure).trans_le hsize) hε hp
    (fallbackSampleSize_bound p hε hfailure hsize)

end FTC.Probability

FTC.Probability.hit.source:
def hit (x y : J) : ℝ := if y = x then 1 else 0

/-- Number of separately indexed sampled copies of `x`, viewed as a real. -/

FTC.Probability.inverseProbabilityContri.source:
noncomputable def inverseProbabilityContribution (a : J → S → ℝ)
    (q : J → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (sample : Fin m → J) (i : Fin m) (s : S) : ℝ :=
  (1 / ((m : ℝ) * q (sample i))) * a (sample i) s

/-- Every stored frequency is relatively accurate. The count form avoids a
division by `m` in the event and in its concentration proof. -/

FTC.Probability.AccurateHistogram.source:
def AccurateHistogram (q : J → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → J) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, |histogram sample x - (m : ℝ) * q x| ≤ ε * ((m : ℝ) * q x)

FTC.Probability.histogram_nonneg.source:
theorem histogram_nonneg {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → J) (x : J) :
    0 ≤ histogram sample x := by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  unfold hit
  split <;> norm_num

/-- Group the sample's cost by its original input index. Duplicate samples
are counted, rather than identified. -/

FTC.Probability.cost_eq_histogram.source:
theorem cost_eq_histogram {a : J → S → ℝ} {q : J → ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (sample : Fin m → J) (s : S) :
    cost (inverseProbabilityContribution a q m sample) Finset.univ s =
      ∑ x, (histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s := by
  unfold cost inverseProbabilityContribution
  calc
    (∑ i, (1 / ((m : ℝ) * q (sample i))) * a (sample i) s) =
        ∑ i, ∑ x, hit x (sample i) * ((1 / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simp [hit, eq_comm]
    _ = ∑ x, ∑ i, hit x (sample i) * ((1 / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s) :=
      Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ x, (histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      unfold histogram
      ring

FTC.Probability.AccurateHistogram.coeffi.source:
theorem AccurateHistogram.coefficient_bounds {q : J → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    {sample : Fin m → J} (h : AccurateHistogram q ε sample)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hq : ∀ x, 0 < q x) (x : J) :
    1 - ε ≤ histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x) ∧
      histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x) ≤ 1 + ε := by
  have hD : 0 < (m : ℝ) * q x := mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm) (hq x)
  have habs := abs_le.mp (h x)
  constructor
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ hD).2
    nlinarith
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hD).2
    nlinarith

/-- The histogram certificate gives a coreset for all solutions at once. -/

FTC.Probability.AccurateHistogram.isCore.source:
theorem AccurateHistogram.isCoreset {a : J → S → ℝ} {q : J → ℝ}
    {ε : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {sample : Fin m → J}
    (h : AccurateHistogram q ε sample) (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hq : ∀ x, 0 < q x) :
    IsCoreset ε (cost a Finset.univ)
      (cost (inverseProbabilityContribution a q m sample) Finset.univ) := by
  intro s
  rw [cost_eq_histogram]
  have hcoeff := h.coefficient_bounds hm hq
  constructor
  · calc
      (1 - ε) * cost a Finset.univ s = ∑ x, (1 - ε) * a x s := by
        simp [cost, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ ∑ x, (histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro x _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcoeff x).1 (ha x s)
  · calc
      (∑ x, (histogram sample x / ((m : ℝ) * q x)) * a x s) ≤
          ∑ x, (1 + ε) * a x s := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro x _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcoeff x).2 (ha x s)
      _ = (1 + ε) * cost a Finset.univ s := by simp [cost, Finset.mul_sum]

end FTC.Probability

FTC.Probability.positiveSupport.source:
def positiveSupport (P : Finset J) (score : J → ℝ) : Finset J := by
  classical
  exact P.filter fun x => 0 < score x

/-- A sample is drawn from this finite support; the underlying input index is
its subtype value. -/

FTC.Probability.PositiveIndex.source:
abbrev PositiveIndex (P : Finset J) (score : J → ℝ) :=
  {x : J // x ∈ positiveSupport P score}

FTC.Probability.positiveIndex_mem.source:
theorem positiveIndex_mem {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (x : PositiveIndex P score) : x.val ∈ P := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp x.property).1

FTC.Probability.positiveIndex_score_pos.source:
theorem positiveIndex_score_pos {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (x : PositiveIndex P score) : 0 < score x.val := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp x.property).2

FTC.Probability.score_nonneg_of_dominate.source:
theorem score_nonneg_of_dominates {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x) :
    ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x :=
  fun x hx => (sensitivity_nonneg ha P x).trans (hscore x hx)

/-- Zero sensitivity/proxy score really means zero contribution, even at
zero-cost queries. -/

FTC.Probability.loss_zero_of_score_zero.source:
theorem loss_zero_of_score_zero {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    {x : J} (hx : x ∈ P) (hzero : score x = 0) (s : S) : a x s = 0 := by
  have h := (contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost ha hx s).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hscore x hx) (cost_nonneg ha P s))
  rw [hzero, zero_mul] at h
  exact le_antisymm h (ha x s)

/-- The zero-total case is a zero objective. No probability distribution on
an empty positive-score support needs to be constructed. -/

FTC.Probability.cost_zero_of_totalScore_.source:
theorem cost_zero_of_totalScore_zero {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hT : totalScore score P = 0) (s : S) : cost a P s = 0 := by
  have hscore0 := score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore
  unfold cost
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  have hle : score x ≤ totalScore score P := Finset.single_le_sum hscore0 hx
  rw [hT] at hle
  have hz : score x = 0 := le_antisymm hle (hscore0 x hx)
  exact loss_zero_of_score_zero ha hscore hx hz s

/-- The degenerate zero-total input has an exact empty summary. -/

FTC.Probability.empty_coreset_of_totalSc.source:
theorem empty_coreset_of_totalScore_zero {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hT : totalScore score P = 0) : IsCoreset 0 (cost a P) (cost a ∅) := by
  intro s
  rw [cost_zero_of_totalScore_zero ha hscore hT s]
  simp

FTC.Probability.positiveSupport_score_su.source:
theorem positiveSupport_score_sum {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) :
    (∑ x : PositiveIndex P score, score x.val) = totalScore score P := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort]
  unfold positiveSupport totalScore
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  intro x hx hxnot
  have hn : ¬ 0 < score x := by
    intro hpos
    exact hxnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, hpos⟩)
  exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn) (hscore0 x hx)

/-- Restricting to positive scores does not change any reference query cost. -/

FTC.Probability.positiveSupport_cost.source:
theorem positiveSupport_cost {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (s : S) :
    cost (fun (x : PositiveIndex P score) t => a x.val t) Finset.univ s = cost a P s := by
  classical
  unfold cost
  change (∑ x : PositiveIndex P score, a x.val s) = ∑ x ∈ P, a x s
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort (positiveSupport P score) (fun x => a x s)]
  unfold positiveSupport
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  intro x hx hxnot
  have hn : ¬ 0 < score x := by
    intro hpos
    exact hxnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, hpos⟩)
  have hz : score x = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn)
    (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore x hx)
  exact loss_zero_of_score_zero ha hscore hx hz s

/-- The actual one-draw PMF `q_x = score_x / T` on positive-score support. -/

FTC.Probability.scoreSupportPMF.source:
def scoreSupportPMF (P : Finset J) (score : J → ℝ)
    (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < totalScore score P) :
    PMF (PositiveIndex P score) :=
  pmfOfMass (fun x => score x.val / totalScore score P)
    (fun x => div_nonneg (positiveIndex_score_pos x).le hT.le)
    (by rw [← Finset.sum_div, positiveSupport_score_sum hscore0]; exact div_self hT.ne')

FTC.Probability.mass_scoreSupportPMF.source:
@[simp] theorem mass_scoreSupportPMF (P : Finset J) (score : J → ℝ)
    (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < totalScore score P)
    (x : PositiveIndex P score) :
    mass (scoreSupportPMF P score hscore0 hT) x = score x.val / totalScore score P := by
  unfold scoreSupportPMF
  rw [mass_pmfOfMass]

FTC.Probability.mass_scoreSupportPMF_pos.source:
theorem mass_scoreSupportPMF_pos (P : Finset J) (score : J → ℝ)
    (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < totalScore score P)
    (x : PositiveIndex P score) : 0 < mass (scoreSupportPMF P score hscore0 hT) x := by
  rw [mass_scoreSupportPMF]
  exact div_pos (positiveIndex_score_pos x) hT

/-- The inverse-probability sample contribution is exactly the score-sampling
weight from Lemma 3.2 / Theorem A.1. -/

FTC.Probability.support_sample_contribut.source:
theorem support_sample_contribution_eq {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x) (hT : 0 < totalScore score P)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (sample : Fin m → PositiveIndex P score) :
    inverseProbabilityContribution (fun (x : PositiveIndex P score) s => a x.val s)
        (mass (scoreSupportPMF P score hscore0 hT)) m sample =
      sampledContribution a (fun i => (sample i).val) score (totalScore score P) m := by
  funext i s
  unfold inverseProbabilityContribution sampledContribution samplingWeight
  rw [mass_scoreSupportPMF]
  rw [inverse_probability_weight hm hT (positiveIndex_score_pos (sample i))]

/-- Complete ordinary coreset guarantee for actual normalized-score iid draws,
with zero-score input indices handled by the support reduction above. -/

FTC.Probability.scoreSampling_coreset_su.source:
theorem scoreSampling_coreset_success {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hT : 0 < totalScore score P) {m : ℕ} {ε failure : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hfailure : 0 < failure)
    (hsize : fallbackSampleSize
      (scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT) ε failure ≤ m) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast
      (iidLaw (scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT) m)
      (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
      (fun sample : Fin m → PositiveIndex P score =>
        IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
          (cost (sampledContribution a (fun i => (sample i).val) score (totalScore score P) m)
            Finset.univ)) := by
  let p := scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT
  have hm : 0 < m := (fallbackSampleSize_pos p ε failure).trans_le hsize
  have h := iid_coreset_success_of_sampleSize p
    (a := fun (x : PositiveIndex P score) s => a x.val s)
    (fun x s => ha x.val s) hε hfailure
    (mass_scoreSupportPMF_pos P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT) hsize
  apply h.mono
  intro sample hco
  have href : cost (fun (x : PositiveIndex P score) s => a x.val s) Finset.univ =
      cost a P := funext (positiveSupport_cost ha hscore)
  rw [href, support_sample_contribution_eq (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT hm sample]
    at hco
  exact hco

/-- The actual normalized-score product distribution now supplies the clean
success hypothesis of Theorem A.1; it is no longer an external assumption. -/

FTC.Probability.scoreSampling_fault_tole.source:
theorem scoreSampling_fault_tolerant {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hT : 0 < totalScore score P) {m f : ℕ} {ε failure α : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hfailure : 0 < failure) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hordinary : fallbackSampleSize
      (scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT) ε failure ≤ m)
    (hfault : α * (f : ℝ) * totalScore score P / ε ≤ (m : ℝ)) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast
      (iidLaw (scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT) m)
      (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
      (fun sample : Fin m → PositiveIndex P score =>
        FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
          (sampledContribution a (fun i => (sample i).val) score (totalScore score P) m)
          Finset.univ) := by
  let p := scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT
  have hm : 0 < m := (fallbackSampleSize_pos p ε failure).trans_le hordinary
  exact theorem_A_1_success_probability (iidLaw p m) ha
    (fun sample i => positiveIndex_mem (sample i)) hscore hm hε hεsmall hα hfault
    (scoreSampling_coreset_success ha hscore hT hε hfailure hordinary)

/-- Complete rounded additive construction for the actual iid score sampler.
It certifies the exact number of separately stored copies and its success
probability, using the explicit finite-input fallback as its ordinary count. -/

theorem scoreSampling_fault_tolerant_rounded {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hT : 0 < totalScore score P) {f : ℕ} {ε failure α : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hfailure : 0 < failure) (hα : 1 ≤ α) :
    let p := scoreSupportPMF P score (score_nonneg_of_dominates ha hscore) hT
    let m := faultTolerantSampleSize (fallbackSampleSize p ε failure) f α (totalScore score P) ε
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).card = m ∧
      SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
        (fun sample : Fin m → PositiveIndex P score =>
          FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
            (sampledContribution a (fun i => (sample i).val) score (totalScore score P) m)
            Finset.univ) := by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  apply scoreSampling_fault_tolerant ha hscore hT hε hεsmall hfailure hα
  · exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  · exact faultTolerantSampleSize_lower _ f α (totalScore score P) ε

/-- Exact sensitivity sampling is the exact-score specialization of the fully
proved construction, including zero-sensitivity support handling. -/

FTC.Probability.sensitivitySampling_faul.source:
theorem sensitivitySampling_fault_tolerant_rounded {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hT : 0 < totalSensitivity a P)
    {f : ℕ} {ε failure α : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hfailure : 0 < failure) (hα : 1 ≤ α) :
    let p := scoreSupportPMF P (sensitivity a P) (fun x _ => sensitivity_nonneg ha P x) hT
    let m := faultTolerantSampleSize (fallbackSampleSize p ε failure) f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).card = m ∧
      SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast (iidLaw p m) (1 - ENNReal.ofReal failure)
        (fun sample : Fin m → PositiveIndex P (sensitivity a P) =>
          FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
            (sampledContribution a (fun i => (sample i).val) (sensitivity a P)
              (totalSensitivity a P) m) Finset.univ) := by
  exact scoreSampling_fault_tolerant_rounded ha (fun _ _ => le_rfl) hT
    hε hεsmall hfailure hα

end

end FTC.Probability

FTC.FilteringSuccess.source:
def FilteringSuccess (ε α : ℝ) (f : ℕ) (reference : S → ℝ)
    (c : I → S → ℝ) (U : Finset I) : Prop :=
  IsCoreset ε reference (cost c U) ∧
    ∀ (d : I → S → ℝ), (∀ i s, 0 ≤ d i s) →
      ∀ (B : Finset I), B.card ≤ f →
        (∀ i ∈ U, i ∉ B → ∀ s, d i s = c i s) →
        ∀ (oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle d α),
          IsCoreset (6 * ε) reference (cost d (peel oracle.score f U))

/-- Package the deterministic theorem as the simultaneous success predicate. -/

FTC.filtering_success_of_entry_bound.source:
theorem filtering_success_of_entry_bound {c : I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ}
    {U : Finset I} {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε reference (cost c U))
    (hentry : ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, c i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε) :
    FilteringSuccess ε α f reference c U := by
  refine ⟨hcoreset, ?_⟩
  intro d hd B hB hagrees oracle
  exact filtering_decoder_correct hc hd hreference hε hεsmall hδ hα
    hcoreset hB hagrees hentry hbudget oracle

/-- Bridge to Definition 2.1 for actual point/weight corruptions. Once a valid
oracle is supplied on each corrupted summary, Algorithm 1 is a filtering
decoder for a `6ε`-coreset with its inherited weights. -/

FTC.FilteringSuccess.to_isFilteringFault.source:
theorem FilteringSuccess.to_isFilteringFaultTolerant
    {ε α : ℝ} {f : ℕ} {reference : S → ℝ} {loss : X → S → ℝ}
    {U : Finset I} {entries : I → Entry X}
    (hsuccess : FilteringSuccess ε α f reference (contribution loss entries) U)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hloss : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ loss x s)
    (oracles : ∀ corrupted : I → Entry X,
      ApproxSensitivityOracle (contribution loss corrupted) α) :
    IsFilteringFaultTolerant (6 * ε) f reference loss U entries
      (fun corrupted => peel (oracles corrupted).score f U) := by
  constructor
  · intro s
    have hco := hsuccess.1 s
    have hεref := mul_nonneg hε (hreference s)
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · intro corrupted hcorrupt
    obtain ⟨B, _, hB, hagrees⟩ := hcorrupt
    refine ⟨peel_subset (oracles corrupted).score f U, ?_⟩
    apply hsuccess.2 (contribution loss corrupted)
      (contribution_nonneg loss corrupted hloss) B hB ?_ (oracles corrupted)
    intro i hi hiB s
    simp only [contribution, hagrees i hi hiB]

end Deterministic

section IndexedSamples

variable {I J S : Type*} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]

/-- Exact sensitivity sampling, conditioned only on the usual clean coreset
event. There is no injectivity assumption on the indexed sample map. -/

FTC.exactSampling_filtering_success.source:
theorem exactSampling_filtering_success {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I} {m f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ i, sample i ∈ P)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hsize : α * (f : ℝ) * totalSensitivity a P / ε ≤ (m : ℝ))
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
      (cost (sampledContribution a sample (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P) m) U)) :
    FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
      (sampledContribution a sample (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P) m) U := by
  apply filtering_success_of_entry_bound
    (fun i s => sampledContribution_nonneg ha (totalSensitivity_nonneg ha P)
      (sensitivity_nonneg ha P (sample i)))
    (cost_nonneg ha P) hε.le hεsmall
    (div_nonneg (totalSensitivity_nonneg ha P) (Nat.cast_nonneg m)) hα hcoreset
    (fun i _ s => lemma_3_2 ha hm (hsample i) s)
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using sampling_budget hε hm hsize

/-- Proxy-score sampling, conditioned on its clean coreset event (Theorem A.1). -/

FTC.proxySampling_filtering_success.source:
theorem proxySampling_filtering_success {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I} {score : J → ℝ} {m f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ i, sample i ∈ P)
    (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hsize : α * (f : ℝ) * totalScore score P / ε ≤ (m : ℝ))
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
      (cost (sampledContribution a sample score (totalScore score P) m) U)) :
    FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
      (sampledContribution a sample score (totalScore score P) m) U := by
  have hscore0 : ∀ x ∈ P, 0 ≤ score x :=
    fun x hx => (sensitivity_nonneg ha P x).trans (hscore x hx)
  have hT : 0 ≤ totalScore score P := totalScore_nonneg hscore0
  apply filtering_success_of_entry_bound
    (fun i s => sampledContribution_nonneg ha hT (hscore0 _ (hsample i)))
    (cost_nonneg ha P) hε.le hεsmall
    (div_nonneg hT (Nat.cast_nonneg m)) hα hcoreset
    (fun i _ s => proxySampling_entry_bound ha hscore hm (hsample i) s)
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using sampling_budget hε hm hsize

FTC.exactSampling_filtering_success_ceil.source:
theorem exactSampling_filtering_success_ceil {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I} {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ i, sample i ∈ P)
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
      (cost (sampledContribution a sample (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P)
        (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε)) U)) :
    FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
      (sampledContribution a sample (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P)
        (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε)) U :=
  exactSampling_filtering_success ha hsample (faultTolerantSampleSize_pos hmsc)
    hε hεsmall hα (faultTolerantSampleSize_lower m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε) hcoreset

FTC.proxySampling_filtering_success_ceil.source:
theorem proxySampling_filtering_success_ceil {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I} {score : J → ℝ} {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ i, sample i ∈ P)
    (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hcoreset : IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
      (cost (sampledContribution a sample score (totalScore score P)
        (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε)) U)) :
    FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
      (sampledContribution a sample score (totalScore score P)
        (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε)) U :=
  proxySampling_filtering_success ha hsample hscore (faultTolerantSampleSize_pos hmsc)
    hε hεsmall hα (faultTolerantSampleSize_lower m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε) hcoreset

end IndexedSamples

section SuccessEvents

variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

/-- A measurable event of probability/mass at least `p` on which the predicate
holds. This avoids presupposing measurability of a predicate with universal
quantification over adversarial corruptions and sensitivity oracles. -/

FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast.mono.source:
theorem SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast.mono {μ : Measure Ω} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    {P Q : Ω → Prop} (hP : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p P)
    (hPQ : ∀ ω, P ω → Q ω) : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p Q := by
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hp, hP⟩ := hP
  exact ⟨E, hE, hp, fun ω hω => hPQ ω (hP ω hω)⟩

FTC.SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast.of_me.source:
theorem SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast.of_measurable_event
    {μ : Measure Ω} {p : ℝ≥0∞} {predicate : Ω → Prop}
    (hE : MeasurableSet {ω | predicate ω}) (hp : p ≤ μ {ω | predicate ω}) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p predicate :=
  ⟨{ω | predicate ω}, hE, hp, fun _ hω => hω⟩

variable {I S : Type*} [DecidableEq I]

/-- The standard clean success witness also certifies simultaneous recovery
against all admissible adversaries; the witnessing event is unchanged. -/

FTC.filtering_success_probability.source:
theorem filtering_success_probability {μ : Measure Ω} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    {clean : Ω → I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ} {U : Finset I}
    {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ ω i s, 0 ≤ clean ω i s) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hentry : ∀ ω, ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, clean ω i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε)
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε reference (cost (clean ω) U))) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f reference (clean ω) U) :=
  hstandard.mono fun ω hco => filtering_success_of_entry_bound (hc ω) hreference
    hε hεsmall hδ hα hco (hentry ω) hbudget

/-- Also, clean-event inclusion gives an outer-measure inequality for the full
predicates. The measurable-witness theorem above is the probability statement. -/

FTC.outerMeasure_clean_event_le_filterin.source:
theorem outerMeasure_clean_event_le_filtering_event (μ : Measure Ω)
    {clean : Ω → I → S → ℝ} {reference : S → ℝ} {U : Finset I}
    {f : ℕ} {ε δ α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ ω i s, 0 ≤ clean ω i s) (hreference : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reference s)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hentry : ∀ ω, ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ s, clean ω i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hbudget : (f : ℝ) * α * δ ≤ ε) :
    μ {ω | IsCoreset ε reference (cost (clean ω) U)} ≤
      μ {ω | FilteringSuccess ε α f reference (clean ω) U} := by
  exact measure_mono fun ω hco => filtering_success_of_entry_bound (hc ω) hreference
    hε hεsmall hδ hα hco (hentry ω) hbudget

end SuccessEvents

section SampleSuccessEvents

variable {Ω I J S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]

/-- Theorem 3.1 for any sufficiently large integer sample count. A standard
sampler's measurable clean-success event of mass `p` yields the same mass `p`
for recovery from every `f`-fault corruption. -/

FTC.theorem_3_1_success_probability.source:
theorem theorem_3_1_success_probability (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {samples : Ω → I → J} {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I}
    {m f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ ω i, samples ω i ∈ P)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hsize : α * (f : ℝ) * totalSensitivity a P / ε ≤ (m : ℝ))
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
        (cost (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P) m) U))) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
        (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P) m) U) :=
  hstandard.mono fun ω hco =>
    exactSampling_filtering_success ha (hsample ω) hm hε hεsmall hα hsize hco

/-- Theorem A.1 for sufficiently large proxy-score sample counts. -/

FTC.theorem_A_1_success_probability.source:
theorem theorem_A_1_success_probability (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {samples : Ω → I → J} {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I}
    {score : J → ℝ} {m f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ ω i, samples ω i ∈ P)
    (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hsize : α * (f : ℝ) * totalScore score P / ε ≤ (m : ℝ))
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
        (cost (sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (totalScore score P) m) U))) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
        (sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (totalScore score P) m) U) :=
  hstandard.mono fun ω hco =>
    proxySampling_filtering_success ha (hsample ω) hscore hm hε hεsmall hα hsize hco

/-- Theorem 3.1 with the rounded additive sample size
`m_sc + ceil(α f T / ε)`. -/

FTC.theorem_3_1.source:
theorem theorem_3_1 (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {samples : Ω → I → J} {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I}
    {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ ω i, samples ω i ∈ P)
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
        (cost (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε)) U))) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
        (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε)) U) :=
  theorem_3_1_success_probability μ ha hsample (faultTolerantSampleSize_pos hmsc)
    hε hεsmall hα (faultTolerantSampleSize_lower m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε) hstandard

/-- Theorem A.1 with the rounded additive proxy-score sample size. -/

FTC.theorem_A_1.source:
theorem theorem_A_1 (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {samples : Ω → I → J} {P : Finset J} {U : Finset I}
    {score : J → ℝ} {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ ω i, samples ω i ∈ P)
    (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
        (cost (sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (totalScore score P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε)) U))) :
    SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
        (sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (totalScore score P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε)) U) :=
  theorem_A_1_success_probability μ ha hsample hscore (faultTolerantSampleSize_pos hmsc)
    hε hεsmall hα (faultTolerantSampleSize_lower m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε) hstandard

/-- Paper-sized specialization of Theorem 3.1: the stored indices are exactly
`Fin m`, where `m = m_sc + ceil(α f T / ε)`. Its cardinality is certified
explicitly alongside the probability guarantee. Repeated sampled points still
have different stored indices. -/

FTC.theorem_3_1_fin.source:
theorem theorem_3_1_fin (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {m_sc f : ℕ} {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (samples : Ω → Fin (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε) → J)
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ ω i, samples ω i ∈ P)
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
        (cost (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε)) Finset.univ))) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε))).card =
        faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε ∧
      SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
        (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
          (sampledContribution a (samples ω) (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P)
            (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalSensitivity a P) ε)) Finset.univ) := by
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  exact theorem_3_1 μ ha hsample hmsc hε hεsmall hα hstandard

/-- Theorem A.1 with exactly the stated rounded number of proxy-score samples. -/

FTC.theorem_A_1_fin.source:
theorem theorem_A_1_fin (μ : Measure Ω)
    {a : J → S → ℝ} {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ} {m_sc f : ℕ}
    {ε α : ℝ} {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (samples : Ω → Fin (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε) → J)
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hsample : ∀ ω i, samples ω i ∈ P)
    (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε < 1 / 10) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hstandard : SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
      (fun ω => IsCoreset ε (cost a P)
        (cost (sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (totalScore score P)
          (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε)) Finset.univ))) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε))).card =
        faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε ∧
      SucceedsWithProbabilityAtLeast μ p
        (fun ω => FilteringSuccess ε α f (cost a P)
          (sampledContribution a (samples ω) score (totalScore score P)
            (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α (totalScore score P) ε)) Finset.univ) := by
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  exact theorem_A_1 μ ha hsample hscore hmsc hε hεsmall hα hstandard

end SampleSuccessEvents

end FTC

FTC.samplingWeight.source:
noncomputable def samplingWeight (score : J → ℝ) (T : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (x : J) : ℝ :=
  T / ((m : ℝ) * score x)

/-- A separately indexed sampled contribution; `sample` may have repetitions. -/

FTC.sampledContribution.source:
noncomputable def sampledContribution (a : J → S → ℝ) (sample : I → J)
    (score : J → ℝ) (T : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (i : I) (s : S) : ℝ :=
  samplingWeight score T m (sample i) * a (sample i) s

/-- Sum of scores on the input. -/

FTC.totalSensitivity.source:
noncomputable def totalSensitivity (a : J → S → ℝ) (P : Finset J) : ℝ :=
  totalScore (sensitivity a P) P

FTC.totalSensitivity_nonneg.source:
theorem totalSensitivity_nonneg {a : J → S → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (P : Finset J) :
    0 ≤ totalSensitivity a P :=
  totalScore_nonneg fun x _ => sensitivity_nonneg ha P x

FTC.samplingWeight_nonneg.source:
theorem samplingWeight_nonneg {score : J → ℝ} {T : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {x : J}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hscore : 0 ≤ score x) :
    0 ≤ samplingWeight score T m x :=
  div_nonneg hT (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hscore)

FTC.sampledContribution_nonneg.source:
theorem sampledContribution_nonneg {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {score : J → ℝ} {T : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {i : I} {s : S}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hscore : 0 ≤ score (sample i)) :
    0 ≤ sampledContribution a sample score T m i s :=
  mul_nonneg (samplingWeight_nonneg hT hscore) (ha _ _)

/-- This identifies the weight with `1 / (m q_x)` for `q_x = score_x / T`.
The positivity hypotheses describe the support of the actual sampler. -/

FTC.inverse_probability_weight.source:
theorem inverse_probability_weight {m : ℕ} {T t : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hT : 0 < T) (ht : 0 < t) :
    1 / ((m : ℝ) * (t / T)) = T / ((m : ℝ) * t) := by
  have hm' : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)
  field_simp [hm', hT.ne', ht.ne']

/-- Scalar cancellation underlying both exact and proxy sampling bounds.
When a score is zero the assigned contribution is zero, so the same bound
also covers that boundary case. -/

FTC.inverse_score_contribution_le.source:
theorem inverse_score_contribution_le {v L t T : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hcontribution : v ≤ t * L) :
    (T / ((m : ℝ) * t)) * v ≤ (T / (m : ℝ)) * L := by
  by_cases ht0 : t = 0
  · simp only [ht0, mul_zero, div_zero, zero_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hT (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hL
  · have hm' : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)
    calc
      (T / ((m : ℝ) * t)) * v ≤ (T / ((m : ℝ) * t)) * (t * L) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcontribution
          (div_nonneg hT (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) ht))
      _ = (T / (m : ℝ)) * L := by field_simp [hm', ht0]

/-- The generic entry bound: any score dominating the input sensitivity works. -/

FTC.sampledContribution_le.source:
theorem sampledContribution_le {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ} {T : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {i : I}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s) (hi : sample i ∈ P)
    (hscore : sensitivity a P (sample i) ≤ score (sample i))
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hm : 0 < m) (s : S) :
    sampledContribution a sample score T m i s ≤
      (T / (m : ℝ)) * cost a P s := by
  have hscore0 : 0 ≤ score (sample i) :=
    (sensitivity_nonneg ha P (sample i)).trans hscore
  apply inverse_score_contribution_le (cost_nonneg ha P s) hscore0 hT hm
  exact (contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost ha hi s).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscore (cost_nonneg ha P s))

/-- Lemma 3.2: every indexed copy drawn by exact sensitivity sampling has
weighted contribution at most `T / m` times the input cost. -/

FTC.lemma_3_2.source:
theorem lemma_3_2 {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J} {P : Finset J}
    {m : ℕ} {i : I} (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hi : sample i ∈ P) (s : S) :
    sampledContribution a sample (sensitivity a P) (totalSensitivity a P) m i s ≤
      (totalSensitivity a P / (m : ℝ)) * cost a P s :=
  sampledContribution_le ha hi le_rfl (totalSensitivity_nonneg ha P) hm s

/-- The entry-bound extension used in Theorem A.1, with total proxy score. -/

FTC.proxySampling_entry_bound.source:
theorem proxySampling_entry_bound {a : J → S → ℝ} {sample : I → J}
    {P : Finset J} {score : J → ℝ} {m : ℕ} {i : I}
    (ha : ∀ x s, 0 ≤ a x s)
    (hscore : ∀ x ∈ P, sensitivity a P x ≤ score x)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hi : sample i ∈ P) (s : S) :
    sampledContribution a sample score (totalScore score P) m i s ≤
      (totalScore score P / (m : ℝ)) * cost a P s := by
  apply sampledContribution_le ha hi (hscore _ hi) _ hm s
  exact totalScore_nonneg fun x hx => (sensitivity_nonneg ha P x).trans (hscore x hx)

/-- The usual sample-size lower bound implies the deterministic filtering
budget `α f (T/m) ≤ ε`. -/

FTC.sampling_budget.source:
theorem sampling_budget {α ε T : ℝ} {f m : ℕ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hsize : α * (f : ℝ) * T / ε ≤ (m : ℝ)) :
    α * (f : ℝ) * (T / (m : ℝ)) ≤ ε := by
  have hm' : 0 < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  rw [← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hm').2
  have h := (div_le_iff₀ hε).1 hsize
  nlinarith

/-- The integer sample size corresponding to the paper's additive overhead. -/

FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize.source:
noncomputable def faultTolerantSampleSize (m_sc f : ℕ) (α T ε : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  m_sc + ⌈α * (f : ℝ) * T / ε⌉₊

FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize_lower.source:
theorem faultTolerantSampleSize_lower (m_sc f : ℕ) (α T ε : ℝ) :
    α * (f : ℝ) * T / ε ≤ (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α T ε : ℝ) := by
  unfold faultTolerantSampleSize
  rw [Nat.cast_add]
  exact (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

FTC.faultTolerantSampleSize_pos.source:
theorem faultTolerantSampleSize_pos {m_sc f : ℕ} {α T ε : ℝ}
    (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) : 0 < faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α T ε :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le hmsc (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

/-- Rounded sample size, in the multiplication order of the deterministic
filtering theorem's budget. -/

FTC.sampling_budget_ceil.source:
theorem sampling_budget_ceil {α ε T : ℝ} {f m_sc : ℕ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hmsc : 0 < m_sc) :
    (f : ℝ) * α * (T / (faultTolerantSampleSize m_sc f α T ε : ℝ)) ≤ ε := by
  have h := sampling_budget (α := α) (T := T) (f := f) hε
    (faultTolerantSampleSize_pos hmsc) (faultTolerantSampleSize_lower m_sc f α T ε)
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h

end FTC

FTC.SelectionRule.source:
structure SelectionRule (I : Type*) [DecidableEq I] where
  select : (Q : Finset I) → Q.Nonempty → I
  select_mem : ∀ Q h, select Q h ∈ Q

FTC.SelectionRule.IsMaxFor.source:
def SelectionRule.IsMaxFor (rule : SelectionRule I) (score : Finset I → I → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ Q h, ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q (rule.select Q h)

FTC.selectionStep.source:
def selectionStep (rule : SelectionRule I) (Q : Finset I) : Finset I :=
  if h : Q.Nonempty then Q.erase (rule.select Q h) else Q

FTC.selectionRun.source:
def selectionRun (rule : SelectionRule I) : ℕ → Finset I → Finset I
  | 0, Q => Q
  | n + 1, Q => selectionRun rule n (selectionStep rule Q)

FTC.selectionStep_spec.source:
theorem selectionStep_spec (rule : SelectionRule I) {Q : Finset I}
    (h : Q.Nonempty) :
    ∃ g ∈ Q, selectionStep rule Q = Q.erase g := by
  exact ⟨rule.select Q h, rule.select_mem Q h, by simp [selectionStep, h]⟩

FTC.selectionStep_removes.source:
theorem selectionStep_removes (rule : SelectionRule I) {score : Finset I → I → ℝ}
    (hmax : rule.IsMaxFor score) {Q : Finset I} (h : Q.Nonempty) :
    ∃ g ∈ Q, selectionStep rule Q = Q.erase g ∧ ∀ y ∈ Q, score Q y ≤ score Q g := by
  exact ⟨rule.select Q h, rule.select_mem Q h, by simp [selectionStep, h], hmax Q h⟩

FTC.selectionStep_subset.source:
theorem selectionStep_subset (rule : SelectionRule I) (Q : Finset I) :
    selectionStep rule Q ⊆ Q := by
  unfold selectionStep
  split
  · exact Finset.erase_subset _ _
  · exact Finset.Subset.refl _

FTC.card_le_selectionStep_add_one.source:
theorem card_le_selectionStep_add_one (rule : SelectionRule I) (Q : Finset I) :
    Q.card ≤ (selectionStep rule Q).card + 1 := by
  by_cases h : Q.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep⟩ := selectionStep_spec rule h
    rw [hstep]
    have := Finset.card_erase_add_one hg
    omega
  · simp [selectionStep, h]

FTC.card_selectionStep_add_one.source:
theorem card_selectionStep_add_one (rule : SelectionRule I) {Q : Finset I}
    (h : Q.Nonempty) : (selectionStep rule Q).card + 1 = Q.card := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep⟩ := selectionStep_spec rule h
  rw [hstep]
  exact Finset.card_erase_add_one hg

FTC.selectionRun_subset.source:
theorem selectionRun_subset (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    selectionRun rule n Q ⊆ Q := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => exact Finset.Subset.refl _
  | succ n ih => exact (ih _).trans (selectionStep_subset rule Q)

FTC.selectionRun_add.source:
theorem selectionRun_add (rule : SelectionRule I) (n m : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    selectionRun rule (n + m) Q = selectionRun rule m (selectionRun rule n Q) := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [selectionRun]
  | succ n ih => simpa [Nat.succ_add, selectionRun] using ih (selectionStep rule Q)

FTC.selectionRun_antitone.source:
theorem selectionRun_antitone (rule : SelectionRule I) {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (Q : Finset I) : selectionRun rule m Q ⊆ selectionRun rule n Q := by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [selectionRun_add]
  exact selectionRun_subset rule d _

FTC.card_le_selectionRun_add.source:
theorem card_le_selectionRun_add (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    Q.card ≤ (selectionRun rule n Q).card + n := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [selectionRun]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := ih (selectionStep rule Q)
    have hstep := card_le_selectionStep_add_one rule Q
    change Q.card ≤ (selectionRun rule n (selectionStep rule Q)).card + (n + 1)
    omega

FTC.card_selectionRun_add_of_nonempty.source:
theorem card_selectionRun_add_of_nonempty (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ)
    (Q : Finset I) (h : (selectionRun rule n Q).Nonempty) :
    (selectionRun rule n Q).card + n = Q.card := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => simp [selectionRun]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hs : (selectionStep rule Q).Nonempty := h.mono (selectionRun_subset rule n _)
    have hq : Q.Nonempty := hs.mono (selectionStep_subset rule Q)
    have hcard := card_selectionStep_add_one rule hq
    have hind := ih (selectionStep rule Q) h
    change (selectionRun rule n (selectionStep rule Q)).card + (n + 1) = Q.card
    omega

FTC.selection_removed_card_le.source:
theorem selection_removed_card_le (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ) (Q : Finset I) :
    (Q \ selectionRun rule n Q).card ≤ n := by
  rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (selectionRun_subset rule n Q)]
  have := card_le_selectionRun_add rule n Q
  omega

FTC.selection_removed_card_eq_of_nonempt.source:
theorem selection_removed_card_eq_of_nonempty (rule : SelectionRule I) (n : ℕ)
    (Q : Finset I) (h : (selectionRun rule n Q).Nonempty) :
    (Q \ selectionRun rule n Q).card = n := by
  rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (selectionRun_subset rule n Q)]
  have := card_selectionRun_add_of_nonempty rule n Q h
  omega

FTC.selection_removed_has_stage.source:
theorem selection_removed_has_stage (rule : SelectionRule I)
    {score : Finset I → I → ℝ} (hmax : rule.IsMaxFor score)
    {n : ℕ} {Q : Finset I} {x : I}
    (hx : x ∈ Q) (hgone : x ∉ selectionRun rule n Q) :
    ∃ t < n, x ∈ selectionRun rule t Q ∧
      ∀ y ∈ selectionRun rule t Q,
        score (selectionRun rule t Q) y ≤ score (selectionRun rule t Q) x := by
  induction n generalizing Q with
  | zero => exact False.elim (hgone hx)
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hs : x ∈ selectionStep rule Q
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt, hmaxT⟩ := ih hs hgone
      refine ⟨t + 1, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [selectionRun] using hxt
      · simpa [selectionRun] using hmaxT
    · obtain ⟨g, hg, hstep, hmaxQ⟩ := selectionStep_removes rule hmax ⟨x, hx⟩
      have heq : x = g := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hs (hstep.symm ▸ Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, hx⟩)
      subst x
      exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n, hg, hmaxQ⟩

FTC.selection_good_stage_of_bad_remainin.source:
theorem selection_good_stage_of_bad_remaining (rule : SelectionRule I)
    {score : Finset I → I → ℝ} (hmax : rule.IsMaxFor score)
    (U B : Finset I) (f : ℕ) (hB : B.card ≤ f)
    (hbad : (selectionRun rule f U ∩ B).Nonempty) :
    ∃ t < f, ∃ g ∈ selectionRun rule t U, g ∉ B ∧
      ∀ y ∈ selectionRun rule t U,
        score (selectionRun rule t U) y ≤ score (selectionRun rule t U) g := by
  let R := selectionRun rule f U
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hbad
  have hbR : b ∈ R := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).1
  have hbB : b ∈ B := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).2
  have hcard : (U \ R).card = f := selection_removed_card_eq_of_nonempty rule f U ⟨b, hbR⟩
  have hex : ∃ g ∈ U \ R, g ∉ B := by
    by_contra h
    have hsub : insert b (U \ R) ⊆ B := by
      intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact hbB
      · by_contra hxB
        exact h ⟨x, hx, hxB⟩
    have hbnot : b ∉ U \ R := by simp [hbR]
    have hlarge := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hbnot, hcard] at hlarge
    omega
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgB⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨hgU, hgR⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hg
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hgt, hmaxT⟩ := selection_removed_has_stage rule hmax hgU hgR
  exact ⟨t, ht, g, hgt, hgB, hmaxT⟩

end FTC

FTC.contribution_ratio_le_one.source:
theorem contribution_ratio_le_one (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) (s : S) :
    c i s / cost c Q s ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hz : cost c Q s = 0
  · simp [hz]
  · have hpos : 0 < cost c Q s := lt_of_le_of_ne (cost_nonneg hc Q s) (Ne.symm hz)
    exact (div_le_one hpos).2 (contribution_le_cost hc hi s)

FTC.sensitivityRatios_bddAbove.source:
theorem sensitivityRatios_bddAbove (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) :
    BddAbove (sensitivityRatios c Q i) := by
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with rfl | ⟨s, rfl⟩
  · norm_num
  · exact contribution_ratio_le_one hc hi s

FTC.sensitivityRatios_nonempty.source:
theorem sensitivityRatios_nonempty (c : I → S → ℝ) (Q : Finset I) (i : I) :
    (sensitivityRatios c Q i).Nonempty :=
  ⟨0, by simp [sensitivityRatios]⟩

FTC.sensitivity_nonneg.source:
theorem sensitivity_nonneg (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (Q : Finset I) (i : I) :
    0 ≤ sensitivity c Q i := by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ Q
  · rw [sensitivity, if_pos hi]
    exact le_csSup (sensitivityRatios_bddAbove hc hi) (by simp [sensitivityRatios])
  · simp [sensitivity, hi]

FTC.sensitivity_le_one.source:
theorem sensitivity_le_one (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s) (Q : Finset I) (i : I) :
    sensitivity c Q i ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ Q
  · rw [sensitivity, if_pos hi]
    apply csSup_le (sensitivityRatios_nonempty c Q i)
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with rfl | ⟨s, rfl⟩
    · norm_num
    · exact contribution_ratio_le_one hc hi s
  · simp [sensitivity, hi]

FTC.sensitivity_of_not_mem.source:
@[simp] theorem sensitivity_of_not_mem {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∉ Q) :
    sensitivity c Q i = 0 := by
  simp [sensitivity, hi]

/-- The sensitivity controls a contribution even for a zero-cost query. -/

FTC.contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost.source:
theorem contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) (s : S) :
    c i s ≤ sensitivity c Q i * cost c Q s := by
  by_cases hz : cost c Q s = 0
  · have hci : c i s = 0 := cost_eq_zero_contribution hc hi hz
    simp [hz, hci]
  · have hpos : 0 < cost c Q s := lt_of_le_of_ne (cost_nonneg hc Q s) (Ne.symm hz)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hpos).1
    rw [sensitivity, if_pos hi]
    exact le_csSup (sensitivityRatios_bddAbove hc hi)
      (by exact Or.inr ⟨s, rfl⟩)

/-- A uniform contribution bound gives an upper bound on the exact supremum. -/

FTC.sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le.source:
theorem sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} {r : ℝ} (hi : i ∈ Q) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hbound : ∀ s, c i s ≤ r * cost c Q s) :
    sensitivity c Q i ≤ r := by
  rw [sensitivity, if_pos hi]
  apply csSup_le (sensitivityRatios_nonempty c Q i)
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with rfl | ⟨s, rfl⟩
  · exact hr
  · by_cases hz : cost c Q s = 0
    · simpa [hz] using hr
    · have hpos : 0 < cost c Q s :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (cost_nonneg hc Q s) (Ne.symm hz)
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hpos).2 (hbound s)

/-- The useful form for a good sampled entry during filtering: a per-entry
bound relative to the input, and a lower bound for the current summary, suffice. -/

FTC.sensitivity_le_of_reference_bound.source:
theorem sensitivity_le_of_reference_bound (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} {reference : S → ℝ} {δ β : ℝ}
    (hi : i ∈ Q) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hentry : ∀ s, c i s ≤ δ * reference s)
    (hcost : ∀ s, β * reference s ≤ cost c Q s) :
    sensitivity c Q i ≤ δ / β := by
  apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le hc hi (div_nonneg hδ hβ.le)
  intro s
  calc
    c i s ≤ δ * reference s := hentry s
    _ = (δ / β) * (β * reference s) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hβ.ne']
    _ ≤ (δ / β) * cost c Q s :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcost s) (div_nonneg hδ hβ.le)

/-- Removing entries can only increase the sensitivity of an entry retained. -/

FTC.sensitivity_mono_denominator.source:
theorem sensitivity_mono_denominator (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    {Q R : Finset I} {i : I} (hQR : Q ⊆ R) (hi : i ∈ Q) :
    sensitivity c R i ≤ sensitivity c Q i := by
  apply sensitivity_le_of_contribution_le hc (hQR hi) (sensitivity_nonneg hc Q i)
  intro s
  exact (contribution_le_sensitivity_mul_cost hc hi s).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cost_mono hc hQR s) (sensitivity_nonneg hc Q i))

/-- An `α`-approximate oracle, in the multiplicative form used in the peeling
proof. For positive `α`, `lower` is equivalent to `σ / α ≤ score`. -/

FTC.ApproxSensitivityOracle.source:
structure ApproxSensitivityOracle (c : I → S → ℝ) (α : ℝ) where
  score : Finset I → I → ℝ
  lower : ∀ (Q : Finset I) (i : I), i ∈ Q → sensitivity c Q i ≤ α * score Q i
  upper : ∀ (Q : Finset I) (i : I), i ∈ Q → score Q i ≤ sensitivity c Q i

FTC.ApproxSensitivityOracle.div_le_score.source:
theorem ApproxSensitivityOracle.div_le_score {α : ℝ}
    (oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle c α) (hα : 0 < α)
    {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) :
    sensitivity c Q i / α ≤ oracle.score Q i := by
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hα).2
  simpa [mul_comm] using oracle.lower Q i hi

FTC.ApproxSensitivityOracle.score_nonneg.source:
theorem ApproxSensitivityOracle.score_nonneg {α : ℝ}
    (oracle : ApproxSensitivityOracle c α) (hc : ∀ i s, 0 ≤ c i s)
    (hα : 0 < α) {Q : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ Q) :
    0 ≤ oracle.score Q i :=
  (div_nonneg (sensitivity_nonneg hc Q i) hα.le).trans
    (oracle.div_le_score hα hi)

/-- Exact sensitivity is an oracle with approximation factor one. -/

FTC.exactSensitivityOracle.source:
noncomputable def exactSensitivityOracle (c : I → S → ℝ) :
    ApproxSensitivityOracle c 1 where
  score := sensitivity c
  lower := by intros; simp
  upper := by intros; exact le_rfl

end FTC
